text.body: śrīmadappadīkṣitapraṇītā citramimāṃsā abhivandya candraśekharamādyaṃ gaurīsakhaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ | vitanomi vipulaviṣayāṃ viśadārthāmarthacitramīmāṃsām || trividhaṃ tāvatkāvyam ; dhvaniguṇībhūtavyaṅgyacitrabhedāt | yatra vācyātiśāyi vyaṅgyaṃ sa dhvaniḥ | yathā - sthitāḥ kṣaṇaṃ pakṣmasu tāḍitādharāḥ payodharotsedhanipātacūrṇitāḥ | valaṣu tasyāḥ skhalitāḥ prapedire cireṇa nābhiṃ prathamodabindavaḥ || atra tapasyantyā devyā dehopari nipatatāṃ prathamavṛṣṭibindūnāṃ kriyāsvabhāvavarṇanena devyāḥ samādhyicitāvasthānābhivāyaktidvārā cirandghataptahopari nipatanena sukhapākavaśyasambhramahetau prachamavṛṣṭāvapyahatā samādhyavasthā vyajyate | tathā hi - nāsāgranyastanayanaḥ saṃvṛtāsyaḥ suniścalaṃ | dhyāyīta manasā devamuro viṣṭabhya cā'grataḥ || iti samādhyucitāvasthanamāhuḥ | tatra pakṣamasu sthitā ityanena nāsāgranyastanayanatārūpamardhanimīlanaṃ vyajyate | sarvathonmīlane pakṣmaṇāmūrdhvāgratvena, sarvathā nimīlane te ṣāmadho'gratvena ca teṣu jalabindūnāṃ stityasambhavāt | pakṣamabhyaścyutānāṃ teṣāmāsyāpraveśena adharoṣṭhe nipatya tataścyutikathanna saṃvṛtāsyatvaṃ vyajyate | tataścyutānāṃ teṣāṃ stanotsedhanipatanādivarṇanena tu uroviṣṭambhaḥ | alasavat avanatāvasthāne hi stanayorantassaṅkucitākāratay tadutsedhayosteṣāṃ patanaṃ na syāt | kathañjittayoḥ patitvā valitrayaṃ prāptānāmapi valīṣu tiryageva gamanaṃ syāt, na nābhideśaprāptiḥ | nābhau ca saṃvṛtāyāṃ praveśo na syāt | pakṣmādharādipatanakramakathanena ca niścalatvaṃ vyajyate | mukhādicalane sati pakṣmapatitānāṃ teṣām adharapayodharādikrameṇa patanāsambhavāt | kiñca, ebhireva viśeṣaṇairdevyā lokottaraṃ saundaryamabhivyajyate | sthitā ityanena pakṣmaṇāmaviralatāyāḥ, kṣaṇamityanena teṣāṃ masṛṇatāyāḥ, pakṣmapatanaśithilavegairudabindubhistīḍanektyā adharasyātisaukumāryasya, pakṣmādharapatanādibhiḥ śithilavegānāṃ teṣāṃ scanotsedhe cūrṇebhāvavarṇanena tayoratikāṭhinyasya, uroviṣṭambhe'pi valīṣu teṣāṃ skhalanoktyā valīnāṃ vispaṣṭatāyāḥ, sarvabindūnāṃ nābhāveva praveśakathanena nābheratigabhīratāyāśca abhivyañjanāt evañca vācyātiśāyi vyaṅgyamatreti | yathā vā - "niśaśeṣacyutacandanaṃ stanataṭaṃ nirmṛṣṭarāgo'dharo netre dūramanañjane pulakitā tanvī taveyaṃ tanuḥ | mithyāvādini, dūti, bāndhavajanasyājñātapīḍāgame, vāpīṃ snātumito gatā'si na punastasyādhamasyāntikam ||" atra vāpīṃ snātuṃ gatā'si, na tu tassakāśamiti vācyārthe sthite tatsakāśameva rantuṃ gatā'sīti adhamapadena prādhānyete | tathā hi - adhamatvamapakṛṣṭatvam | tacca jātyā karmaṇā vā bhavati | tatra jātyā'pakarṣaṃ nottamanāyikā nāyakasya vadati | nāpi svāparādhaparyavasāyidūtīsambhogādihīnakarmātiriktena karmaṇā | tādṛśañca dūtīsambhogātprācīnaṃ sarvaṃ soḍhameveti noddhāṭanāīm | anyathā, svayaṃ dūtīsampreṣaṇānupapatteḥ | tadanantarañca svapreṣitadūtīsambhogarūpameva saṃnihitaiścihnaiḥ jñātuṃ śakyaṃ hīnakarma sambhavatīti tatparyavasāyinā ' dhamapadena tasyāntikameva rantuṃ garā'sīti vyajyate | niśśeṣacyutacandanaṃ stanataṭamityādīni vākyāni sambhogacihnoddhāṭanena tatra sāhāyakamācaranti | katham ? `niśśeṣacyutacandanaṃ stanataṭam' ityatra tānat vāpīṃ snātumito gatā'sīti vācyārthamupapādayituṃ uhottarīyakarṣaṇena candanacyutiriti anyathāsiddhiparibārāya niśśeṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtam | tataścandanacyuteḥ snanasādhāraṇyavyāvartanena sambhogacihnoddhaparihārāya taṭagrahaṇam | snāne hi sarvatra candanacyutiḥ syāt tava tustanayostaṭe uparībhāge eva dṛśyate, iyamāśleṣakṛtaiveti | tathā nirmṛṣṭarāgo'dhara ityatra tāmbūlagrahaṇavilambāt prācīnarāgasya kiñcinmṛṣṭateti anyathāsiddiparihārāya nirmṛṣṭarāga iti rāgasya niśśeṣamṛṣyatoktā | punaḥ snanānasādhāraṇyavyāvartanena sambhogacihnaddhāṭanāya adharaiti viśiṣya grahaṇam| uttaroṣṭhe sarage'dharoṣṭhamātrasya nirmṛṣṭarāgatā cumbanakṛtaiveti | netre dūramanañjane ityatra prātardattamañjanaṃ kālavilambena kiñcidviluptamiti anyathāsiddhiparihārāya dūramityuktam | dūramatyarthamiti āpātato'rthaḥ | etena kālānyathāsiddhinirāsaḥ | punaḥ snānasādhāraṇyavyāvartanena sambhogacihnoddhāṭanāya dūraṃ prānte iti hṛdayasthito'rthaḥ | vastutastu kālataḥsnānena vā sarvato'ñjanalopaḥ syāt, tava tu locanayoḥ kkacit prānta eva anañjanatvamidaṃ cumbanakṛtameveti | `pulakitā tanvī taveyaṃ tanuḥ' ityatra āpātataḥ tanvīti sahajatānavakīrtanam | pulakiteti snānacihnopanyāsaḥ | pulakitā'pi tanvī vartata iti hṛdi sthito'nvayaḥ | tena ca snānena pulakitā tanuḥ kiñjiducchvasitā bhavati, iyaṃ tu na tatheti tatikyeśajanitāveva tānavapulakodgamāviti marmeddāṭanam | evamebhirvākyairupaskṛtena adhamapadena tasyāntikameva rantuṃ gatāsīti vyajyamāne prāgvācyārtādaśāyāṃ vāpīṃ snātuṃ gatā'sītyetadanuguṇārthatayā'nvitaṃ, mthyāvādinīti sambodhanamapi vyaṅgyānuguṇa evā'rthe paryavasyati | tataśca nyagbhāvitavācyamasyā'pi vyaṅgyaṃ vācyātiśāyīti idamapi dhvanerudāharaṇam | yatra vyaṅgyaṃ vācyānatiśāyi tadguṇībhūtavyaṅgyam | yathā - "gacchāmyacyuta darśanena bhavataḥ kiṃ tṛptirutpadyate kintvevaṃ vijanasthayoītajanaḥ sambhāvayatyanyathā | ityāmantraṇabhaṅgisūcitavṛthāvasthānakhedālasāmāśliṣyan pulakotkarāñjitatanuṃ gopīṃ haraḥ pātu vaḥ ||" atra gacchāmyacyutetyādyāmantraṇena tvayā rantumetāvatkālaṃ sthitaṃ, tanna labdhamiti vyaṅgyam | tattu `ityāmantraṇabhaṅgisūcitavṛthānakhedālasām' ityetadvācyasya siddhiṃ karotīti tadaṅgatvānna vācyātiśāyi | ato guṇībhūtavyaṅgyamidam | yathā vā - "praharaviratau madhye vā'hnastaso'pi pare'thavā kimuta sakale yāte vā'hni priya, tvamihaiṣyasi | iti dinaśataprāpyaṃ deśaṃ priyasya yiyāsato harati gamanaṃ bālā''lāpaiḥ sabāṣgalajjalaiḥ || atra sakalamahaḥ paramāvadhiḥ, tataḥ paraṃ prāṇān dhārayituṃ na śaknomīti vyaṅgyaṃ priyagamananivāraṇarūpasya vācyasya siddhiṃ karotīti tadaṅgatvādvācyānatiśayi | ata idamapi guṇībhūtavyaṅgyam | yadavyaṅgyamapi cāru rtāccatram | tat trividham; śabdacitram arthacitram ubhayacitramiti | śabdacijtraṃ yathā - "navapalāśapalāśavanaṃ puraḥ sphuṭaparāgaparāgataṅkajam | mṛdulatāntalatāntamalokayatsa surabhiṃ surabhiṃ sumanobharaiḥ ||" arthacitraṃ tathā - "sa cchinnamūlaḥ kṣatajena reṇustasyopariṣṭāt pavanāvadhūtaḥ | aṅgāśeṣasya hutāśanasya pūrvetthito dhūma ivā''babhāse ||" ubhayacitraṃ yathā - "varāhaḥ kalyāṇaṃ vitaratu sa vaḥ kalpavirame vinirdhunvannaudanvatamudakamurvemudavahat | khurāghātatruṭyatkulaśikharikūṭapraviluṭhacchilākoṭisphoṭasphuṭaghaṭitamaṅgalyapaṭahaḥ ||" tadevaṃ trividhe dhvaniguṇībhūtavyaṅgyayoranyatrāsmābhiḥ prapañjaḥ kṛtaḥ | śabdacitrasya prāyo nīrasatvānnātyantaṃ tadādriyante kavayaḥ, na vā tatra vicāraṇīyamatīvopalabhyata iti śabdacitrāṃśamapahāya arthacitramīmāṃsā prasannavistīrṇā prastūyate | cintye'tra citravarge pradarśyayorlakṣyalakṣaṇayoḥ | prācīnānāmeva ślokāḥ prāyeṇa likhyante || iti citramīmāṃsāyāṃ granthārambhaprakaraṇam || athopamālaṅkāraḥ upamaikā śailūṣī samprāptā citrabhūmikābhedān | rañjayati kāvyaraṅge nṛtyantī tadvidāṃ cetaḥ || `candra iva mukha' miti sādṛśyavarṇanaṃ tāvadupamā | saivoktibhaṅgībhedena anekālaṅgārabhāvaṃ bhajate | tathā hi - `candra iva mukhaṃ mukhamiva candra' ityupameyopamā | `mukhaṃ mukhamiva' ityananvayaḥ | `mukhamiva candra' iti pratīpam | `candraṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ smarāmi `iti smaraṇam | `mukameva candra' iti rūpakam | `mukhacandreṇa tāpaḥ śāmyati' iti pariṇāmaḥ | `kimidaṃ mukham, utāho candra' iti sandehaḥ | `candra iti cakorāḥ tvanmukhamanudhānanti' iti bhrāntimān | `candra iti cakorāḥ kamalamiti cañcarīkāstvanmukhe rajyanti' ityallekhaḥ | `candro'yaṃ na mukham' ityapahnavaḥ `nūnaṃ candra' ityutprekṣā | `candro'ya' mityatiśayoktiḥ | `mukhena candrakamase nirjite' iti tulyayogitā | `niśi candraḥ tvanmukhañcahṛṣyati' iti dīpakam | `tvanmukha evā'haṃ rajyāmi, candra eva cakoro rajyate' iti prativartūpamā | `divi candro bhuvi tvanmukhem' iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | `mukhaṃ candraśriyaṃ bibharti' iti nidarśanā | ` niṣkalaṅkaṃ mukhaṃ candrādatiricyate' iti vyatirekaḥ | `tvanmukhena samaṃ candro niśāsu hṛṣyati' iti sahoktiḥ | `mukhaṃ netrāṅkaruciraṃ smitajyotsnopaśobhitam' iti samāsoktiḥ | `abjena sadṛsaṃ vaktraṃ hariṇāhitasaktinā' iti śleṣaḥ | `mukhasya purataścandro niṣprabhaḥ' ityaprastutapraśaṃsā | evamuktānekālaṅkāravivartavatīyamupamā | tadidaṃ citraṃ viśvaṃ brajhajñānādivopamājñānāt | jñātaṃ bhavatītyādau nirūpyate nikhilabhedasahitā sā || asyāstāvadevaṃ lakṣaṇamāhuḥ - "upamānopameyatvayogyayorarthayordvayoḥ | hṛdyaṃ sādharmyamupametyucyate kāvyavedibhiḥ" || dṛṣṭañja loke sambhāvanāparatvamivaśabdasya | `dūre tiṣṭhan devadatta iva bhāti' iti | kathaṃ ca svatassiddhenetyanena utprekṣāvyāvṛttiḥ ? `na nityamasmin paripūrṇateti tyaktvā nabhaḥ kṣoṇitalāvatīrṇaḥ | ānandayan induriva svadhāmnā vibhāti loko navakākatīndraḥ ||' iti tadīyotprekṣodāharaṇa eva upamānasya svatassiddhatvāt | induḥ kṣoṇitalāvatīrṇatvākāreṇa kavikalpita iti ceccarhi, `candrabimbādiva viṣaṃ candanādiva cānalaḥ | paruṣā vāgito vaktrādityasambhāvitopamā ||' ityuktāyāmasambhāvitopamāyāmavyāptiḥ | viṣānalayoḥ svatassiddhatve'pi candracandanaprabhavatvena kavikalpitatvāt | `ubhau yadi vyomni pṛthakpravāhāvākāśagaṅgāpayasaḥ patetām | tenopamīyeta tamālanīlamāmuktamuktālatamasya vakṣaḥ ||' iti kavikalpitopamānāyāmupamāyāṃ sarvathaivāvyāptiḥ | bhinnenecyananvayavyāvṛttyarthamupāttamapyayuktam | `anantaratnaprabhavasya yasya himaṃ na saubhāgyavilopi jātam | eko hi doṣo gumasannipāte nimajjatīndoḥ kiraṇeṣvivāṅkaḥ ||' ityasyāmupapādakopamāyāmavyāpteḥ | tatropameyadoṣaguṇasāmānyāntargatānāṃ doṣaguṇaviśeṣāṇāṃ kalaṅkakiraṇānāṃ tadbhinnatvābhāvāt | atha upameyatāvacche daka bhinnopamānatāvacche dakāvicchinnatvamupamānasya tadbhinnatvam, etadapi na yuktam | `anavaratakanakavitaraṇabhṛtajalalavakarataraṅgatārthitateḥ | bhaṇitiriva matirmatiriva ceṣṭā ceṣṭeva kīrtirativimalā ||' iti raśanopamāyāmavyāpteḥ, matitvādyupamānatāvacchedakayoḥ upayatāvacchedakabhinnatvābhāvāt | upameyopamāyām upamānāvacchedakayordvayorapi tadbhinnatvābhāvena uttaviśeṣaṇenaiva tadvyāvṛttisiddhyā ekadetyasya vaiyarthyāpatteśca | `rajobhiḥ syandanoddhūtairgaśca ghanasannibhaiḥ | bhuvastalamiva vyoma kurvan vyomeva bhūtalam ||' ityupameyopamāprakaraṇodāhariṣyamāṇaparasparopamāyāmavyāpteśca | atha svopameyatāvacchedakabhinnadharmāvacchinnatvamupamānasya tadbhinnatvamiti vivakṣitam, idamapi na samyak | "upādade tasya sahastraraśmistvaṣṭrā navaṃ nirmitamātapatram | sa taddukūlādavudūramaulirbabhau pataḍhgaṅga ivottamāṅge ||" "dvāraṃ dvāramaṭan bhikṣuḥ śikṣatyevaṃ navaṃ yācate | adattvā mādṛśo mābhūrdatvā tvaṃ tvādṛśo bhava ||" chaitiyādyabhinnadharmikopamāsu avyāpteśca | tatra parameścaratvādeḥ svopameyatāvacchedakasyaiva upamānatāvaccheda katvāt | śleṣavyāvṛttyarthaṃ dharmata iti viśeṣaṇamapyayuktam | tatra na śabdasāmyamātramivenocyate, kintu guṇasāmyamapīti tadavyāvṛtteḥ | nanu pure sakalakalatvaṃ kalakalaśabdasāhityaṃ, sudhāṃśubimbe kalāsākalyamiti naiko'nigatoo guṇo labhyate, mai vam | śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyamūlayā bhede'bheda ityevaṃrūpayā'tiśayoktyā dharmasādhāraṇayalābhāt | na jhupamānopameyayoranugatadharmasya mukhyasādhāraṇya evopamālaṅkāraḥ | `pāṇḍyo'yamaṃsārpitalambahāraḥ klaptāṅgarāgo haricandanena | ābhāti bālātaparaktasānuḥ sanirjharodgāra ivādrirājaḥ ||' ityādau haricandanabālāpahāranirjharādīnāṃ bimbapratibimbabhāvena nirdiṣ‌ṭānāmapi sādhāraṇadharmatvāṅgīkārāt | nanu sakalakalamityādāvapi guṇasāmyaṃ cedupamaiva syāditi cet śabdasāmyamātrañjedapi kimityupamā na syāt | nahi śabdānyaguṇādisāmyamevopamāprayojakaṃ na śabdasāmyamiti kuladharmaḥ | `yathā prahlādanāccandraḥ pratāpāttapano yathā | tathaiva so'bhūdanvarthe rājā prakṛtirañjanāt ||' ityatrānugatānvarthanāmarūpaśabdasāmye'yupamādarśanāt | kintu śleṣasya alaṅkārāntaraviviktaviṣayābhāvena niravakāśatayā balavattvenālaṅkārāntarabādhakatvadadupamāpratibhāne'pi tatpratibhotpattihetuḥ śleṣa eva nopameti maṅkhakādibhirabhyupeyate | tataśca yathā śabdasāmyamātramāśritya upapratibhāne tadbādhakatvaṃ śleṣasya tathā śleṣabhittikābhedādhyavasāyalabdhābhedaguṇasāmyamātramāśritya upamāpratibhāne tadvaktuṃ śakyamiti tadanurodhena na tatra guṇasāmyaparītyāghaḥ | yattu ruderaṭena `sakalakala' mityādāvupamāṃ samarthayamānena - `ruphuyamarthālahgārāvetāpamāsamuccayau, kintu | āśritya śabdamātraṃ sāmānyamihā'pi sambhavataḥ ||' iti śabdasāmyamātramihoktam, tadandadaḥ śabdasāmyamātramāśrityā'pi upamā samarthayitaṃ śakyeti bhāvena, na tvabhedādyavasāyenāpi guṇasāmyaṃ na sambhavatīti bhāvena; śliṣṭaviśeṣaṣvapi abhedādhyavasāyena aikyasyālaṅkarāntareṣu sarverapi samāśrayaṇāt | tasmādhdarmata ityanena na śamaleṣo vyāvartayituṃ vyāvartayituṃ śakyate | vastutastu `sakalakala' mityādāvupamaiveti vyarthaṃ dharmata iti viśeṣaṇam | alaṅkārāntaraviviktastu śleṣasya viṣayastatprakaraṇe darśayiṣyate | kiñca, viviktaviṣayābhāvena alaṅkārāntarabādhakatvamiti vācoyuktirapyayukta | viṣayasadbhāvamātreṇa niravakāśatvahānerviviktaviṣayānapekṣaṇāt | na jhayamalaṅkāragocaroo lokanyāyo yadviviktaviṣayo vaktavya iti | aran‌dhraratnānāṃ suvarṇaviviktaviṣayābhāve'pi suvarṇāśritānāmeva cārutāhetutvena alaṅkārāntaratvavyavasthiteḥ | anyathā nravakāśairarandhrapratyuptaratnaiḥ sāvakāśasya tadāśrayasuvarṇasya alaṅkāratā bādhyeta | nāpyayaṃ vākyavitsammataḥ śaऱāstrīyānyāyaḥ, pad juhootītyādīnāmīva uttarārdhe juhootītyādīnāmāhavanīyaśāstrādiviṣayābhāve'pi saviṣayatvamātreṇa pratiṣṭhitatvāt | nāpyasādhāraṇyena etacchāstranyāyaḥ sahoktyādīnāmatiśayoktyādiviṣayābhāve'pi tadabādhena alaṅkārāntaratvavyavahārāt | avirodha ihāpyavisiṣṭaḥ | tasmādatra upamāpratibhotpattihetuḥ śleṣālaṅkāra ityayuktam | pratyuta upamaivā'tra śleṣatratibhotpattihetuḥ | nahi puravarṇanaprakaraṇe sakalāsākalyalaśraṇārthāntarapratibhā sambhavati | pratīpavyāvṛttyarthamanyena varṇyasya sāmyamityuttaṃ tatra anyenetyayuktam | anyenetyasya bhinnaviśeṣaṇena paunaruktyāt | kiñca, varṇyātprakṛtādanyena aprakṛtena iti yadyarthastadā - `itarāṇyapi rakṣāṃsi peturvānarakoṭiṣu | rajāṃsi samarotthāni tacchoṇitanadīṣviva ||' iti samuccitopamāyāmavyāptiḥ | tatra samarāṅgatvena rajasāṃ śoṇiteṣu patanasyāpi varṇyātvāt | yadi tu svayaṃ varṇyenāvarṇyena vā ku taścidvarṇyā danyenetyarthaḥ, tadātyutkuṣṭaguṇatvādupamānabhāvamapyasahamānasya upamānatvakalpanarūpe pratīpe'tivyāptiḥ | yathā - `ahameva gurussudāruṇānāmiti hālāhala,tāta, mā sma dṛpyaḥ | nanu santi bhavādṛśāni bhūyo bhuvane'sminvacanān durjanānām ||' atra hi varṇyānāṃ durjanavacasāṃ hālāhalenātiprakṛṣṭadopamānabhāvamapyasahamānena sāmyanibandhanaṃ pratīpam | atra varṇyasyetyayuktam, `tvatkīrteḥ puratoo bhāti jyotsnā dhvāntamalīmasā` ityaprastutapraśaṃsāsaṅkīrṇepamāyāmavyāpteḥ | tatra kītereva varṇyatvena jyotsnāyā avarṇyatvāt | api ca, `anyena varṇyasya sāmyaṃ vācyam' iti ko'rthaḥ? kimanyapratiyogikatvena varṇyagataṃ sāmyaṃ vācyamiti, kiṃ vā yatākathañcit varṇyānarṇyobhayanirūpitaṃ sāmyaṃ vācyam, athavā varṇyānuyogikatvena sāmyaṃ vācyamiti? ādye (cakitahariṇalolalocanāyāḥ krudhi taruṇāruṇatārahārakānti |)`sarasijamidamānanañcatasyaḥ samamiti cetasi sammadaṃ vidhatte' ityubhayaviśrāntasādṛśyopamāyāmavyāptiḥ | dvitīye, prasiddapratīpe'pyativyāptistadavasthā | evaṃ tṛtīye varṇasya sāmyamityetāvatā vivakṣitārchalābhādanyenetyasya vaiyarthyam | upameyopamāvyāvṛttyarthamekadeti viśeṣaṇamapyayuktam | tena `khamiva jalaṃ jalamiva kham' ityādau paryāyeṇa pravṛttāyāmupameyopamāyāmativyāptinrāse'pi ` tadvalgunā yugapadunmiṣitena tāvatsadyaḥ parasparatulāmadhirohataṃ dve | praspandamānaparuṣetaratāramantaścakṣustava pracalitabhramarañca pajham ||' iti yugapatpravṛttāyāṃ tasyāṃ ativyāptyanirāsāt | api caivam, `jyotsnevaṃ nayanānandaḥ sureva madakāraṇam | prabhuteva samākṛṣṭasarvalokā nitambinī ||' iti bhinnasādhāraṇadharmāyāṃ mālopamyāmavyāptiḥ, tatrānekadā sāmyapratipādanāt | na ca, bahūpamāmelanameva mālopamā naikā, tāsu ca pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇamastyeveti nācyam | tathā sati upameyopamāpi upamāpratīpamelanameveti tulyam | evamupameyoopamāprakaraṇe udāhariṣyamāṇāyāṃ `rajobhiḥ syandanoddhūtaiḥ' iti parasparopamāyāmavyāptiḥ | vyaṅgyopamāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ vācyamityuktamapyayuktam | `na pajhaṃ mukhamevedaṃ na bhṛṅgau cakṣuṣī ime | iti vispaṣṭasādṛśyāttattvākhyānopamaiva sā ||' ityuktarūpāyāṃ tattvākhyānopamāyāṃ sāmyasyāvācyatvena avyāptyāpatteḥ | `tvadānanamadhīrākṣamāvirdaśanadīdhiti | bhramadbhṛṅgamivālakṣyakesaraṃ bhāti paṅkajam ||' ityādau viśiṣṭopamādyākṣiptaviśeṣaṇāgyu pamāyāmavyāptyāpatteśca | `śastrī śyām' ityādi vācakaluptopamāyāṃ, `candrasuhṛnmukham' ityādisāmyalakṣakapadavadupamāyāñca avyāp‌tyāpatteśca | kiñca, vācyamityatra vidheyatayā vācyatocyate, anuvādyatayā vā? ādye, `sa karṣanmahatīṃ senāṃ pūrvasāgāgāminīm | babhau harajaṭābhraṣṭāṃ gaṅgāmiva bhagīrathaḥ ||' ityādāveva idaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ syāt | `sa yayau prathamaṃ prācīṃ tulyaḥ prācīnabarhiṣā | ahitānaniloddhūtaistarjayanniva ketubhiḥ ||' ityādau na syāt | dvitīye, yatra vyatirekālaṅkāre sāmyasya niṣedhāyānuvādyatā `mukena niṣkalaṅkena na samastava candramāḥ' ityādau, tatrāpīdaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ syāt | na ca niṣedhāpratiyogitvena vācyamiti viśeṣaṇīyam | `asimātrasahāyo'pi prabhūtāriparābhave | naivānyatucchajanavatsagarve'yaṃ mahādyutiḥ ||' iti vyatireke tathāpyativyāpteḥ | na ca niṣedhapratiyogikoṭyananupraviṣṭatayā vācyamiti viśeṣaṇīyam | `vṛthā carasi kiṃ bhṛṅga tatra tatra vanāntare | mālatyāḥ sadṛśīṃ kkāpi bhramannapi na lapsyase ||' ityupamānaluptāyāmavyāpteḥ | tatra sadṛśalābhaniṣedhe sāmyasyāpi pratiyogikoṭiniviṣṭatvāt | tasmādvidyānāthoktalakṣaṇamapyayuktama || yattu sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇoktaṃ lakṣamam `prasiddheranurodhena yaḥ paraspasamarthayoḥ | bhūyo'vayasāmānyayogaḥ sehopamā matā ||' iti | tadapi guṇakriyādīnāṃ parasparasādṛśyavarṇanātmikāyām - `samañjuraśvakṣuṇṇānāmelānāmutpatiṣṇavaḥ | tulyagandhiṣu mattebhakaṭeṣu phalareṇavaḥ ||' ityādyupamāyāmavyāptam | `udgarbhahūṇataruṇīramaṇopamardabhugnonnatastananiveśanibhaṃ hmāṃśoḥ | bimbaṃ kaṭhorabisakāṇḍakaḍārametadviṣṇoḥ padaṃ prathamamagrakarairvyanakti'|| `sadyo muṇḍitamattahūṇacibukapraspardhi nāraṅgakam' ityādau prasiddhirahitopamānāyāṃ, kalpitopamāyāñca avyāptam | yattvalaṅkārasarvasvakṛtoktam `upamānopameyayoḥsādharmye bhedābhedatulyatve upamā | sādharmye trayaḥ pratārāḥ - bhedaprādhānyaṃ dīpakatulyayogitādṛṣṭāntaprativastūpamāsahoktivyatirekādiṣu | abhedaprādhānyaṃ rūpakapariṇāmabhrāntimadullekhādiṣu | dvayostulyatvaṃ yathā'syāmupamāyām | atra hi upamānopameyayorasādhāraṇarupābhyāṃ bhedaḥ, sādhāraṇadharmeṇa abhedaścati dvayorapi tulyataiva' iti tadapyupameyopamātivyāptyādiduṣ‌ṭamiti spaṣṭameva | tasmāddurvacamasyā lakṣaṇamiti | atrocyate - vyāpāra upamānākhyo bhavedyadi vivakṣitaḥ | kriyāniṣpattiparyantamupamālaṅkṛtistu sā || upamānavyāpāra upamitikriyāniṣpādako vyāpāraḥ sādṛśyavarṇanā | so'yamupamitikriyāniṣpattiparyantaṃ vivaśritaścedupamālaṅkāra ityarthaḥ | tathā ca vyatireke vātivyāptiḥ | tatra sādṛśyavarṇanāsattve'pi `mukhena niṣkalaṅ‌kena na samastava candramāḥ' ityādau sāśrāttasyaiva niṣedhena, `nai vānyatucchajanavat' itiyādau tatprayojakadharmaniṣedhena ca upamitikriyāyā aniṣpatteḥ | nāpyananvaye'tivyāptiḥ | tatrāpi svena svasya sādṛśyasya sadṛśāntaravyavacchede rudrarodanavapotkhananādyarthavāde' sadarthasya nindāstutyoriva dvāramātratayā varṇamānatvena upamitikriyāyā aniṣpatteḥ | anyathā svasya tadeva phalaṃ bhāmaṅādayaḥ - `yatra tenaiva tasya syādupamānopameyatā | asādṛśyavivakṣāto vadanti tamananvayam ||' iti | ata eva varṇyamānamapi svasya svasminsādharmyaṃ nānvetīti ananvayapadavyutpattimalaṅkārasarvasvakārādayo vadanti | tataśca yathāmbhasi katakarajassaṃyojanena rajontavyavacchede sati katakarajasooo'pi vilayanātsarvathā'nāvilamambhaḥ sidhyati tathā `rāmarāvaṇayoriva' ityādau svena sādṛśyavarṇanayā sadṛśān‌taravyavacchede sati vastutaḥ svenāpyupamāyā asambhavādanupamaṃ rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhamityatraiva kavisaṃsambha iti upamitikriyāyā aniṣpatternānanvaye'tivyāptiśaṅkāvakāśaḥ | evaṃ pratīpe'pi yatropamityaniṣpattiḥ, `ākarṇaya sarojākṣi, vacanīyamidaṃ bhuvi | śaśāṅkastava vaktreṇa pāmarairupamīyate ||' ityādau, na tatrātivyāptiśaṅkā; upamitikriyāniṣpattivirahāt | `garvamasaṃvājhamimaṃ locanayugalena kiṃ vahasi bhadre | santīdṛśāni diśi diśi sarassu nanu nīlanalināni ||' ityādipratīpamupameyopamā ceti ubhayamapi saṅgrājhameveti na tadvyāpanaṃ lakṣaṇasya doṣaḥ | tathā hiudāhṛtapratīpaṃ tāvadupamāviśeṣa eva | sādṛsyavarṇanasya prakṛtiṣayatva iva aprakṛtaviṣayatve'pi smṛtirūpaṇasandehabhrāntyanekadhāgrahaṇāpahnavasambhāvanā'samābhavadvastusambandha (nibandhana) nirdiṣṭasamarthanādīnāmiva alaṅkārāntaratvāyogāt | anyathā teṣāmapi prakṛtaviṣayatva eva smaraṇarūpakasasandehabhrāntimadullekhāpahnutyutprekṣānidarśanārthāntaranyāsādyalaṅkāratvam, aprakṛtaviṣayatve ca alaṅkārāntaratvam iti kalpanāprasahgāte | smṛtyādayaśca prakṛtaviṣayā iva aprakṛtaviṣayā apyalaṅkārabhūtāstatra tatra udāhariṣyante | na copamāyāmayaṃ niyamo yadaprakṛtena prakṛtasādṛśyavarṇanātmanaiva tathā bhāvyamiti | samuccayopamādyudāhakaṇeṣu prakṛtayoreva, aprakṛtayoreva vā sādṛśyavarṇanasya upamātvāṅgīkārāt | tadvat prakṛtenāprakṛtasya sādṛśyavarṇanamapyupamaiveti yuktam | evañcopameyopamāpi prakṛtāprakṛtaviṣayopamāṇaparaspasopamāyā na alaṅkārāntaratāṃ bhajate | anyathā tatprakaraṇodāhariṣyamāṇaparaspasopamāya api alaṅkārāntaratvaperasaṅegait | parasparabhramanibandhanādiṣvāpi alaṅkārntaratāpatteśca | na cānanvayapratīpopameyopamāsu sādṛśyavarṇanasya pṛthaḍnirūpaṇasya cāviśiṣyatvena ananvayasya anupamātvamitarayorupamātvaṃ ta vaktumayuktamiti vācyam | yatropamitikriyāniṣaapantistatropamāśabdapravṛttinimttasadbhāvena, yatra tadaniṣpittistatra tadābhāvena ca vaiṣamyasya sphuṭatvāt | imameva viśeṣam abhipretya tāvyapratāśikādilakṣaṇeṣu ananvavyudāsārthameva yatnaḥ kṛ too noopameyopamādivyudāsārtham | upameyopamāderupamāntargatatve'pi vyaṅgyādikṛtavaicitryaviśeṣeṇa pṛchaggaṇanaṃ na virudhyate, rūpakapariṇāmavat | `ubhau yadi vyomni pṛthakpranāṅau' ityādau lakṣaṇābhāvo na doṣaḥ | yadi tathābhūtau pravāhau syātāṃ tarjhupamīyeta | na ca tau sambhavataḥ | tasmānna ke nāpyupamīyata iti upamāpararyāyopamityaniṣpatteḥ | tathāpyumātvasvīkāre tatropamāśabdasya pāribhāṣikatvāpatteḥ | kintu tatra ātiśayoktiviśeṣo'laṅkāraḥ | ata eva kāvyaprakāśikāyāṃ `prastutasya yadanyatvaṃ yadyarthektau ca kalpanam' ityatiśayoktiṣu parigaṇayya yadyarthektau kalpanasya, `rākāyāmakalaṅkaṃ cedamṛtāṃśorbhavedvapuḥ | tasyā mukhaṃ tadā sāmyaparābhavamavāpnuyāt ||' ityudāhṛtam | `puṣpaṃ pravālopahitaṃ yadi syānmuktāphalaṃ vā sphuṭavidrumastham | tato'nukuryādviśadasya tasyāḥ tāmrauṣṭhaparyastarucaḥ smitasya || iti tu kavikalpitāmānāyā utpādyopameti vyavahṛtāyā udāharaṇam | tatra yadyutpādyasyopamānasya sambhāvitatayā tenopamitiniṣpatterlakṣaṇamastyeveti nāvyāptiḥ | na caivaṃ `candrabimbādiva viṣam' ityasambhāvitopamāyām avyāptiḥ, tatra asambhāvitenaiva upamanānena upamitikrayāniṣpatteḥ kavinā vivākṣitatvena vivakṣānusāryupamitikriyāniṣpattisadbhāvāt | na hi `vasetusarthanibandhanopamitikriyāniṣpattirupamā' iti lakṣaṇamucyate, kintu kavivivakṣānibandhanā | ata eva śloke vivakṣita iti viśeṣaṇamarthavatama | anyathā `candra ava mukham' ityādāvapi lakṣaṇaṃ na syāt | candragatakāntyatiśayasya vastuto mukhe'bhāvena vivakṣānusaraṇaṃ vinā gatyabhāvāt | na caivamananvaye'pi kavivivakṣayā svasya svena upamitikriyāniṣpattiḥ sambhavatīti vācyam | sarvathaivānupamatvadyotane kavisaṃrambhe sati tathā vivakṣānudayāt | `vṛthā carasi kiṃ bhṛṅgaga' ityādau sādṛśyādhikaraṇasya anupalamābhoktyā upabhyamāneṣu sādṛśyaniṣedhaparyavasāne'pi anupalabhyamānagatasādṛśyābhyanujñānāt tatropamitikriyāniṣpattirastīti nāvyāptiḥ | ata eva viśiṣyānupādānāt upamānaluptatā | evam, nirūpyamāṇaṃ kavinā sādṛśyaṃ svātmano na cet | pratiṣedhamapādāya paryavasyati sopamā || ityapi lakṣaṇamanusandheyam | upamitikriyāniṣpattimatsādṛśyavarṇanamupamā | svaniṣedhāparyavasāyi sādṛśyavarṇanamupamā | iti dvividhamapyetat upamāsāmānyalakṣaṇam | alaṅkārābhūtopamālakṣaṇanti etadeva aduṣṭāvyaṅgyatvaviśeṣitam | viśiṣṭopamādisthale viśeṣaṇādyupamānānāṃ vācyabhūtaviśiṣṭopamādisiddhyaṅgatvāt, vācyasiddhyaṅgarūpaguṇībhūtavyaṅgyataiva tāsāṃ nālaṅkārateti na tadavyāpanaṃ doṣaḥ | `na pajhaṃ mukhamevedam' ityādau nopamālaṅkāraḥ | kintu pratiṣedhākṣiptasaktitayā bhrāntimān, tadupapādakatayā upamā cetyubhayaṃ vyaṅgyam | tathā'pi bhrāntimadādikamapi sādharmyamūlatvamātreṇa upamāmadhye parigaṇayatā daṇḍinā tattvākhyānopameti etādṛśavyavahāraḥ kṛtaḥ paramiti na tatrāpyavyāptirdoṣa iti dik | sā copamā dvividhāpūrṇā, luptā ca | upamānopameyasādhāraṇadharmepamāvācakānāṃ caturṇāmupādāne pūrṇā | teṣāmekasya dvayostrayāṇāṃ vā lope sati luptā | pūrṇāyā kkacitsādhāraṇadharmasya anugāmitayā nirdeśaḥ | kkacidvastuprativastubhāvena | kkacidbimbapratibimbabhāvena | kkacit śleṣeṇa | kkacidupacāreṇa | kkacitsamāsāntarāśrayeṇa | kkacideṣāṃ yathāsambhavaṃ miśraṇena | luptāyāṃ tu naivaṃ bhedāḥ tasyāṃ sādhāraṇadharmasya anugāmitvaniyamāt | kintu prakarāntareṇa bhedā vakṣyante | tatra pūrṇāyāṃ dharmasyānugāmitā yathā - `vāgarthāviva sampṛktau vāgarthapratipattaye | jagataḥ pitarau vande pārvatīparameśvarau ||' autpattikastu śabdasyārthena sambandha iti vāgakthayornityasambandhitvaṃ prasiddham | umāmaheśvarayorapyanayorna pṛthagbhāvaḥ candracandrikayorityatiprasiddham | tathā ca nityasambandhitvarūpo'tra sādhāraṇadharme'nugāmitayā nirdiṣṭaḥ | yadyapyumāmaheśvarayorvāgarthavannityasambandhitvavarṇanena tayorniratiśayaparaspasapremaśālitvaṃ mahāmahimatvamityādi vyajyate tathā'pi na dhvaniguṇībhūtavyaṅgyavyavahāraḥ | na khalu vyaṅgyasaṃsparśapratibhāsādevā'tra cārutāpratītiḥ, kintu vācyavaicitryapratibhāsādapīti prāyastatra tatra sambhavadralādirūpaṃ vyaṅ‌gyamalaṅkāgāntarañca agaṇayitvaiva tattadalaṅkārā udāhriyante | ekasyaiva dharmasya sambandhibhedena dvirupādānaṃ vastuprativastubhāvaḥ | sa tu śuddho na sambhavati | kintu viśeṣaṇatayā viśeṣyatayā vā sarvatra bimbapratibimbabhāvakarambitaḥ | vastutoo bhinnayordharmayoḥ parasparasādṛśyādabhinnatayā adhyavasitayoḥ dvirupādānaṃ bimbapratibimbabhāvaḥ | tatra vastuprativastubhāvasya viśeṣaṇatā yathā - `yāntyā muhurvalitakandharamānanaṃ tadāvṛttavṛntaśatapatranibhaṃ vahantyā | digdho'mṛtena ca viṣeṇa ca pakṣmalākṣyāgāḍhaṃ nikhāta iva me hṛdaye kaṭākṣaḥ ||' atra bimbapratibimbabhāvena nirdiṣṭayoḥ kandarāvṛntayoḥ valitāvṛttaśabdābhyāmeka eva dharme viśeṣaṇatayā nirdiṣṭaḥ | viśeṣyatā yathā - `sā tena jagṛhe sādhvī haṭhātsādhvasakampitā | vānareṇātilolena vātādhūteva vallarī ||' atra sādhvasavātayorbimbapratibimbabhāvāpannayoḥ kampitādhūtaśabdābhyām eka eva dharme viśeṣyatayā nirdiṣṭaḥ | śuddhabimbapratibambabhāvo yathā - `pāṇḍyo'yamaṃsārpitalambahāraḥ' itiyādi | atra harīcandranabālātapau hāranirjharau ca bimbapratibimbabhīvena nirdiṣṭau | śleṣo yathā - `narasiṃha mahīpāla samasto'pi ripustava | pārāvārasamānatvaṃ dadhāti svapadacyutaḥ || ' upacāro yathā - `udbhavantamuditārciṣaṃ tato bhānumantamiva hemabhūbhṛtaḥ | paṅkajairiva kumāramīkṣaṇairvismayena vakacaiḥ papurjanāḥ ||' atra vikāsaḥ puṣpadharmaḥ upameyeṣu vīkṣaṇeṣu upacaritaḥ | samāsabhedāśrayaṇaṃ yathā - `tayā vivṛddhānanacandrakāntyā praphullacakṣuḥkumudaḥ kumāryā | prasannacetassalilaḥ śivo'bhūt saṃsṛjyamānaḥ śaradeva lokaḥ ||' atra vivṛddhānanacandrakāntayeti viśeṣaṇaṃ devyāṃ śaradi ca samāsabhedena pravartate | miśraṇeṣu anugāmitvabimbapratibimbabhāvayormiśraṇaṃ yathā - `bhīmakāntairnṛpaguṇaiḥ sa babhūvopajīvinām | adhṛṣyaścābhigamyaśca yādoratnairivārṇavaḥ ||' atra adhṛṣyatvamabhigamyatvañca nṛpaguṇānāṃ yādoratnānāñca bimbapratibimbabhāvamapekṣya labdhātmakaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ | anugāmitvaśleṣayormiśraṇaṃ yathā - `gate tava bhrātari vatsa,pañcatāṃ cirāya naścāndramasaṃ kulaṃ mahat | adṛṣṭasantānatayā na śobhate vanaṃ hareḥ prāṅgathanādivodadheḥ ||' atra santānaśabdaśleṣamapekṣya labdhātmakaṃ śobhārahitatvaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ | anugāmitvopacārayormiśraṇaṃ yathā - `taṭiṭujjvalahetimuttaraḥ kururājadhvajinīṃ vilokayan | priyayeva bhiyā sakampayā parirebhe dhṛtagharmapāthasā ||' atra sakampatvānugāmidharmapekṣayā labdhacāribhāvaṃ parirambhakartṛtvaṃ bhītyāmupacatītam | anugāmitvasamāsabhedāśrayaṇayormiśraṇaṃ yathā - `śyenapakṣaparidhūsarālakāḥ sāndhamegharudhirārdravāsasaḥ | aṅganā iva rajasvalā diśo no babhūvuravalokanakṣamāḥ ||' atra śyenapakṣaparidhūsaretyādiviśeṣaṇayoḥ samāsabhedāśrayaṇena sādhāraṇyamapekṣya anavalokanakṣamatvamanugāmidharmaścārutātiśayaṃ puṣṇāti | vastuprativastubhāvabimbabapratibimbabhāvayormiśraṇaṃ yathā - `liṅgairmamudassaṃvṛtavikriyāste hradāḥ prasannā iva gūḍhanakrāḥ | vaidarbhamāmantrya yayustadīyāṃ pratyarpya pūjāmupadācchalena ||' atra bimbapratibimbabhāvāpannayoḥ krodhanakrayoḥ saṃvṛtagūḍhaśabdābhyām eka eva dharma ukta iti bimbapratibimbabhāvakarambitavastuprativastubhāvaḥ | santoṣacihnaprasādayorbimbabhāvaśca | śleṣabimbapratibimbabhāvayormiśraṇaṃ yathā - `pārthanāśamuditā nṛpātmajā bāṣpamūhurabhinītamanyavaḥ | ātapakkathitapāthaso bahiḥ śītagarbhasalilā iva hradāḥ ||' atra bāṣpaśabde śleṣasya nṛpātmajahradaviśeṣaṇānāṃ bimbapratibimbabhāvamavekṣya cārutā | upacāra-imbapratibimbabhāvayormiśraṇaṃ yathā - `sā kilā'ṣaśvāsitā caṇḍī bhartrā tatsaṃśrutau varau | udvavāmendrasiktā bhūrbilamagnāvivoragau ||' atrā''śvāsitendrasiktetyanayorvaroragaṇātrya bimbapratibibhāvamapekṣyodvamanamupamānopameyayordvayorapyupacaritam | mukhyārthasya dvayorapyasambhavāt | mukhyārthe tasya grāmyatvācca | cadāhuḥ - `niṣṭhyūtodgīrṇavāntādi gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayam | atisundaramasyattu (tra) grāmyakakṣāṃ vigāhate ||' iti | evamanyadapi dvayoormiśraṇamūjham | anugāmitvabimbapratibimbabhāvasamāsabhedāśrayaṇānāṃ miśraṇaṃ yathā - `nṛpaṃ tamāvartamanojñanābhiḥ sā vyatyagādanyavadhūrbhavitrī | mahīdharaṃ mārgavaśādupetaṃ strotoovahā sāgaragāminīva ||' atra vyatyagāditi anugāmidharmaḥ | anyavadhūrbhavitrīsāgaragāminītyanayorbimbapratibimbabhāvaḥ | āvartamanojñanābhiḥ ityatra samāsabhedāśrayaṇamityeteṣāṃ miśraṇam | anugāmitvaśleṣopacārāṇāṃ miśraṇaṃ yathā - `asau maruccumbitacārukesaraḥ prasannatārādhipamaṇḍalāgraṇīḥ | viyuktarāmāturadṛṣṭivīkṣito vasantakālo hanumānivāgataḥ ||' atrāturadṛṣṭivīkṣita ityādāvanugāmitā | rāmādiśabde śleṣaḥ | cambitaśabdasya vasantapakṣe upacāraḥ - ityeteṣāṃ miśraṇam | evamanye'pi miśraṇodāharaṇabhedāḥ svayameva draṣyavyāḥ | bimbapratibimbabhīvodāharaṇeṣu kaścidviśeṣaḥ | kkacitprasiddasādharmyatayā pratīyamānasādharmyayoḥ bimbapratibimbabhāvaḥ | yathā - `pāṇḍyo'yamaṃsārpitalambahāraḥ' ityādau | kkacidaprasiddhasādharmyatayā yena ke nacitpra kāreṇa upāttasādhāraṇadharmayoḥ bimbapratibimbabhīvaḥ, yathā - `tayā vivṛddhānanacandrakāntyā' itiyīdau | atra hi śaradarṇayoḥ svato'prasiddhasādharmyayorvivṛddhānanetyādinā samāsabhedāśrayaṇena upāttasādhāraṇadharmayoreva bimbapratibimbabhīvaḥ | yathākathañcit sādharmyapratītiṃ vinā bimbapratibimbabhāvo na sambhavatyeva | nanu, `yathā tvaṃ guṇavām̐lloke tathā te nirguṇo ripuḥ | itīdamupamānantu viparītamiti smṛtam ||' ityuktarūpāyā viparītopamāyāḥ kathaṃ nirvāhaḥ tatra hi saguṇatvanirgaṇatvayoḥ napāttena , na vā pratīyamānena dharmeṇa sādharmyapratītirasti | naiṣa doṣaḥ tatrāpi ātyantikasvābhāvikatvādidharmeṇa pratīyamānena tayoḥ sādharmyapratīteḥ | anyathā yathāśabdoditasya sādṛśyasya sarvathā nirālambanatvaprasaṅgāt | evaṃ pūrṇāyā digudāhṛtā | luptāṣṭavidhāvācakaluptā, dharmaluptā, upamānaluptā, vācakopamānaluptā, dharmepamānaluptā, dharmavācakaluptā, vācakopameyaluptā, dhamopamānavācakaluptā ceti | krameṇodāharaṇāni - `kailāsagauraṃ vṛṣamārurukṣoḥ pādārpaṇānugrahapūṣṭham | avehi māṃ kiṅkaramaṣṭamūrteḥ kumbhodaraṃ nāma nikumbhatulyam ||' atra kailāsagauramityatra vācakalopaḥ | nikumbhatulyamityatra dharmalopaḥ | vācakalopaḥ sarvatra samāsavidhārakaśāstrakṛtaḥ | dharmasopastvaicchikaḥ prabhāvādinā nikumbhatulyamityapi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt | `yaccorāṇāmasya ca samāgamo yacca tairvadhoo'sya kṛtaḥ | upatanametadakasmāt āsīdbata! kākatālīyam ||' ityatra kākatālaśabadau vṛttiviṣaye kākatālasamavekriyāvartinau | tena kākāgamanamiva tālapatanamiva kākatālamiti ivārthe `samāsācca tadviṣayt' iti jñāpakāt supsupeti samāsaḥ | ubhayatropameyaṃ krameṇa devadattāgamanaṃ dasyūpanipātaśca | tena devadattadasyusamāgamaḥ kākatālamāgamasadṛśa iti phalati | tataḥ kākatālamuva kākatālīyamiti dvitīye ivārthe `samāsācca tadviṣayāt' iti chapratyayaḥ | tataśca patatā tālaphalena yathā kākasya vadhaḥ evamupanipatitairdasyubhiredesyubhirdettasya vadha ityarthaḥ | yathāha bhagavān bhāṣaayakraḥ | `eva tarhi dvāvivārthau kākagamanamiva tālapatanamiva kākatālaṃ, kākatālamiva kākatālīyam' iti | tacca vivṛtaṃ kaiyaṭena - `tatra kākāgamanaṃ devadattāgamanasya upamānam tālapatanaṃ dasyūpanipātasya | tālena tu yaḥ kākasya vadhaḥ sa devadattasya vadhasyopamāna' miti | akasmādupanamatvañca samāno dharmaḥ | tadāha vṛttikāraḥ - `tena kākatālīyaṃ nāma akasmādupanataṃ citrīkaraṇamucyate' iti | tataścātra kākāgamanatālapatanasamāgamarūpasya patattālakṛtakākavadharūpasya copamānasyānupādānāt chapratyārthepamāyāṃ upamānalopaḥ | samāsārthepamāyāṃ vācakopamānalopaḥ | atraiva `kimiki brūmo vayamidam' iti tṛtīyapādapāṭhe pratyayārthepamāyāṃ dharmepamānalopaḥ | samāsārthepamāyāṃ dharmepamānavācakalopaḥ | atra dharmalopamātramaicchikam | `yaṃ tvaṃ pālayase dharmaṃ dhṛtyā ca niyamena ca | sa vai rāghavaśārdūla, dharmastvāmabhirakṣatu ||' atra sāghavaḥ śārdūla ivatyarthe `upamitaṃ vyāghrādbhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge' iti samāse dharmavācakalopaḥ | atra vācatalopavaddharmalopo'pi śāstrīyaḥ | sāmānyāprayoga eva etatsamāsānuśāsanāt | dharmavācakalupartāyāṃ dharmalopasya aicchikatvamapi sambhavati | yathā - `nṛṇāṃ yaṃ sevamānānāṃ saṃsāro'pyapavargati | taṃ jagatyabhajanmartyaścañcā candrakalādharam ||' atra apavarga ivācaratītyarthe apavargatītyatra ācārārthasya kkipo lopāt vācakavaddharmasyāpi lopaḥ | cañcā ityatra cañcā tṛṇapuruṣa ivetyasmunnarte `iti (adhikārasthitena saṃjñāyāñcatyanena) vihtasya kano `lummanuṣye' iti lubvidhānāt vācakalopo dharmalopaśca | asya ślokasya - iti pāṭhenobhayatrāpi dharmasya śravaṇamapi sambhavati | `rūpayovanalāvaṇyaspṛhaṇīyatarākṛtiḥ | purato harimākṣīṇāmeṣa puṣpāyudhīyati ||' atra vācakopameyayorlepaḥ | rūpayauvanetyādisvaviśeṣaṇasāmarthyāt svātmānaṃ puṣpāyudhamivācaratīti asyārthasya gamyamānatvāt svātmana upameyasya lopaḥ kaveraicchikaḥ na ca eṣa ityupameyasya upādānamastīti śaṅkyam | tasya karmavibhaktyabhāvena puṣpāyudhīyatityatra upameyāsamarpakatvāt | etraiva harīṇasyākṣiṇī iva āyate akṣiṇī āsāmicyasminnarthe'nuśiṣṭe hariṇaśrīṇāmiti pade dharmepamānavācakānāṃ lopaḥ śarve'pyayaṃ `saptamyupamānapūrvapadasya' ityādiśāstrakṛta eva lopaḥ trilope dharmalopastu aicchiko'pi sambhavati | yathā - `yaccotāṇāmasya ca' iti ślokasya dvitīyapāṭhe samāsārthepamāyām | evaṃ luptāyā aṣṭau vidhāḥ pradarśatāḥ | kāvyaprakāśikākārādibhistu pūrṇāyāḥ ṣaṅkidhāḥ, luptāyāstu dharmaluptādiṣu avāntarabhedena kaiścidekonaviṃśatiḥ, anyairviṃśatirvidhāḥ pradarśitāḥ | tatrāyaṃ valibhāgaḥ - pūrṇā tāvad dvividhā śrautī, ārthī ca | sādṛśyamātravācakayathevādiśabdavatī śrautī | sādṛśyaviśiṣṭadharmiparyantatulyasadṛśāsaṅkāśādiśabdavatī ārthī | dvividhāpi vākye samāse taddhite ceteyevaṃ ṣaṅvidhā pūrṇā | dharmaluptāpi pūrṇāvadeva vibhāgavatī | kintu śrautī taddhate na sambhavatītyevaṃ pañcavidhā | vācakaluptā karmakartaṇamuloḥ karmādhikaraṇakyacoḥ kyaṅi ṇinau samāse cetyevaṃ saptavidhā | upamānaluptā vākyasamāyordvividhā | dharmavācakaluptā kkipsamāsayordvividhā | dharmepamānaluptā vākyasamāsayordvividhā | upamevācakaluptā kyaci ekavidhā | dharmavācakopamānaluptā samāsa evaikavidheti | yadhuḥ - "pūrṇā luptā ca sā dvedhā śrautyārthe ceti te punaḥ | dvividhe prathamā vākye samāse taddhite bhavet || tadvalluptāpi dharmasya lope śrautī na taddhite | ivādilope dvividhe ṇamuli kyaci ca kyaḍiṃ || tathā ṇinau samāse ca saptadhā parikīrtitā | upamānasya lope tu dvidhā vākyasamāsayoḥ || ivādidharmalope'pi dvividhā kkipsamāsayoḥ | dharmepamānayorlepe vākyagā ca samāsaga || ināderupamesya dvayorlepe bhavetkyaci | ivādidharmepamānalope tveṣā samāsaga" iti | atrodāharaṇāni tanmatarītyā saṅgṛjhāsmābhirlikhyante - "yasyājñā śirasojhate sumanasāṃ bṛndairyathā mālikā baddhvā muñcati yaḥ paśūniva janānyasyābhravadvaibhavam | hṛdyaṃ śevadhinā samaṃ hṛdi bhajantyānandasāropamaṃ yaṃ dhanyāḥ śaśivatprasannavapuṣe tasmai namaśśambhave ||" atra ṣaṅvidhā'pi pūrṇā darśatā | tatra prathamavākye vākyagā śrootī | dvitīye vākye vākye samāgagā śrotī | `ivena samāso vibhaktyalopaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvañca' iti vārtikakṛdvacanena paśūnivetyasya samāsapadatvātā tṛtīyavākye taddhitaga śrautī | abhravat iti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādvateḥ `tatra tasyeva' ici sūtreṇa ivārthe vihitatvāt | `hṛdyaṃ śevadhināsamaṃ hṛdi bhajanti' ityatra vākyagā ārthī | ānandasāropamaṃṃṃ samāsaga ārthī | hṛdyamitiviśeṣaṇamatrāpi apekṣyate | anyathā dharmaluptaiva syātu; na pūrṇā | śaśivadityatra taddhitagā ārthī | tatratyavateḥ `tena tusyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ' iti tulyārthī vihitatvāt | "mūrtiryathā navasudhā balabhinmaṇīva kaṇṭhaprabhā susadṛśaśca jaṭāstaṭidbhiḥ | śaṅkhākṣi kāñcananibhaṃ padamabjadeśyaṃ yasyaiṣa me'stu hṛdi daivatasārvabhaumaḥ |" atra pañcavidhā'pi dharmaluptā darśitā | tatra mūrtithā navasudheti vākyagā | bhasabhinmaṇīva kaṇṭhaprabheti samāsagā śrautī | ubhayatrāpi bhātītyākriyāprayoge saiva sādhāraṇo dharma iti dharmasuptā na bhavet, atastadaprayogaḥ | śrautī tu dharmasuptā taddhite na sambhavati ṣaṣṭhīsamarthātsaptamīsamarthādvā ivārthe vihitasya vateḥ dharmepādāna vivā'nvayasaukaryabhāvāt | na ca nācyaṃ `ive pratikṛtau' ityadhikāre ivārthe vihitasya taddhitasasya dharmepādānaṃ vinā nairākāṅaakṣyamasti, `kuśāgrīyā buddhiḥ', `śaileyaṃ dadhi', `pauṇjarīkaṃ mukham' iti darśanāt | atastatra śrautī dharmaluptā taddhite udārtuṃ śakyate iti, `ive pratikṛtau' ityadhikāre vihitapratyayānāṃ tulyārthe eva vidhānāt | anyathā te ṣāṃ sādṛśyaviśiṣṭadharmiparyantatvābhāvena `kaśāgrīyā buddhi' rityādyupameyasāmānādhikaraṇyadarśanāditi sūtre ivagrahaṇaṃ na viridhyate | susadṛśaśamacetyādivākyatraye krameṇa ārthī vākyagā samāsagā taddhitagā ca | abjadeśyamtyatra īṣadasamāptau vihito'pi deśyapratyayaḥ sādaśye prayujāyate; so'pi sāmānādhikaraṇyāt sadṛśaparyavasāyī | nanu sadṛśādiśabdaprayoge sādṛśyaviśiṣṭadharmiparyantatvāt ārthīti yuktam | sādṛśyādiśabdaprayoge katham, kiṃ śrautī, uta ārthī? yathā - `parasparākṣisādṛśyamadūrojjhitavartmasu | mṛgadvandeṣu paśyantau syandanābaddhadṛṣṭiṣu ||' ityādau ārthyava | tatra tadditaprakṛtyā dharmiparyantābhidhānapūrvakamena, bhāvapratyayena sādṛśyasyābhidhānāt | vastutaḥ śrautyeveti brūmaḥ tatra daddhitaprakṛtyā dharmiparyantābhidhāne'pi pradhānāpratyayābhihitasya sādṛśyasyaiva vākyārthānvayitvāt | "yaṃ paśyandīpadarśaṃ sapadi manasijaḥ kīyanāśaṃ sa naṣṭaḥ svānte yo'ntaḥpurīyatyatibhajanakṛtastaṃ kumārīyati drāk | mūlastambhāyate yastribhuvanabhavane kokilālāpinī yaṃ vāmāṅge kalpavallī śrayati kuvalayaśyāmalā, taṃ bhajāmi ||" atra saptavidhāpi vācakaluptā darsitā | tatra dīpamiva paśyannityarthe dīpadarśamiti karmaṇamuli, kīṭa iva vaṣṭa ityarthe kīyanāśaṃ naṣṭa iti kartṛṇamuli, svānte|‍ntaḥpure ivācaratītyarthe antaḥpurīyatīti adhikaraṇakyaci, kumāraṃ skandamivācaratīti karmakyaci, tribhuvanasyotpattau mūlastambha ivācaratītyarthee mūlastambhāyate iti kartṛkyaṅi, kokila ivāsapatītyarthe kokilālāpinīti ṇinau, kuvalayamiva śyāmaletyarthe kuvalayaśyāmaleti samāse ca krameṇa vācakaluptā draṣṭavyā | `pūjanaṃ puraripostanotu me cittamanyadapahāya cāpalam | yatsamaṃ priyahitaṃ na dṛśyate yena nāpi sadṛśaṃ niśamyate ||' atra yatsamamiti samāse, yena sadṛśamiti vākye ca upamānaluptā dvividhā'pi darśitā | "vṛthā mama bhramatyaho! manaḥ sthite maheśvare śruto'sti tena kiṃ samaḥ smṛto'thavā'sti tatsamaḥ | ṣaḍaṅghrayatvadassadā tadaṅghrapaṅkajadvaye cakorakīyatu sthiraṃ tadānane śaśiprabhe ||" atra saptavidhāpi vācakaluptā darśitā | tatra dīpamiva paśyannityarthe dīpadarśamiti karmaṇamuli, kīṭa iva naṣṭa ityarthe kīṭanāśaṃ naṣṭa iti kartṛṇamuli, svānte'ntaḥpure ivācaratītyarthe antaḥ purīyatīti adhikaraṇakyaci, kumāraṃ skandamivācaratīti karmakyaci, tribhuvanasyotpattau mūlastambha ivācaratītyarthe mūlastambhāyate iti kartṛkyaṅi, kokila ivālapatītyarthe kokilālāpinīti ṇinau, kuvalayamiva śyāmaletyarthe kuvalayaśyāmaleti samāse ca krameṇa vācakaluptā draṣṭavyā | evamayaṃ pūrṇāluptāvibhāgo vākyasamāsapratyayaviśeṣagocaratayā śabdaśāstravyutpattikauśalapradarśanamātraprayojano nātīvāsaṅkāraśāstre vyutpādyatāmarhati | na vā luptānāmayaṃ sāmastyena vibhāgaḥ | tathathā hi - dharmaluptā vākyasamāsataddhiteṣu darśitā dvirbhāve'pi dṛsyate - `paṭupaṭurevadatta' iti | atra hi `prakāre guṇavacanasya' iti sādṛśye dvirbhāvavidhānāt, paṭusadṛśa ityarthaḥ | yo hi śāstrādiṣvapaṭureva paṭuvadabhinayati sa ucyate paṭupaṭuriti | na tāvadiyaṃ vākye dharmaluptā | `karmadhārayavaduttareṣu' iti samāsavadbhāvavidhānenaikapadyasiddheḥ | ata eva na samāse'pi dharmalupteyam | vācakaluptā ṇiniṃ vinā kaiścit ṣahkidhā darśitā | ṇininā saha aparaissaptavidhā, kkiptaddhitayorapi dṛśyate - `yadbhaktānāṃ sukhamayaḥ saṃsāro'pyapavargati | taṃ śambhumabhajanmartyaścañcaiva svahitākṛteḥ ||' iti | vivṛtametadadhastāt | vākyasamāsayorūpamānaluptā'pi darśinā, `upanatametadakasmāt āsīdbata! kākatālīyam' iti taddhite'pi dṛśyate | vācakopamānaluptā svarūpata eva nodāhṛtā | sā'pi kākatālīyamiti prakṛtibhūte samāse dṛsyatate | dharmepamānaluptāpi taddhita kākatālīyāmityatra dṛśyate | dharmavācakaluptā kkipsamāsayopariva taddhite'pi dṛśyate | `taṃ jagatyabhajanmartyaścañjā candrakamalādharam' iti hi prāgudāhṛtam | tasmālluptāvibhāge diṅmātrapradarśanamevedaṃ prācāṃ na tu sāmastyena vibhāgaḥ | ye cānce kāvyālookādiṣu upamāyāṃ prakārabhedā rśitāste sarve teṣveva draṣṭavyāḥ | darśitāścehāpi leśato sakṣaṇavicāraprastāve | rūpakaprakaraṇe cāsyāḥ prakārabhedān kāṃścitpradarśayiṣaayāmaḥ | punaśceyamupamā saṃkṣepatastridhā | kkacit svavaicitryamātraviśrāntā yathā - `sa cchinnamūlaḥ kṣatajena reṇuḥ' ityādau | kkaciduktārthepapādanaparā yathā - `anantaratnaprabhavasya' itiyādau | yatā vā - `vistrabdhaghātadoṣa svavadhāya khalasya vīrakopakaraḥ | vanatarubhaṅgadhvaniriva harinidrātaskaraḥ kariṇaḥ ||' kkacidvyaṅgyapradhānā sā vyaṅgyasya vastvalaṅkārarasarūpatayā traividhā | tatra vastudhvaniryathā - "darpāndhagandhagajakumbhakapāṭakūṭasaṅkrāntinidhnaghanaśoṇicaśoṇarociḥ | vīrairvyaloki yudhi kopakaṣāyakāntiḥ kālīkaṭākṣa iva yasya kare kṛpāṇaḥ ||" atra kṛpāṇasya kupitakālīkaṭākṣasādṛśyavarṇanena sakalaripubalakṣayaḥ kṣaṇādeva kariṣyata iti vastu vyajyate | alaṅkāradhvaniryathā - `yaśāsi tava vikasite nṛpa, himakarakiraṇacchaṭādhavale | bhramara iva puṇḍarīke virājate viṣṇupadametat ||' atropamālaṅkāreṇa yaśasaḥ puṇḍarīkadvaipulyasya, gaganasya ca bhramaravadalpatvasya pratīterāśrayāśrayiṇoranānurūpyalakṣaṇo'dhikālaṅkāro vyajyate | rasadhvaniḥ vāgarthāviva ityatrodāhṛtaḥ | kkacidekatraiva trividho'pi dhvanirdṛśyate yathā - `paśyātra nalinīpatre balākā paridṛśyate | harinmaṇimaye pātre śuktikeva pratiṣṭhitā ||' kimāvayoḥ saṅkesthānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti praṣṭumanaso janasamakṣamapṛcchataśca pracchannakāmusya abhiprāyamiṅgitena viditavatyā vidagdhāyāḥ saṅketasthānasūcanārthamidaṃ vacanam | atra pajhapattrasthitabalākāyā marakatapātrapratiṣṭhitaśikāsādṛśyavarṇanena tasyastadvanniścalatvapratīterāśvastavaṃ vyajyate | tena tatpradeśasya nirtanatvaṃ vyajyata iti vastudhvaniḥ | tataśca tadeva saṅkatasthānamāvayoriti prakāśanāt saṃlakṣitasūkṣmārthaprakāśavanarūpasūkṣmālaṅkāradhvaniḥ | evaṃ tadabhiprāyānurūprāyānurūpavarṇanātparasparamaṃ ratibhāve vyajyata iti rasadhvaniśca | nanu rasādidhvanirasaṃlakṣyakrama iti prasiddhiḥ; kathamatra tasyānuraṇanena vyaṅgyatocyate ? maivam | yatra vibhāvānubhāvādivaśādāsu bhāvini rasābhivyaktistatrā'saṃlakṣyakramatā | anyatra tu rasādidhvanirapi saṃlakṣyakrama eva | taduktamabhinavaguptapādācāryaiḥ - `yadyapi rasabhāvādirarthe dhvanyamāna eva, na vācyaḥ kadācidapi, tathā'pi na sarve'saṃlakṣyakramasya viṣayaḥ' iti | ata eva dhvanikāto'pi - `evaṃ vādini devarṣo pārśce pituradhomukhī | līlākamalapatrāṇi gaṇayāmāsa pārvatī ||' ityatra lajjākhyaṃ sañcāribhāvamanuraṇanavyaṅgyamudājahāra | athopamāvyaṅgyaprasaṅgādupamādhvanayaḥ pradarśyante | tatra śabdaśaktimūlopamādhvaniryathā - `kirat prakaraṃ gavāṃ prakāmaṃ sumanassvaccataraṃ nidhau kalānām | katicitkalayanti yatprabodhaṃ katicinneti sa tatsvabāva eva ||' ekasmādgurorvidyāṃ śiśkṣamāṇānāṃ kecitpragalbhante nānya iti viśeṣo bodhakasya gurosteṣu teṣu bodhanaviśeṣakṛto na bhavati, kintu tatsvabhāvakṛta ityasminnarthe prakṛte'prakṛtārthasya upamānatvakalpanayā atraivamupamā vyatyate yathā candre kiraṇānāṃ prakaramaviśeṣeṇa sarvapuṣpeṣu vikirati kānicidvikasanti, nānyānīti eṣa vikirati teṣa bodhābodhaviśeṣo'pi tattatsvabhāvakṛta evati | atra śliṣṭānāṃṃ gosumanaḥkalānidhiśabdānāṃ vāgādiparyāparivṛttyasahiṣṇutvāt śabdaśattimūlānuraṇanarūudhvaniḥ | arthaśaktimūlo vastunopamādhvaniryathā - `vāhi vāta, yataḥ kāntā tāṃ spṛṣṭvā māmapi spṛśa | tvayi me gātrayaṃsparśaścandre dṛṣṭisamāgamaḥ ||' atrārtaśaktyā candre dṛṣṭisamāgama ityanena candre sītāmukhasādṛśyaṃ vyajyate | alaṅkāreṇa upamādhvaniryathā - "yairdṛṣṭo'si tadā lalāyapatitaprasaprahāro yudhi sphītāsṛkstrutipāṭalīkṛtapurobhagaḥ parāndārayan | teṣāṃ dussahakāmadehadahanaprodbhūtanetrānalajvālālībhāsure puraripāvastaṃ gataṃ kautukam ||" atra anyatkāryaṃ prakurvato'śakyānyavastukaraṇātmako viśophālaṅkāraḥ, uktarūpaṃ tvāṃ paśyato yathooktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭapurarīpudariśanamāsīditi nibandhanāt | karaṇasya krayāsāmānāyātmano darśane'pi sadhbhāvāta | yadyapi ayamarthe na vācyastathā'pi tasmin kautukāstamayavarṇanādvyaṅgyaḥ | tena tadā tvaṃ tathābhūtaḥ purapuriva sthito'siti upamā vyajyate | evamupamādigudāhṛtā | athopamādoṣāścintyante - nyūnatvamadhikatvaṃ liṅgabhedoo vacanabhedooo'sādṛśyamasambhava ityasyāḥ ṣaṭ doṣānāhuḥ | tatropameyādupamānasya aprakṛṣṭatvaṃ nyūnatvam | utkṛṣṭatvamādhikyam | dvayamapi jātyā pramāṇena dharmato vetā pratyekaṃ trividham | tatra jātipramāṇagatanyūnatvādhikye yathā - "caṇḍālairiva yuṣmābhiḥ sāhasaṃ parame kṛtam" | "vahnisphuliṅga iva bhānurayaṃ cakāsti |" "ayaṃ pajhāsanāsīnaścakravāko virājate | yugādau bhagavānvedhā vinirmitsuriva prajāḥ ||" "pātālamiva nābhiste parvatāviva ca stanau | veṇīdaṇḍaḥ punarayaṃ kālindipātasannibhaḥ ||" atra caṇḍālādibhirupamānaiḥ prastuto'rthe'tyantameva kadarthita iti anucitārthatāyāmiye nyūtvādhikye paryasyataḥ | dharmato nyūnatvādhikapadatvarūpau doṣau yathā - "sa munirlāñchito mauñjyā kaṣṇājinapaṭaṃ vahan | vyarājannīlajīmūtabhāśliṣṭa avāṃśumān ||" "sa pītāvāsāḥ pragṛhītaśārṅge manojñabhīmaṃ vapurāpa kṛṣaṇaḥ | śatahrandrāyudhavānniśāyāṃ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ śasineva meghaḥ ||" atrādye upamānasya mauñjīpratibimbastaṅillakṣaṇadharme na niba dhda iti nyūnatvam | dvitiye upameyasya śaṅkhāderanirdeśava śaśino grahaṇatiricyata ityādhikyam | liṅgavacanabhedo yathā - "bhāgyabhāvātkarastho'pi cintāratnamiva cyutaḥ | saktavo bhakṣitā deva śuddhāḥ kulavadhūriva ||" imau prakra ṇabhaṅgāntarbhūtau | katham? karacyutatvādiratra sādhāraṇadharme bhavituṃ nāīti | upamānopameyayormadhye yatra liṅgavacanasārūpyaṃ tatraivā'sya samanvayena ubhayānvayābhāvāt | tathā copāttaviśeṣaṇaviṣṭasyaiva upamānatvamupameyatvaṃ vā bhavet | pratīyamānena tu dharmāntareṇa upamā nirvājhā | tataścopamānopameyayoḥ kasyacitsaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ, anyasya na - ityevaṃ viśeṣaṇaprakramabhaṅgarūpatā | kecitta kālapuruṣasoḍharthādibhedamapi dooṣamāhuḥ | yathā - "tasyāpanodāya phalapravṛttāvupasthitāyāmapi nirvyapekṣaḥ | tyakṣyāmi vaidehasutāṃ purascāskamudranemiṃ piturājñayeva ||" atra samudranemimatyajamimatyanveti, na tu tyakṣyāmiti | puruṣabhedo yathā - "śarīkamātreṇa narendra tiṣṭhan ābhāsi tīrthapratipāditarddhiḥ | āraṇyakopāttaphalaprasūtiḥ stambena nīvāra ivāvaśiṣṭaḥ ||" nīvāre ābhātītyanveti, na tvābhāsīti | vidhyādibhedo yathā - "āśāsyamanyatpunaruktabhūtaṃ śreyāṃsi sarvāṇyadhijagmuṣaste | putraṃ labhasvātmaguṇānurūpaṃ bhavantamīḍyaṃ bhavataḥ piteva ||" bhavantamalabhatetyanveti, na tu labhasvetyāśīḥ | asādṛśyāsambhavau upamāyāṃ anucitārthatāyāṃ paryavasyataḥ | asādṛśyaṃ yathā - "grathnāmi kvāyaśaśinaṃ vitatārtharaśmim" kāvyasya śaśinā sādṛśyamaprasiddham | yadyarthānāṃ raśmīnāñca sādṛśyaṃ prasiddhaṃ syāt, tadā tadīyabimbapratibimbabhāvena kāvyaśaśinoḥ sādṛśyamaprasiddhamapi ānīyeta | na ca tadapyasti | yathā vā - "eṣa vindhyācalassāndrakuñjoccalitanirjharaḥ | bhālekṣaṇasphuradvahniśikhāṭopa iveśvaraḥ ||" asambhavo yathā - "bāṣpadigdhekṣaṇaṃ vaktraṃ taruṇyāḥ parudṛśyate | tuṣārasiktacchadanaṃ taraṅgiṇyā ivotpalam ||" atra bāṣpadigdhekṣaṇaṃ tuṣākasiktacchadanamiti anayorbimbapratibinbabhāvena sādṛśyasambhave'pi utpalasya mapakhaṃ prati upamānatvāprasiddhireva doṣaḥ | athaiṣāṃ doṣāṇāṃ yathāsambhavamapavādāḥ pradarśyante | kavisamayasammateṣu jātyā pramāṇena ca nyūnatvādhikye na doṣau | yathā - "tavananasamaścandraḥ candratulyaṃ tvadānanam | dvyaṇukaṃ madyasadṛśaṃ madhyaṃ dvyaṇukasannibham ||" atra kavisamayaprasidderna kiñcidanaucityam | upameyo pamānagatādhikadharmepādānasya ekai ka dharma kāne ko pamārthatvena vā sādhāraṇa dharmavattāsampādanārthatvena vā dharmisvarūpaviśeṣalābhārthatvena vā vidhāntareṇa vāṃ prastutakāryāntarārthatve dharmato nyūnatvādhikye na doṣau | yathā - " kṣīrodaveleva saphevapuñjā paryāptacadreva śarattriyāmā | navaṃ namakṣaumanivāsinī sā bhūyūyo babhau darpaṇamādadhānā ||" ityatropameyagatakṣaumadarpaṇarūpādhikaviśeṣaṇopādānasya ekkaiviśeṣaṇakānekopamānārthatvāt | "kṣīrodavelā ca saphenapuñjā paryāptacandrā ca śarattriyāmā | anuvyadhāt kṣaumanivāsinīṃ tāmacchaprabhaṃ darpaṇamādadhānām |" ityasyaiva ślokasya pāṭhe upamānagatānekadharmepādānamaikaidharmakopamādvayārthamiti upamānasya dharmata ādhikyaṃ na doṣaḥ | "iti vijñāpito rājñā dhyānastimitalocanaḥ | kṣaṇamātramaṣistasthau suptamīna iva hradaḥ ||" atra vijñāpitaviśeṣaṇaṃ dhyānastimitalocana iti sādhāraṇadharmavattāsampādanārthamiti nyūnatvaṃ na doṣaḥ | "jyāninādamabhigṛhṇatī tayoḥ pradurāsa bahulakṣapācchaviḥ | tāḍakā calakapālakuṇḍalā kālikeva nibiḍā balākinī ||" atra nibiḍeti viśeṣaṇaṃ kālikāyāṃ bahulakṣapācchaviriti sādhāraṇadharmavattāsampādanārthamiti ādhikyaṃ na doṣaḥ | "atithiṃ nāma kākutsthāt putramāpa kumudvatī | paścimādyāminīyāmātprasādamiva cetanā || " atra atithiṃ nāmeti viśeṣaṇaṃ dharmisvarūpaviśeṣalābhārthamiti nyūnatvaṃ na doṣaḥ | "rasāntarāṇyekarasaṃ yathā divyaṃ payo'śrute | deśe deśe guṇoṣvevamavasthāstvamavikriyaḥ || " atra dvyamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ dharmiviśeṣalabhārthamiti ādhikyaṃ na doṣaḥ | evaṃ prakṛtakathāsaṅghaṭanacamatkārādikāryāntarārthatve'pi draṣṭavyam | evañaca prastutakāryāntaropayogarahitanāṃ bimbapratibimbabhāvena sādhāraṇadharmataikaprayojanatāyā sambhāvyamānānāmupameyopamānaviśeṣaṇānāṃ prativiseṣaṇānirdeśa eva nyūnatvamadhikatvañca doṣaḥ | kāryāntarārthānāmapi anugāmitayā prativiśeṣaṇanirdesena vā sādhāraṇīkaraṇe tvadhikoguṇaḥ | yathā - "jyāninādamabhigṛhṇatī" iti śloke jyāninādamabhigṛhṇatīti upameyaviśeṣaṇaṃ tāḍhakā svayameva jighāṃsayā prādurbhaya prathamamabhidrutavatī rāmeṇa hateti strīvadhāvocityaparihārārthatve'pyupamānasādhāraṇam, kālikāyāmapi garjitasālinyāmatiśayoktyā tadviśeṣaṇānuvṛtteḥ | tathā - "nṛpaṃ tamāvarta" iti śloke "anyavadhūrbhavitrī" ityasya vyatikramaṇārthatve'pi sāgaragāminīti tatprativiśeṣaṇanirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | yatra liṅgavacanabhede'pi sāmānyābhidhāyipadaṃ svarūpabhedaṃ nāpadyate tatra na doṣaḥ, ubhayānugatikṣamatvāt; yathā - `bhīmakāntairnṛpaguṇaiḥ'| "tadveṣo'sadṛśo'nyābhiḥ strībhirmadhuratābhṛtaḥ | dadhate sma parāṃ śobhāṃ tadīyā vibhramā iva ||" sāmānybhidhāyipadasya svarūpabhedāpattāvapi liṅgavacanabhedo mahākaviprayogeṣu dṛśyate | " dveṣyo'pi sammataśśiṣṭastasyārtasya yathauṣadham | tyājyo duṣṭaḥ priyo'pyāsīdaṅgulīvoragakṣatā ||" "pravṛddho hīyate candrassamapadro'pi tathāvidhaḥ | satu tatsamavṛddhiśca na cā'bhūttāviva kṣayī ||" ityādau | kālādibhede tu bhūyāṃsyudāharaṇāni | "etādṛśīṣu lokasīddhatvālliṅgadibhedo na doṣaḥ" iti vāmanaḥ | evaṃ guṇadoṣavyavasthāyāṃ sahṛdayahṛdayameva pramāṇam | uktaṃ hi daṇḍinā - "na liṅgavacane bhinne na hīnādhikate api | upamādūṣaṇāyālaṃ yatrodvego na dhīmatām || strīva gacchati ṣaṇḍo'yaṃ vaktyeṣā strī pumāniva | prāṇā iva priyo'yaṃ me vidyā dhanamivārjitā || bhavāniva mahīpāla, devarājo virājate | alamaṃśumataḥ takṣāmāroḍhuṃ tejasā nṛpaḥ | ityevamādi saubhāgyaṃ na jahātyeva jātucit || asti ca kkacidudvegaḥ prayoge vāgvidāṃ yathā | haṃsīva dhavalaścandraḥ sarāsīvāmalaṃ nabhaḥ || bhartṛbhakto bhaṭaḥ śvave khadyoto bhāti bhānuvat || īdṛśaṃ varjyate sadbhiḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra cintyatām ||" iti | kavisamayaprasiddhau satyāmasādṛśyaṃ na doṣaḥ | yathā - `candradhavalā kīrtiḥ' ityādau | upameyagatāsambhāvitatvavivakṣāyāmupamānasyāsambhavo na doṣāya; yatā - candrabimbādiva viṣam' ityādau | śliṣṭasādhāraṇadharmāyāmanyatrāpi sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādinyāṃ kalpitopanāyāmupamāyāmaprasiddhitvaṃ na doṣaḥ; yathā - "kavimatiriva bahulohā sughaṭitacakrā prabhātaveleva | haramūrtiriva hasantī bhāti vidhūmānalopetā ||" "sadyomuṇḍitamattahūṇacibukapraspardhi nāraṅgakam |" ityādau | evamanye'pe doṣāpavādaprakārā vidvadbhiścantanīyāḥ | iti citramīmāṃsāyāmupamāprakaraṇam | athopameyopamā nirūpyate upamānopameyatvaṃ dvayoḥ paryāyato yadi | upameyopamā sā syād dvividhaiṣā prakīrtitā || yadi dvayoryadvarṇyate sopameyopametyucyate tadā tulyayogitāyāmativyāptiḥ | tatra - "janasya tasmin samaye vigaḍhe babhūvaturdvau saviśeṣakāntau | tāpāpanodakṣamapādasevau sa codayastho nṛpatiḥ śaśī ca ||" iti dvayornṛpaśaśinoryugapadekadharmānvayavarṇanāt | ataḥ paryāyeṇetyuktam | tathā'pi - "tasya dvipānāṃ madavārisekt khurābhighātācca turaṅgamāṇām | reṇuḥ prapede pathi paṅkabhāvaṃ paṅko'pi reṇutvamiyāya netuḥ ||" ityatrātivyāptiḥ | tatra reṇupaṅkayoḥ paryāyeṇa paṅkareṇabhāvavarṇanāt | ata upamānopameyatvamityuktam | dvatyaryadupamānopameyatvaṃ varṇyate sopameyopametyukte'pi 'vyaṣṭaṃ prayāṇaṃ caja viyogavedanāvidūnanārīkamabhūtsamaṃ tad' itiyubhayaviśrāntasādṛśyāyām upamāyām ativyāptiḥ | na ca tatra ubhayorapi sādṛśyāśrayatvarūpasyopameyatvasyaiva pratipādanamasti na sādṛśyapartiyogitvarūpasyopamānatvasya, ato nātivyāptiriti vācyamiti lakṣaṇe vivakṣitaṃ vyaṅgyopameyopamāsaṅgrahābhāvaprasaṅgāt | ataḥ paryāyeṇetyuktam | evamapi `bhaṇitiriva matirmatiriva matirmatiriva ceṣṭā' itiyādiraśanopamāyāṃ maticeṣṭayoḥ paryāyabhedenopamānatvasya upameyatvasya ca satttvena ativyāptiparihārāya ekasmin paryāye yaṃ pratyupamānatvaṃ taṃ pratyeva paryāntare upameyatvaṃ vivakṣaṇīyam || dvividhaiṣetyuktam | dvaividhyaṃ dharmasya sādhāraṇyavastubhāvābhyām - "sugandhi nayanānandi madirāmadapāṭalam | ambhojamiva te vaktraṃ tvadvaktramiva paṅkajam ||" "sacchāyāmbhojavadanāḥ sacchāyavadavāmbujāḥ | vāpyo'ṅganā ivā''bhānti yatra vāpya ivāṅganāḥ ||" iti krameṇodāharaṇe | atredaṃ vicāryate | lakṣaṇasya "tadvalgunā yugapadunmiṣitena tāvat" iti prāgudāhṛtāyāṃ yugapadupameyopamāyāmavyāptiḥ | na ca, iyamupameyopamā na bhavati, kantu ubhayaviśrāntopamāmātramiti śāṅkanīyam | parasparatulāmityanena dvayorapi pratiyogitvasyā'pi pratipādyamānatayā upameyena upameti avayavārthasyāviśiṣṭatvāt | arthādapi sidhyataḥ parasparapratiyogitvasya mukhataḥ pratipādanena tṛtīyasadṛśavyavacchedarupaphalalābhācca | kiñja `rajobhiḥ syandanoddhūtaiḥ' iti prāgudāhṛtāyāṃ parasparopamāyāmativyāptiḥ | na ca tatrapyupameyopamā; tṛtīyasadṛśavyavacchedāpratīteḥ | `dvividhaiṣā prakīrtitā' iti vibhāgāsāmañjasyaprasaṅgācca | na jhatra dharmasya sādhāraṇyaṃ vastuprativastubhāvo vā'sti | gaganasya bhūtalena sādṛśye rajovyāptatvaṃ sādhāraṇadharmaḥ | bhūtalasya gaganena sādṛśye gajānāṃ meghānāñca bimbapratibimbabhāva iti atyantavilakṣaṇatvāt | ata evātra tṛtīyasabrajhacārīvyavacchedarūpaṃ phalati | kasyacet kenacit sādṛśye virṇite tasyāpyanyena sādṛśyarthasiddhamapi varṇyamānaṃ tṛtīyasadṛśavyavacchedārthaṃ bhavatīti hi tatphalakatve bījam | na ca etat dharmasādhāraṇya iva dharmabhede'pi labhyate | rajobhirgaganasya bhūtalasādṛśyavarṇanena bhūtalasya meghākārairgajairgaganasādṛśyasya arthataḥ siddhyabhāvāt | api ca - "pitā samārādhanatatpareṇa putreṇa putrī yathaiva tena | putrastathaivādhikavatsalena sa tena pitrā pitṛmān babhūva ||" iti vyatyastadharmibimbapratibimbakopamātivyāptiḥ | atra hi putraḥ pitā ceti ubhāvupamānopameyabhūtau dharmiṇau | tayostāveva pitṛmattvaṃ puttratvamiti sādhāraṇadharmakoṭipraviṣaṭatayopāttau | tayośca bimbapratibimbabhāvarūpasādhāraṇyāpādako dharme matubinipratyayopāttaṃ praśastyam | praśaṃsāyāṃ jhatra tau pratyayau | puttrī pitṛmānit sambandhamātrasyāvaktavyatvāt | evañca putrasya pituśca praśastapitṛmattvaṃ, praśastaputtravattvañca bimbapratibimbakarambitena vastuprativastubhāvena sādāraṇadharma iti labhyate | tayośca pitāputrayoḥ prāśastaputtravatvañca bimbapratibimbakarambitena samārādhanatatpareṇeti ca viśeṣaṇe | tataśca dharmyupamāyāṃ yaḥ pitā putrasyopamānaṃ sa eva tasya tadupapādake bimbapratibimbanirdeśe upameya iti lakṣaṇasya vartanaṃ tāvatspaṣṭam | na ceyamupameyopamā | putrapitrordharmiṇorupamāyāṃ praśastapitṛmattvaṃ praśastaputravattvañca vastuprativastubhāvena bmbapratibimbabhāvakarambitena sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ | pitāputtrayostu dharmakoṭiniviṣṭayorvātsalyabhaktyatiśayakṛtaṃ prāśastyaṃ anugakasādhāraṇadharma iti pūrvedāharaṇasārūpyāt | samuccayopamayā puttro'pi pitṛbhaktyā praśastaḥ, pitāpi puttravātsalyena praśasta ityarthalābhe'pi tṛtiyasabrajhacārivyavacchedālābhācca | na cātra ivaśabdadvayādiyuktaparyayadvayābhāvāt paryāyaviśeṣaṇe naivātivyāptinirāsaḥ syāditi vācyam | vācyakakṣayāṃ putrapitrorupamā, vyaṅgyakakṣāyāṃ pitāpittrayoriti paryāyadvayasattvāt | nahi paryāyadvayasyāpi vācyatvamatra vivakṣitam, yenevaśabdadvayayuktaparyāyadvayābhāvāt ativyāptirnirasyeta | tathā sati hi vyaṅgyopameyopamāsādhāraṇyaṃ na syādityuktam | na cātra dharmiṇorevopamā, dharmayestu upamānopameyasādhāraṇyārthamabheda eva pratīyate, nopameyate vācyam | 'nalinyā iva tanvaṅgyāstasyāḥ pajhamivā''nanam | mayā madhukareṇeva pāyaṃpāyamakṛpyata ||" ityādau bimbapratibimbabhāvāpannayostanvīnalinyādikayorupamāyā api darśanena dharmayoḥ sādṛśyena sādhāraṇīkasyāpi upamāprayojakatvāt | tasmāttatra ativyāptiśaṅkā durvārā | ato'nupapannamevedaṃ lakṣaṃṇaṃ lakṣyate | atra bramaḥ - anyonyenopamā bodhyā vyaktyā vṛttyantareṇa vā | ekadharmaśrayā yā syāt sopameyopamā matā || anyonyeneti viśeṣaṇāt na raśanopamāyām ativyāptiḥ | vyaktyā vṛttyantareṇa vā iti viśeṣaṇācca na ubhayaviśrāntasādṛśyopamāyām ativyātiḥ | parasparapratikṣepakavikalpārthana vākreṇa hi yā parasparapratiyogikatvaviśiṣṭopamā tadviṣayavṛttyantaranirapekṣavyaktibodhyā tadviṣayavyāktinirapekṣavṛttyantarabodhyā vā bhavati sopameyopameti | tataścobhayaviśrāntasādṛśyopamāyām anyonyapratiyogikatvāṃśevyaktiḥ, sādṛlyarūpopamāṃśe vṛttyantaramiti tayoḥ karambitatvānnātivyāptiśaṅkā | sāmānyalakṣaṇasiddhyartaṃ ca vyaktivṛttyantarayonyapratikṣepakatvena kroḍīkṛtayorgrahaṇam | evaṃ hī `tayā gṛhītaṃ nu mṛgāṅganābhyaḥ' ityatra vṛttyantarānapekṣavyaktibodhyāyāṃ analaṅkārabhūtāyāṃ vyaktinirapekṣavṛttyantarabodhyāyāmalaṅkārabhūtāyāṃ copameyopamāyāṃ lakṣaṇamanagataṃ bhavati | yadyapi vyaṅgyāyāmumeyopamāyāṃ śabdasya sahakāritvena tadrataśakterapyapekṣitatvāt `khamiva jalaṃ jalamiva kham' ityādau vātyāyāmapi gamyasādhāraṇadharmāyāṃ tasyā dharmaṃśe vyakterapekṣitatvāt parasparanairapekṣyamasambhavi, tathāpyanyonyapratiyogikatvaviśiṣṭasādṛśyaviṣayavṛttyantaranipekṣakatvaṃ vyakteḥ, tādviṣayavyaktinirapekṣatvaṃ vṛttyantarasya ca astyeva | idameva ca vyaktipatānapekṣayā alaṅkārārūpāyā viśeṣalakṣaṇampi | tatra vyaktipadaparutyāge vṛttyantaramātrabodhyeti etadviśeṣaṇaṃ paryavasyati | tataścobhayaviśrāntasādṛśyopamāvyāvṛttiḥ | na ca tasyāmekasyaivopamānatvaṃ na tu dvayoriti anyonyapadenaiva vyāvṛttāvidaṃ vyartamiti vācyām | prākaraṇitāprākaraṇikayossādṛśyavarṇane'prākaraṇisyaiva upamānatvalābhe'pi ubhayorapi prākaraṇikatve vinigamanāviraheṇa parasparopamānatvapratīteḥ | ekadharmaśrayatvaviśeṣaṇāt `rajobhissyandanoddhūtaiḥ' iti parasparopamāyāṃ nātivyāptiḥ | uktaviśeṣaṇabalādeva `pitā samārādhanatatpareṇa' ityumāyāmapi nātivyāptiḥ | ubhayatrāpi upamayorbhinnadharmāśrayatvāt | ekadharmāśrayetyaseya cāyamarthaḥ | kasyacidanyenopamāyāṃ yo dharmarsādhāraṇo vartupradivastudhāvāpanno vā sa evānyasya tenopamāyāmapīti | na tvanugāmidharmāśrayetyarthaḥ bimbapratibimbabhāvagakbhavastupravastubhāvanirdeśe tadabhāvāditi dik | idantūpameyopamātvaprayojakaṃ lakṣaṇam | anugatānatiprasaktalakṣaṇantusadṛśalya tṛtīyasya vyavacchadoya yad dvayoḥ | anyonyenopameyatvaṃ sopameyopamā matā || iti draṣṭavyam | atrānyonyeneti viśeṣaṇaṃ `ahameva guruḥ sudāruṇānām' iti pratīpaviśeṣavyāvṛttyartam | athodāharaṇāni | tatra dharmasya (anugāmitayā) sādhāraṇye yathā - "khamiva jalaṃ jalamiva khaṃ haṃsaścandra iva candraḥ | kumudākārāstārāstārākārāṇi kumudāni ||" iyaṃ pratīyamānasādhāraṇadharmā | vācyasādhāraṇadharma yathā - `sugandhi nayanānandi' ityādi | yathā vā - "giririva gajarājo'yaṃ gajarāja iveccakairvibhāti giriḥ | nirjhara iva madadhārā madadhārevāsya nirjharaḥ stravati ||" atra upameyopamādvayasya parasparānugṛhītatvena vicchittiviśeṣo'dhikaḥ | vastuprativastubhāvo yatā - `sacchāyāmbhojavadanā' ityādi | idaṃ vastuprativastubhāvasya bimbapratibimbaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ udāharaṇaṃ tu - `tadvalgunā yugapadunmiṣitena' ityādi | tatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ pūrvektā bhedā unneyāḥ | ityupameyopamāprakaraṇam | athānanvayaḥ ekasyaivopamānopameyatve'nanvayo mataḥ | evakārabalādekasyāmeva upamitikriyāyāmiti gamyate | tenopameyopamāyāṃ raśanopamāyāñca nātivyāptiḥ | udāharaṇam - `gaganaṃ gaganākāraṃ sāgaraḥ sāgaropamaḥ' | ayaṃ pratīyamānadharmaḥ | nirdiṣṭadharme yathā - "na kevalaṃ bhāti nitāntakāntirnitambinī saiva nitambinīva | yāvadvilāsāyudhalāsyavāsāste tadvilāsā iva tadvilāsāḥ ||" nanu - "piturniyogādvanavāsamevaṃ nistīrya rāmaḥ pratipannarājyaḥ | dharmārthakāmeṣu samāṃ prapede yathā tathaivāvarajeṣu vṛttim ||" ityatraikasyaiva raghupamānatvamupameyatvañca na ca tatrānanvayaḥ | samuccayepamayā tasya dharmārthakāmeṣu anujeṣu ca samavṛttimātrasyaiva pratipādyatayā sadṛśāntaravyavacchede tātparyābhāvāt | tathā - `tyakṣyāmi vaidehasutāṃ purastātsadranemiṃ piturājñayeva' ityatrāpyasti svasyaivopamānatvamupameyatvañca | tatrā'pi nānanvayaḥ | "pitṛniyogātkṣitityage iva apavādātsītātyāge ca na pratiṣeddavyo'ha" mityetāvataiva tātparyeṇa sadṛśāntaravyavacchede tātparyābhāvāt | evam - "upādade tasya sahastraraśmistvaṣṭrā navaṃ nirmitamātapatram | sa taddukūlādavidūramaulirbabhau patadraṅga ivottamāṅge ||" ityādāvapyekasyaiva upamānopameyabhāvaḥ spaṣṭaḥ | na ca, eteṣu kkacit dharmādiṣu vṛtte'varajeṣu vṛtteśca upamānopameyabhāvaḥ | anyatra kṣitityāgasya sītātyāgasya ca, aparatra gaṅgāpatanasya dukūlasaṃnidhānasya ca| na tu kkacidapyepasyaiva dharmiṇa upamānopameyabhāvaḥ | viśiṣṭānvayino'pi viśeṣaṇasaṅkamaucityāt iti vātyam | yathā dharmarthakāmeṣu samavṛttiṃ prapede tathā avarajeṣu ityādiprakāreṇa ekasyaiva upamānopameyabhāve nibaddhe'pi tasya viśeṣaṇasaṅkāntikalpane `pāṇḍyo'yamaṃsārpitalambahāraḥ' ityādīnām api hāranirjharādīnām iva upamānopameyabhāvaḥ syāditi bimbapratibmbadāharaṇamātravilopaprasaṅgāt | `rāmarāvaṇayoryuddam' ityādau abhede'pi upamānopameyabhāvamabhyupagacchatāmālaṅkārikāṇāṃ viśeṣyabādhasya' apariharaṇīyatvācca | tasmādatra `saviśeṣaṇe hi' iti nyāyopanyāso vākyamīmāṃsakānāṃ śobhate nālaṅkārikamīmāṃsakānām | vākyamīmāṃsakā hi abhede upamānopameyabhāvanirdeśa eva nāstīti manyamānā `rāmarāvaṇayoryuddham' ityādāvadyatanasya pūrvedyustanaṃ yuddhamupamānam | etatkalpagaganasya kalpāntaragaganamupamānamityādi kalpayanti | tasmādālaṅkārikamate eteṣvekasyaiva upamānopameyabhāva iti lakṣaṇamativyāptamiti cet - atra brūmaḥ - svasya svenopamā yā syādanugāmyekadharmikā | anvarthanāmadheyo'yamananvaya itīritaḥ || svasya sveneti viśeṣaṇādupameyopamāyāṃ raśanopamāyāñca nātivyāptiḥ | anugāmyekadharmiketi viśeṣaṇādudāhṛtopamāviśeṣeṣu nātivyāptiḥ | yadyapi samāṃ vṛttiṃ prapede ityādyaṃśe anugāmidharmapraveśaḥ | tathāpyeko na bhavati | dharmatthakāmāvarajādibimbaprabhāvakarambitatvāt | ata eva ekagrahaṇamapyarthavat | anvartanāmadheya iti tu na lakṣaṇāntargatam | kintu svena svasyopamāpi anugāmyekadharmā cedeva ananvayo nānyathetyatra upapattimātraparam | dharmaikye hi svasya svenopamā nānvetīti ananvaya ityanvarthaṃ nāma bhavati | anvayyarthanibandhanavaśācca anupamatvadyotanaphalaparyantaṃ dhāvet | dharmabhede tu ekadharmāvacchinnena sve nai va dharmāntarāvacchinnasya svasyopamānvetīti na tatrānvartaṃ nāma, na vā ananvayyarthanibandhanādhīnānipamatvaphalalābhaḥ | idam ananvayatvaprayojakaṃ lakṣaṇam | lakṣaṇamātraṃ tu - `yatra tenaiva tenaiva tasya syāt' iti bhāmahaktamanusandheyam | `ubau yadi vyomni pṛthakpravāhau' ityatiśayoktiviśeṣe, anupamatvadyotanaphalakasāmyakaspanāt tatra ativyāptinisālāya tenaiva tasyeti viśeṣaṇam | ayamananvayo vyaṅgyo'pyasti | yathā - "adya yā mama govinda jātā tvayi gṛhāgate | kālenaiṣā bhavatprītistavaivāgamanātpunaḥ ||" atra gṛhāgataṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prati viduravākye iyaṃ tvadāgamanaprabhavā prītirbahukālavyavahitena punarapi tvadāgamanenaiva bhavet, nānyenetyuktibhaṅgyā tvadāgamanaprabhavapriteḥ saiva sadṛśī na tvitaraprabhaveti vyajyate | etādṛśavyāvṛttyarthamananvayālaṅkāralakṣaṇe'vyaṅgyatvaśeṣaṇaṃ pūrvavaddraṣṭavyam | ityananvayaprakaraṇam atha smaraṇālaṅkāraḥ smṛtissādṛśyamūlā yā vastvantarasamāśrayā | smaraṇālaṅkṛtissā syādavyaṅgyatvaśeṣitā || yathā - "api turagasamīpādutpatantaṃ mayūraṃ na sa rucirakalāpaṃ bāṇalakṣyīcakāra | sapadi gatamanaskaścatramālyānukīrṇe rativigalitabandhe keśapāśe priyāyāḥ ||" yathā vā - "divyānāmapi kṛtavismayāma purastādambhastaḥ sphuradaravindacāruhastām | udvīkṣya śriyamiva kāñciduttarantīmasmārṣījjalanidhimanthanasya śoriḥ ||" ekatra sadṛśadarśanāttatsadṛśadharmikā smṛtiḥ | itaratra madṛśadarśanāttatsadṛśalakṣmīsambanjhino jalanidhimanthanasya smṛtiḥ | ubhayatrāpi sādṛśyamūlakavastvantarasmṛtitvamaviśiṣṭam | ata eva sadṛśāsadṛśasādhāsaṇyārthatayā lakṣaṇe vastvantaragrahaṇamartavat | "saumitre, nanu sevyatāṃ tarutalaṃ caṇaḍāśurujjṛmbhate caṇḍāṃśornaśi kā kathā raghupate candro'yamunmīlati | vatsaitadviditaṃ kathaṃ nu bhavatā dhatte kuraṅgaṃ yataḥ kkāsi preyasi hā kuraṅganayane candrānane, jānaki ||" atra śrutakuraṅgasambandhinastannayanasya smaraṇāt tatsadṛsasītānasmṛtiḥ tatsambandhisītāsmṛtiśceti | kintvaṣā vyaṅamagyā; alaṅkāryabhūtā ca | tadvyāvṛttyarthamavyaṅgyatvaviśeṣaṇam | "atyuccāḥ paritaḥ sphuranti girayaḥ sphārāstatāmabhedhayastanetānapi bibhratī kimapi na klāntā'si tubhyaṃ namaḥ | āścaryeṇa muhurmuhaḥ stumiti prastaumi yāvadbhuvastāvadbibhradimāṃ smṛtastava bhuto, vācastato mudritāḥ ||" stūyamānabhūsambandhino bhūbhṛdbhujasya smṛtirna sādṛśyamūleti nātra smaraṇālaṅkāraḥ | kintu smṛteḥ sañcāribhāvasya bhūbhṛdviṣayaratibhāvāṅgatvāt preyo'laṅkāraḥ | "sa tatheti pratijñāya visṛjya katamapyumām | ṛṣīñjyotirmayānsapta saramāra smaraśāsanaḥ ||" atra cintāmūlā smṛtiḥ | vicchittiviśeṣābhāvānna kaścidalaṅkāraḥ | etadubhayavyāvṛttyarthaṃ sādṛśyamūleti viśeṣaṇam | evamete bhedābhedasādhāraṇasādharmyamūlā alaṅkārāḥ pradarśitāḥ | iti smaraṇālaṅkāraprakaraṇam atha rūpakam athābhedapradhāneṣu prathamaṃ rūpakaṃ nirūpyate - āropaviṣayasya syāt atirohitarūpiṇaḥ | upañjakamāropyamāṇaṃ tadrūpakaṃ matam || atra āropaviṣayasya ityanena utprekṣātiśayoktyorvyāvṛttiḥ, tatra mukhāderopavaṣayatvābhāvāt | atirohitarūpiṇa ityanena sasandehabhrāntimadapahnutīnāṃ vyāvṛttiḥ | teṣu sandehabhrāntyapahnavairviṣayasya tirodhānāt | uparañjakamityanena samāsoktipariṇāmavyāvṛttiḥ, tayerhi noparañjakatvaṃ viṣaye svatādrūpyāpādakatvalakṣaṇam, samāsoktau vyavahāramātrasamāropeṇa tādrūpyapratīterevābhāvāt | paruṇāmee āropyamāṇasyaiva viṣayatādrūpyāpattyā viṣayasyāropyamāṇatādrūpyāpattyabhāvāt ityāhuḥ | atredaṃ vicāryate | āropādhyavasāyayoḥ kīdṛśaṃ bhedamabhisandhāya āropaviṣayasyetyanena utprekṣāvyāvṛttiruccate? yadi viṣayaviśayiṇorabhihitayorabhedapratipattirāropaḥ, viṣayanigaraṇena viṣayiṇaḥ tadabhedapratipattiradhyavasāya iti bhedamabhisandhāya; tadotprekṣā āropamūlaiva syāt | tatra `nūnaṃ mukhaṃ candraḥ' iti viṣayasya mukhasyāpyabhidhānena tannigaraṇābhāvāt | tataśca tatrātivyāptiranivāritaiva syāt | athavā, tādrūpyapratipattirāropaḥ, tadabhedapratipattiradhyavasāya iti tayorbhedaḥ | `mukhaṃ candraḥ' ityādirūpake candrasya yadrūpaṃ candratvaṃ tena rūpavattāmātraṃ mukhasya pratīyate, na tu prasiddhacandrābhedaḥ; mukhaviṣayāyāṃ `candraḥ' ityādyatiśayoktau tu tadabheda eva pratīyata iti cet na | vaiparītyasyāpi ktuṃ śākyatvāt | na ca nācyam - "indorapi mṛgākṣīṇāṃ mukhenduratiricyate | nirjaraiḥ pīyamāno'pi yaḥ kadācinna hīyate ||" iti mukhacandrasya prasiddhacandrādvyatirekavarṇanaṃ, tadabhedapratipattau rūpake tādrūpyatipattireveti | tathā sati hi - "sudhābaddhagrāsairūpavanacakoraikanusṛtāṃ kirañjyotsnāmacchāṃ lavaliphalapākapraṇayinīm upaprātārāgraṃ prahiṇu nayane takṛya manāk anākāśe ko'yaṃ galitahariṇaśśītakiraṇaḥ ||" `aparaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ' ityādyatiśayoktau, `apara iva pākaśāsanaḥ' ityādyutprekṣāyāṃ ca rūpakavadeva prasiddhacandrādyabhedaprattyabhāvena tādrūpyapratipattireva syāditi tayorlakṣaṇasyātivyāptiranenānivāritā syāt | atha tatra prasiddhacandrādyabhedapratipattyabhāve'pi upāttakalpitāpākacandrādyabhedapratipattiḥ sambhavatīti cet rūpakepyevaṃ vaktuṃ śakyamityasambhava eva lakṣaṇasya syāt | kiñca atirohitarūpiṇa ityanena sasandehabhrāntimatorativyāptivāraṇe'pi nā'pahnave'tivyāptivāraṇam | `nedaṃ mukhaṃ, kintu candraḥ' ityatra mukhe mukhatvābāvākopasya candratvāropasya ca āhāryatvena viṣayatirodhāyakatvābhāvāt | āhāryāropasyāpi tirodhāyakatve rūpake'pi lakṣaṇasya asambhavaḥ syāt | utprekṣāyā apyāhāryasambhāvanārūpāyā atirohitarūpiṇa ityanenaiva vyāvṛttisddhāvāropaviṣayasyeti viśeṣaṇasya vaiyarthyañca syāt | atirohtarūpiṇa ityanenaiva vyāvṛttisiddhāvāropaviṣayasyeti viśeṣaṇasya nigīrṇasya tirohitatvena tasyā
