pariṇame'sambhavaḥ | yatrāropyamāṇaṃ kiñjitkāryopayogitvena nibadhyamānaṃ svatastasya tadupayogitvāsambhavāt prakṛtātmātāpattimapekṣate tatraiva pariṇāmāṅgīkārāt | yathā `prasannena dṛgabjena vīkṣate madirekṣaṇā' iti | atra hi abjasya vikṣaṇopayogitvaṃma nibadhyate; mayūravyaṃsakādisamāsena uttarapadārthaprādhānyāt | na ca, upamitisamāsāśrayaṇena pūrvapadārthaprādhānyāt dṛśa eva tadupayogitvaṃ nibadhyata ityastu it vācyam | prasanneneti sāmānyadharmaprayogāt, `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge' iti tadaprayoga eva upamitisamāsānuśāsanāt | abjasya ca vīkṣaṇopayegitvaṃ na svātmānā sambhavati |ataḥ prakṛtadṛgātmatāpatyapekṣaṇāt pariṇāmālaṅkāraḥ | nanvevaṃ `yām manovākkāyaiḥ' ityādiṣvapi taraṇādiśabdalakṣitajanmanāśādyupayogitvaṃ taraṇḍādīnāmaṅghrigādyātmanaiveti teṣvapi pariṇāmaprasaṅgaḥ | maivam | yasya kāryavātipadaprathamapratītatanmukhyārthanirvartanasāmarthyaṃ tadātmanopayogitvasya grājhatvāt | taraṇḍādipadamukhyārthanirvartanasāmarthyasya ca taraṇḍādiṣveva vyavasthitatvāt | tasmādudāhṛteṣura rūpakameva | teṣu ca nātivyāptiriti | nanvevamuktātivyāptiparihāre'pi - "so'pūrvo rasanāviparyayavidhistatkarṇayoścāpalaṃ dṛṣṭissā madavismṛtasvaparadikkiṃ bhūyasoktena vā | sarvaṃ vismṛtavānasi bhramara he yadvāraṇo'dyāpyasāvantaśśūnyakaro'pi sevyat iti bhrātaḥ ka eṣa grahaḥ ||" ityaprastutapraśaṃsāyām ativyāptiḥ tatrāprakṛtavāraṇarasanāviparyayādīnāṃ prakṛtaduprabhurasanāviparyayādyātmatayaiva tatsevātyāgalakṣaṇakāryopayogitvāt | nahi yathā vāraṇasya karṇacāpalaṃ bhramarasya tatsevātyage hetuḥ; tathā tasya rasanāviparyayaḥ śūnyakaratā ca tatra hetuḥ madaḥ pratyuta tatsevāyāmeva heturiti tasya tattyāgahetutvaṃ dūrāpāstam | evamapi yatteṣāṃ tyāgahetutvaṃ nibadhyate tadvāraṇādīnāmaprakṛtānāṃ duṣprabhuprabhṛtitādātmyāpattyaiva nirvājhamiti | `suhṛdālāpenaiva' ityatrodāhṛtapariṇāme'vyāptiśca tadavasthā | tatra candravanmakhusyāpyaprakṛtatvena prakṛtātmanā upayogitvābhāvāt | ucyate | prakṛtātmānetyatra prakṛtaśabdo viṣayamātrapara iti nodāhṛtaparuṇāmāvyāptiḥ | upayogitvañja prakṛtā'gamakakāryaṃ prati vivakṣitam| aprastutapraśaṃsodāharaṇe prakṛtaduṣprabhusevātyāgagamakavāraṇasevātyāgaṃ prati upayogitvamiti na tatrātivyāptiḥ | evañja- "āropyamāṇamāropaviṣayātmātayā sthitam | prakṛtasyopayogitve pariṇāma udāhṛtaḥ ||" iti vidyānāthalakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtasyeti padasya prakṛtā'gamasyeti vyākhyānena pariṣkaraṇīyam | ayañja pariṇāmo dvividhaḥ - sāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyadhikaraṇyābhyām | sāmānādhikaraṇyena yathā - "tīrtvā bhūteśamaulistrajamamaradhunīmātmanā'sau tṛtīyastasmai saumitrimaitrīmayamupakṛtavānātaraṃ nāvikāya | vyāmagrājhastanībhiśśabarayuvatibhiḥ kautukodañjadakṣaṃ kṛcchrādanvīyamānaḥ kṣaṇamacalamatho citrakūṭaṃ pratasthe ||" atrāropyamāṇa ātaro viṣayabūtasaumitrimaitrīrūpatāpattyā guhopakāralakṣaṇakāryopayogīti parīṇāmaḥ | ubhayorvibhaktyaikyāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam | vaiyadhikaraṇyena yathā - "punnāgajālakairhārān kāñjīḥ kesaradāmabhiḥ | karṇikāḥ karṇitāraiśca vihartuṃ vidadhurvane ||" atrāropyamāṇā hārādayo viṣayabhūtapunnāgajālakādirūpatayaiva vanakrīḍopayogina iti pariṇāmaḥ | bibhaktibhedādvaiyadhikaraṇyam | idañca vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ rūpake'pi sambhavati | yathā - "tārānāyakaśekharāya jagadādhārāya dhārādharacchāyādhārakakandharāya giridāsaṅgaikaśṛṅgāriṇe | nadyāśekhariṇe dṛśā tilakine nārāyaṇenāstrim̐ṇe nāgaiḥ kaṅkaṇine nagena gṛhiṇe nāthāya seyaṃ natiḥ ||" atra nadīdṛśorviṣayayorvibhaktiḥ āropyamāṇayoḥ śekharatilakayornāsti | yathā vā - "dvirbhāvaḥ puṣpaketorvibudhaviṭapināṃ paunaruktyaṃ vikalpaścintāratnasya vīpsā tapanatanubhuvo vāsavasya dviruktiḥ | dvaitaṃ devasya daityādhipamathanakalākelikāralya kurvannānandaṃ kovidānāṃ jagati vijayate śrīnṛsiṃhakṣitīndraḥ ||" atra viṣayasya rājño viṣayiṇāṃ puṣpaketuprabhṛtīvāñja vibhāktibhedaḥ | atha parimāmasya vyaṅgyatāyāṃ kimudāharaṇam? "narasiṃha, dharānātha, ke vayaṃ tava varṇane | api rājānamākramya yaśo yasya vijṛmbhate ||" iti vidyādhareṇodāhṛtam | atra rājapadena candre viṣaye nirdiṣṭe tatra āropyamāṇasya nṛpasya ākramaṇarūpakāryopayoginaḥ pratīteḥ pariṇāmo vyajyata iti, tadayuktam | atra jhāropyamāṇasya nṛpasya nṛṣayātmanā pariṇatyapekṣāyāmeva pariṇāmo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ | yadāha - "taṃ pariṇāmaṃ vibudhāḥ kathayantyāropaviṣayatayā | pariṇamati yatra viṣayī prasitutakāryopayogāya ||" vidyānāthena tūdāhṛtam - "eṣa śāmyati vastāpo rājapādaniṣevayā | kaṇṭakadrumamūleṣu vāsastaṃ śamayetkatham ||" iti | nāstyatra prāguktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ | nṛpacaraṇasevāyāṃ prastutāyāmāropyamāṇāyāḥ candrakiraṇasevāyāḥ nṛpacaraṇasevātmatayaiva tāpāśāntihetutvāt | tāpaśabdasya sauratāpasādhāraṇye'pi prakṛte rājyabhraṃśajanitatāpasyaiva vivikṣitatvāt tannivartane candrakiraṇasevāyāḥ svato'sāmarthyat | tathāpi prācīnānāṃ mate evaidudāharaṇam | te hi `rājapadaniṣevayā' ityasya prakaraṇaniyantritatvāt aprakṛtāyāṃ candrakiraṇasevāyāṃ śabdaśaktimūlo vyajājanāvyāpāra iti manyante | vastutastvaprakṛte'pyarthe śabdānāmabhidhaiva vyāpāra itiyasmābhiḥ śleṣaprakaraṇe vyavasthāpayiṣyamāṇatvāt, ihāpi `rājapādaniṣevayā' ityatra candrakiraṇasevāyāmapyābhidhaiva vyāpāraḥ | ataḥ prastutāprastutadvayatādrūpyapratīteḥ śleṣabhittikātiśayoktyādiṣaaviva saṃsargavidhayaiva lābhāt, tasya prakṛtakāryopayogitāyāstṛtīyayā lābhācca na kkāpi vyañjanāvyāpārāpekṣeti nedaṃ pariṇāmadhvanerudāharaṇam | idañca dūṣaṇaṃ pūrvodāharaṇe'pi tusyam | idantūdābaraṇam - "cirādviṣahase tāpaṃ citta, cintāṃ parutyaja | nanvasti śītalaḥ śaureḥ pādābjanakhacandramāḥ ||" atra ciratāpārtaṃ prati haripādābjanakhacandrasadbhāvapradarśanena tameva niṣevasva, tanniṣevaṇādayaṃ tāpaḥ śāntimeṣyatīti pariṇāmo vyajyate | evaṃ rūpakarailakṣaṇye pariṇāmo nirūpitaḥ | tatra rūpake prakṛtamaprakṛtarūpāpannaṃ bhavati, pariṇāme tvaprakṛtaṃ prakṛtarūpāpannaṃ bhavatīti vailakṣaṇye sthite yattadupajīvya cakravartinā'nyathaiva tayorvailakṣaṇyaṃ varṇitam | mukhacandreṇa tāpaśśāmyati iti paruṇāme tu mukhamanācchāditasvarūpameva bhavati | candrasya mukhātmanaiva virahatāpaśāntihetutvāditi | uktañca - "viṣayyākāramāropya viṣayasthaganaṃ yadā | rūpakatvaṃ tadā tatra rañjanena samanvayaḥ | yadā tu viṣayo rūpāt svasmādapracyuto bhavet | upayuṅkte parākāraḥ pariṇāmastadā mataḥ ||" iti | atredaṃ vicāraṇīyam | ripake viṣayasya sthaganaṃ na tāvāttirohitarūvatvām, rajatabhrameṇa śuktisvarūpalyeva, āhāryāropeṇa viṣayasya tirodhānāsambhavat | śārīrake ca `ya evāsau tapati tamudrīthamupāsīta' ityatrodgīthasya ādityadṛṣṭiviṣayatvaṅgīkāre rajaradṛṣṭiviṣayaśuktisvarūpamiva udgīthakriyāsvarūpaṃ tirodhīyetetyāśaṅkya āhāryadṛśṭeratīrodhāyakatvasya uktatvāt | nāpi viṣyyupasarjanatvam | pariṇāme'pi tulyatvāt | ubhayatrāpyuttarapadārthapradhānasya mayūravyaṃsakādisāmāsasyāviśeṣāt | ata eva viṣayiviśeṣitatvaṃ sthaganamityapi nirastam | viṣayiṇo viśeṣyatvāt | tasmāt sthaganāsthanavailakṣaṇyaco nirālambanamiti viṣayātmanopayogenaiva pariṇāmasya rūpakādvailakṣaṇyaṃ samarthanīyamityalaṃ vistareṇa | iti pariṇāmaprakaraṇam atha sasandehaḥ "sāmyādaprakṛtārthasya yā dhīranavadhāraṇā | prakṛtārthāśrayā tajjñaiḥ sasandehaḥ sa iṣyate ||" trividhaścāyaṃ sandehaḥ - śuddho niścayagarbhi niścayāntaśca | krameṇa yathā - "ānīya dviṣatāṃ dhanāni vipine rājanyacūḍāmaṇe teṣvāsokya vinirmalaṃ himaśilākhaṇḍaṃ karaṇḍaṃ punaḥ . kiṃ vādyaṃ kimu peṣaṇaṃ kimu dhanaṃ kiṃ kṣepaṇīyāyidhaṃ kiṃ vā daivatamityaniścitadhiyo mandāḥ pulindā janāḥ ||" "ayaṃ mārtaṇḍaḥ kiṃ sa khalu turagaiḥ saptabhiritaḥ kṛśānuḥ kiṃ sarvāḥ prasarati diśo naiṣa niyatam | kṛtāntaḥ kiṃ sākṣānmahiṣavahano'sāviti ciraṃ samālokyā''jau tvāṃ vidadhati vikalpānpratibhaṭāḥ ||" "kiṃ tāvatsarasi sarojametadārāt āhosvinmukhamavabhāsate taruṇyāḥ | saṃśayya kṣaṇamiti niśaacikāya kaścibdibbokairvakasahavāsināṃ parokṣaiḥ ||" iti vadanti | atredaṃ vicāraṇīyam | sāmyāditi, kimannāddhetorvasatītivatphalatvena hetutvatavavakṣayā pañcamī, uta svato hetutvavivakṣayā | ādye'prakṛtasāmyābhivyaktiphalakatvamarthaḥ syāt | tatathā sati `ānīya dviṣatāṃ' ityudāharaṇe'vyāptiḥ | na hi tatra himakaraṇḍasya vādyādisādṛśyābhivyaktau kavisaṃrambhaḥ, kintu dviṣatpuramidṛśīmavasthāmāpannamiti rājñaḥ pratāpātiśayābhivyaktau | dvitīye sāmyādityanena kimekameva aprakṛtasāmyaṃ yāvatsandehakoṭyutthiti (koṭyupastiti) hetutvena vivakṣitam ? uta, anekaṃ vā ityaniyamaḥ | ādye `ayaṃ mārtaṇḍaḥ kim ?' itiyādyudāharame'vyāptiḥ | na hi tatra `kiṃ lakṣmīrurvaśī veyaṃ rambhā vā menakātha vā' ityātra lakṣmītvādivikalpeṣu atiśayitasaundaryasāmyavadekameva sāmyamiha mārtaṇḍatvāvikalpe, kṣaṇena sakalasaṃhartṛtvasāmyaṃ kṛtāntatvavikalpe ca hatuḥ | dvitīye `iha namaya śiraḥ kaliṅgavadvā samaramukhe karahāṭavaddhanurvā' iti vikalpālaṅkāre'tivyāptiḥ || atra digvijayapravṛttena balavatā rājñā samare pramare yathā kaliṅganṛpatiḥ - "samākrānto balavatā kāṅkṣannabhraṃśinīṃ śriyam | śrayeta vaitasī vṛttiṃ na bhaujaṅgī kadācana ||" iti nītimanusṛtya asandigdhanijarājyalakṣmībhraṃśaparīhārakāmaḥ śiro namitavāt, tathā vā śiro namaya, yathā karahāṭamṛpatiḥ `jayena labhyate lakṣmīrmaraṇena surāṅganā' iti nītimanusṛtya yuddhakāmo dhanurnamitavān tathā vā dhanurnamaya iti samayocitāptopadeśe tattadrājacaritadṛṣṭāntaprāpitānavasthitārthadhīsattvāt | na ca tatra śloke tādṛgdhīnibandhanaṃ nāstīti nātivyāptiriti vācyam | tannibandhanasyā'pi lakṣaṇāntargatvavivakṣāyam - "jīvanagrahaṇe namrā gṛhītvā nunarūnnatāḥ | kiṃ kaniṣṭhāḥ kimu jyeṣṭhā ghaṭīyantrasya durjhanāḥ ||" ityādiṣu sandehaviṣayanibandhanagamyasasandehālaṅkāreṣu ativyāptiprasaṅgāt | atprekṣāyāṃ vācyagamyabhedavadihāpi dvividhodāharaṇadarśanena vācyāgamyabhedena dvaividhyasya aṅgīkartavyatvāt | api ca, anavadhāraṇeti kimucyate ? aniścayātmakatvamiti cet, thathā sati `bālenduvakrāṇyavikāsabhāvāt' ityādāvudāhariṣyamāṇāyām aprakṛtasāmyanimittatattādātmyasambhāvanārūpāyāmutprekṣāyāmativyāptiḥ virodhena parasparapratikṣapakatayā nibaddhānekakoṭyavagāhitvaṃ vivākṣitamiti cet tathā'pi `aṅakaṃ ke'pi śaśaṅkire' ityādāvudābariṣyamāṇāyāmapahnutāvativyāptiḥ | sandehavikalpayorvākārādineva tatrā'pi tattanmatatvopanyāsena parasparapratiṣedhasiddheḥ | "asyāssargavidhau prajāpatirabhūccandro nu kāntipradaḥ śṛṅgāraikarasaḥ svayaṃ nu madano, māso nu puṣpākaraḥ | vedābhyāsajaḍhaḥ kathaṃ sa viṣayavyāvṛttakautūhalo nirmātuṃ prabhavenmanoharamidaṃ rūpaṃ purāṇo muniḥ ||" iti sasandehodāharaṇe cāvyāptiḥ tatra candrādīnāṃ sandehadharmiṇāmeva anekatvam | prakārastu sarvatra varṇanīyavanitāsraṣṭṛtvamekameveti anekakoṭikatvābhāvāt | na ca, sāmyanimittatvābhāvāt tatra sasandehaḥ | `ito gatā sā kka gatā gṛhaṃ gatā me hṛdayaṃ gatā vā' ityatreva sandeho na saṅaagājha iti vācyam | varṇanīyanāyikāyāḥ kāntyā candrasāmyaṃ saurabhasaukumāryābhyāṃ puṣpasāmyaṃ ca nimittīkṛtya kimasyāṃ kāntinidhānabhūtaścandraḥ svakāntisampadā straṣṭā, tu puṣpamāsaḥ svakīyapuṣpasampadeti sandehanibhandhanāt `śṛṅaagaraikarasaḥ svayaṃ nu madanaḥ' ityaṃśasya śṛṅgaravibhramabhāhulyamātrapar‌yavasāyitvana kiñcitsāmya nimittatvābhāve'pi candravasantadharmikāṃśayoḥ tannimittatvānivāramāt | evañca prakṛtārthāśryetyetadapi ayuktam | udāhṛtasandehasya varṇanīyanāyikānāśrayatvena avyāpteriti cet | atra brūmaḥ - buddhissarvātmānānyonyakṣepinānārthasaṃśrayā | sādṛśyamūlā vārthaspṛk sandehālaṅkṛtirmatā || yadyāpyanyonyapratikṣepakavirūddhanānārthāvalambanatvaṃ vikalpasyāpyasti, tathāpi tadarthānāṃ sarvātmanā parasparapratikṣepakatvaṃ nāsti, kintu pakṣe tatprāptimanirūdhya svaprāptipakṣe eva svaparīpanthiprāptipratikṣepakatvāt | nahi `vrīhibhiryavairvā yaṣṭavyam' iti vikalpoddeśe vrihayo yavān, yavāśca vrīhin sarvātmanā yāgāt pratikṣipanti | tathā sati śāstrasyāsya anirṇāyakatvena ananuṣṭhāpakatvena cāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt | kintu svasvānuṣṭhānapakṣe eva | ata eva `vrīhibhiryavairvā yaṣṭavyam' iti sandehena pṛṣṭavantaṃ prati `vrihibhiryavairvā yaṣṭavyam' iti praśnasamākārameva vākyaṃ nirṇāyakaṃ praśnamūlasandehanivartakamanuṣṭhāpakañca dṛśyate | praśnavākye vākāraḥ sarvātmanā pakṣāntarapratikṣepārthaḥ | uttaravākye pakṣe tatpratikṣepārtha iti viśeṣasadbhavāt | evaṃ vikalpālaṅkārodāharaṇe'pi dvividhasyā'pi nītiśāstrasya prāmāṇyāttadupadiṣ‌ṭaphalecchānusāreṇa ubhayamapi pakṣe'nuṣṭhātuṃ yuktamiti śirodhanurnamanayerna sarvātmanā parasparapratikṣepakatvamiti vikalpālaṅkāre nātivyāptiḥ | apahnavodāharaṇe sarvātmanā parasparapratikṣepasattve'pi vākārārthasparśābhāvāt nātivyāptiḥ | tatra hi kecit, anye iti matāntaratvopanyāsena pakṣāṇāṃ parasparapratikṣepalābhaḥ | na tu vākārārthasparso'sti | utprekṣāyāmapi nātivyāptiḥ | tatra jhutkaṭaikatarakoṭike saṃśaye koṭyoḥ samabalatvābhāvena vākārārthasparsābhāvāt | `asyāḥ sargavidhau' ityudāhaṇe parasparapratikṣepakanānākoṭisamāśrayatvabhāve'pi tathābhūtanānādharmirūpārthasamāśrayatvasattvānnāvyaptiriti sarvamavadātam | sandehālaṅkaradhvaniryathā asmatkulakūṭasthavakṣaḥsthalācāryakṛte varadarājavasantotsave - "kāñcitkāñcanagaurāṅgīṃ vīkṣya sākṣādiva śriyam | varadaḥ saṃśayāpanno vakṣaḥsthalamavaikṣata ||" atra saṃśayasya śabdopāttatve'pi tāvanmātrasya analaṅkāratvāt, tadalaṅkāratāprayojakasya vakṣaḥsthale sthitaiva lakṣmīḥ uta tato'vatīrya puratastiṣṭhatītyevaṃ saṃśayākrasya vakṣaḥsthalamavaikṣatetyanena vyaṅgyatvātsandehālaṅaakāradhvaniratreti | yathā - "darpaṇe ca paribhogadarśinī pṛṣṭhataḥ pramayino niṣeduṣaḥ | vīkṣya bimbamanu bimbamātmanaḥ kāni kānyapi cakāra lajjayā ||" ityatra kānikānyapīti sāmānyato nirdiṣṭānubhāvaviśeṣapratītyarthalajjāśabdaprayoge'pi tasyāḥ svavibhāvānubhāvābhyāṃ rasānuguṇābhivyaktirūpo dhvaniḥ | yadyāpi `saṃśayāpannaḥ' ityanena lakṣmyāḥ puro dṛṣṭāyāśca madhye kasyā rūpamadhikamiti saṃśayāviṣṭa iti vā, nassamādhikarūpavattvābhimāninī lakṣmīḥ purata enāṃ dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ vartata iti saṃśayāpanna iti vā, iyañca vakṣasi kutra niveśanīyeti saṃśayāpanna iti vā bahavaḥ saṃśayākārāḥ vakṣaḥsthalamavaikṣatetyanena vyaṅgyāssambhavanti | tathāpi sarveṣāmapi sandehānāṃ sādṛśyamūlatvāt vyatirekamūlasandehasyāpyatra sambhave'pi kathañcitsādṛśyamūlatvāt sandehālaṅkāradhvanyudāharaṇatvamiti yuktameva | iti sasandehālaṅkāraprakaraṇam | atha bhrāntimān kavisammatasādṛśyādviṣaye pihitātmani | āropyamāṇānubhavo yatra sa bhrāntimānmataḥ || `pihitātmani' ityanena āropyamāṇānubhavasya svārasikaṃ kavipratibhayā kalpanaṃ vivakṣitam, tasyaiva viṣayapidhānasāmarthyāt | ato rūpakādau nātivyāptiḥ | udāharaṇam - "kapāle mārjāraḥ paya iti karan leḍhi śaśinaḥ tarucchidraprotān bisamiti karī saṅkalayati | ratānte talpasthān harati vanitāpyaṃśukamiti prabhāmattaścandro jagadidamaho vibhramayati ||" atra lehānādipravṛttiparyantokteḥ svārasika eva bhramaḥ kavipratibhayā candrikotkadyotanāya nibaddhaḥ | kkacidbhānteruttarottaraṃ pallavena camatkāraḥ - 'ballālakṣoṇipāla, tvadahitanagare sañcarantī kirātī kīrṇānyādāya ratnānyurutarakhadirāṅgaraśaṅkākulāṅgī | kṛtvā śrīkhaṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ tadupari mukulībhūtanetrā dhamantī śvāsā''modānudhāvanmadhukaranikaraimaśaṅkāṃ karoti ||" kkacidbhinnakartṛkottarottarabhrāntinibandhanena camatkāraḥ - "śiñjānairmañjarīti stanakasaśayigaṃ cumbitaṃ cañ‌carīkaiḥ tattrāsollālalolāḥ kisalayamanasā pāṇayaḥ kīradaṣṭāḥ | tallopāyālapantyaḥ pikaninadadhiyā tāḍitāḥ kākalokaiḥ itthaṃ colendrasiṃha, tvadarimṛgadṛśāṃ nāpyaraṇyaṃ śaraṇyam ||" kkacidanyonyaviṣayabhrāntinibandhanena yathā - "palāśamukulabhrāntyā śukatuṇḍe patatyaliḥ | so'pi jambūphalabhrāntyā tamaliṃ dhartumicchati ||" "visphūrtimatyāṃ kīrtau te vidhivaikuṇṭhaśaṅkarāḥ | āroḍhuṃ śayituṃ vastumāṅkṣanti mahīpate ||" ityatra bhrāntimadalaṅkāro vyaṅaagyaḥ | sādṛśyānyamūlau sandehavibhramau sasandehabhāntimadalaṅkāraprayojakau na bhavataḥ | yathā - "amuṣya dhīrasya jayāya sāhasī śarāsanajyāṃ viśikhaiḥ sanāthayan | nimajjayāmāsa yaśāṃsi saṃśaye smarastrilokīvījayārjitānyapi ||" "dāmodarakarāghātacūrṇitāśeṣavakṣasā | dṛṣṭaṃ cāṇūramallena śatacandraṃ nabhastalam ||" ādye durjayaviyodyegasāhasaprayuktaḥ kīrtibhraṃśasandehaḥ | dvitīye ghāḍhamarmaprahārakṛtacandravibhrama iti | iti bhrāntimatprakaraṇam atha ullekhālaṅkāraḥ nimittabhedādekaseya vartuno yadanekadhā || ullekhanamekena tamullekhaṃ pracakṣate || yatra nānāvidhadharmayogyekaṃ vastu tattaddharmayogarūpanimittabhedādanekena grahītrā anekadhollikhyate sa ullekhaḥ | "kīrtigaṅgāhimakṣmābhṛdojassūryodayācalaḥ | śatrusenābdhimanthādrirguṇaratnaugharohaṇaḥ ||" iti mālārūpake ekaseya rājño yaśasvitvādidharmayogarūgarūpanimittabhedāttuṣārādratvādyanekaprakāreṇa ullekhanamastīti tatrātivyāptinirāsāya anekenetyuktam | tatra grahītṛbhedanibandhanaṃ na bhavati anekadhollekhanamiti nātivyāptiḥ | "vidyāvikramasaundaryatapasāṃ nidhimāgatam | paśyanti vibudhāśsūrāḥ striyo vṛddhāśca kautukāt ||" "kīrtau visphūrtimatyāṃ te mṛṇālakṣīraśaṅkinaḥ | dvaye'pi nāgārtanvanti jihvāntollehanaṃ muhuḥ ||" iti bhrāntimadudāharaṇe ekasyā eva kīrteranekena kuñjarabhujaṅgarūpeṇa grahītrā mṛṇālakṣīrarūpatvādyanekaprakoreṇa ullehanamastīti tatrātivyāptinirāsāya nimittabhedādityuktam | tatra kīrtigataṃ dhāvalyamekamullekhadvaye'pi nimittam | yadyapi gajabhujaṅgānāṃ svasvapriyāhāralobharūpanimittabhedo'pyasti, tathāpi nimittabhedādityanena ekanimittaviraho vivakṣita iti tavdyāvṛttiḥ tasya saṅgrājhatvaṃ nimttabhedāditi svarūpakathanamātram | evamapi yadi - "kāntyā candraṃ viduḥ kecitsaurabheṇāmbhujaṃ pare vaktraṃ vayaṃ brūmastapasaikyaṃ gataṃ dvayam ||" ityapahnavodāharaṇaviṣe'tivyāptiḥ śaṅkyā | tadānīmanekadhollekhanaṃ niṣedhāspṛṣṭatvena viśeṣaṇīyam | tatrādyollekhanadvayaṃ paramatatvopanyāsasāmarthyadgamyamānaniṣedhamiti nātivyāptiḥ | dvividhaścāyamullekhaḥ; śuddho'laṅkārāntarasaṅkīrṇaśca | tatra śuddho yathā - "gajatrāteti vṛddhābhiḥ śrīkānta iti yauvataiḥ | yathāsthitaś‌ca bālābhiḥ dṛṣṭaśśaurissakautukam ||" atra yastathā bhītaṃ bhaktaṃ gajaṃ tvakayā trayate sma, so'yamādipūruṣa iti vṛddhābhissaṃsārādbhītyā tadabhayārthinībhiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ puraḥ praviśanama dṛṣṭaḥ | yastathā cañcalatvena prasiddhāyā lakṣamyā api kāmopacāravaidagdhyena nityavallabhasso'yaṃ divyayuveti yuvatībhiḥ sotkaṇṭhābhirdṛṣṭaḥ, bālābhirbālasvabhāvādyathāsthitarūpaveṣayukto dṛṣṭa iti sarvatra vastusatā nānārūpeṇa ullekhanādayaṃ śuddhaḥ | yathā vā harṣacarite śrīkaṇṭhajanapadavarṇane - "yastapovanamiti munibhiḥ, kāmāyatanamiti veśyābhiḥ, saṅgītasāleti lāsakaiḥ, yamanagaramiti śatrubhiḥ, cintāmaṇirityarthibhiḥ, gurukulamiti vidyārthibhiḥ, gandharvanagaramiti gāyakaiḥ, viśvakarmamandiramiti vijñānibhiḥ, lābhabhūmiriti vaidehakaiḥ, dhūrtasthānamiti vandibhiḥ, sādhusamāgama iti sadbhiḥ, vajrapañjaramiti śaraṇāgataiḥ, viṭagoṣṭhīti vidagdhaiḥ, sakṛtapariṇāma iti pathikaiḥ, asuravivaramiti śaraṇāgataiḥ, śākyāśrama iti śamibhiḥ apsaraḥpuramiti kāmibhiḥ, mahotsavasamāja iti cāraṇaiḥ, vasudhāreti ca viprairagṛjhata ||" atra tapovanādibhūyiṣṭhatvāt tapovanādyullekhaḥ saṅkīrṇaḥ tatra yadi yamanagaratvādīnāmuparañjakatāmātreṇānvayastadā rūpakasaṅkaraḥ | yadi tādrūpyānubhavagocaratayā tadā bhrāntimatsaṅkaraḥ | ayañcollekho varṇyaguṇotkarṣakhyāpanāya acetanakartṛko'pi nibadhyate | yathā tatraiva harṣavarṇane - "niḥsneha iti dhanaiḥ, anāśrayaṇīya iti doṣaiḥ, nigraharuciriti indriyaiḥ, durupasarpa iti kalinā, nīrasa iti vyasanaiḥ, bhīruriti ayaśayā, durgrahacittavṛttiriti cittabhuvā, strīpara iti sarasvatyā, ṣaṇḍa iti parakalatraiḥ, kāṣṭhāmuniriti yatibiḥ, dhūrta iti veśyābhiḥ, vinaya iti suhṛdbhiḥ, karmakara iti vipraiḥ, asahāya iti śatruyodhaiḥ, ekamapyanekadhā gṛjhamāṇam " iti | bhrāntimadalaṅkārādayo'pyevamacetanakartṛkā nibadhyante - "bhinneṣu ratnakiraṇaiḥ kiraṇeṣvihendoruccāvacairupagateṣu sahastrasaṅkhyām | doṣāpi nūnamahimāṃśurasau kileti vyākośakokanadatāṃ dadhate nalinyaḥ ||" ityādau | "madhulubhdhā madhukarāstṛṣitāśca cakorakāḥ | sugandhi tāntisampannamanudhāvanti te muśam ||" yatyatrollekhovyaṅgyaḥ | `vidyāvikramasaundarya' iti śloke vidyādīnāṃ svarūpāvalokanakautukamātre nimittatayā yadi na viśrāntiḥ, kintu vidvattādyullekhavadavalokavakautukanimittatāyāṃ raryavasānaṃ tadā tatrāpi ullekhanagatānekadhātvakṛtavicchittaviśeṣasya gamyatvādulleṅkāro gamyaḥ | "parivrāṭ kāmukaśunāmekasyāmeva yoṣiti | kuṇapaḥ kāminī bhakṣyamiti tistro vikalpanāḥ ||" ityatrāpyullekha iṣyata iti lakṣṇasya nātivyāptiḥ | athāpara ullekhaprakāraḥ - "grahītṛbhedābhāve'pi viṣayāśrayabhedataḥ | ekasyānekadhollekhamapyullekhaṃ pracakṣate ||" tatra viṣayabhedādanekadhollekhaḥ śuddhaḥ, saṅkīrṇaśca | śuddho yathā - "akṛśaṃ kuśaṃ vilagne cakṣuṣi vistṛtaṃ nitambe | adhare'ruṇamāvirastu citte karūṇāśālikapālibhāgadheyam ||" "gururvacasi, pṛthururasi, viśālo manasi, janakastapasi, sumitrastejasi, sumantro rahasi, budhaḥ sadasi, arjuno yaśasi, bhīṣmo dhanuṣi" ityādau śleṣasaṅkīrṇaḥ | "haṃsamayīva gatīṣu, parapuṣṭamayīvālāpe, cakravākamayīva patipremaṇi, prāvṛṇmayīva payodharonnatau, kamalamayīva kośasaṅkīrṇaśca | `yadhiṣṭhiraḥ satyavacasi' ityādau rūpakasaṅkīrṇaḥ | `yudhiṣṭhirasamassatyavacasi' ityādāvupamāsaṅkīrṇa ityādyunneyam | ādhikaraṇabhedenānedhollekho yathā - "vardhiṣṇorupari kṣaṇaṃ ravirabhūcchatraṃ balidhvaṃsino ratnaṃ mūrdhni lalāṭasīmni tilakaṃ karṇāntike kuṇḍalam | aṃse cakramuraḥsthale maṇivaro nābhau sarojāsano yasyāṅghrau kaṭakastrivikramagateḥ pāyādapāyātsa vaḥ ||" atra rūpakaṅkīrṇaḥ | bhagavallalāṭamadhyakarṇāntāditattadavayavābhimukhasthitagrahītṛbhedanimittollekhasaṅkīrṇaśca | ekasyaiva draṣṭurlalāṭamadhye karṇāntike ca ravidarśanāsambhavāt | `yasya vahnimayo hṛdayeṣu, jalamayo locanapuṭeṣu, mārutamayaḥ śvasiteṣu, kṣamāmayo'ṅgeṣu, ākāśamayaḥ śūnyatāsu, pañcamahābhūtamayo mūrta ivādṛśyata nihatapratisāmantāntaḥpureṣu pratāpaḥ |' atra vahnijalādiśabdagṛhītatāpabāṣpādirūpāṇāṃ pratāpakāryāṇāṃ pratāpasya ca abhedakathanaṃ hetvalaṅkāra iti tatsaṅkaraḥ | matāntare rūpakasaṅkaraḥ | "kastūrīrilakanti bhālaphalake dovyā mukhāmbhoruhe rolambanti tamālalolamukulottaṃsanti maulāvapi | yāḥ karṇe vikacotpalanti kucayorante ca kālāgurusthāsanti pradiśantu tāstava śivaṃ śrīkaṇṭhakaṇṭhatviṣaḥ ||" atropamāsaṅkīrṇaḥ | kecitu tattadadhikaraṇaucityāt kastūrītilakāditādātmyasambhāvanāyām upamārthe vihito'pi kkibutprekṣāyāṃ paryavasyatītyupamopakramotprekṣeyamityāhuḥ | tanmate utprekṣāsaṅkīrṇaḥ | evamalaṅkārāntarasaṅkaro'pyanneyaḥ | || iti ullekhaprakaraṇam || athāpahnutiḥ "prakṛtasya niṣedhena yadanyatvaprakalpanam | sāmyādapahnutirvākyabhedābhedavatī dvidhā ||" anyatvakalpanamātraṃ rūpake, viṣayaniṣedhamātraṃ `nāhaṃ dūtī varatanoraṅgatāpo'tibhāskaraḥ' ityākṣepe ubhayamapi sāmyaviśeṣaṇarahitam `na pañcaviśikhaḥ kāmaḥ kintvapañca(asaṃkhya)śilīmukhaḥ `ityatiśayoktau cātivyāptimiti (sāmya) viśiṣṭopādānam | na caivaṃ `na pajhaṃ mukhamevedam' iti tattvākhyānopamāyāṃ viṣaye pajhatvaniṣedhasya mukhatvaprakalpanasya ca sattvādativyāptiḥ, prakalpanapadasyāropaparatvāt | `niṣidhyā viṣayaṃ sāmyādanyāropaḥ' iti ktvpratyayena lakṣaṃṇaṃ noktam | vakṣyamāṇodāharaṇe āropapūrvakāpaṅnave'vyāptiprasaṅgāt | iyañca sākṣānniṣedhakanañādiprayoge, parapakṣatvādyupanyāsena, niṣedhasya arthādgamyatve ca vākyabhedena pravartate | viṣayāsatyatvapratipādakacchajhanibhakapaṭavyājādiśabdaprayoge viṣayāsatyatvaparyavasāyi rūpavapurnāmabhaḍgyādiśabdaprayoge ca tadabhedena | tatra vākyabhede'pahnavapūrvaka āropaḥ, āropapūrvako'pahnavaśceti dvaividhyam | krameṇodāharaṇāni - "avāptaḥ prāgambhyaṃ pariṇatarucaḥ śailatanayaṃ kalaṅko naivā'yaṃ vilasati śaśāṅkasya vapuṣi | amuṣyeyaṃ manye vigaladamṛtasyandiśiśire ratiśrāntā śete rajaniramaṇī gāḍhamurasī ||" yathā vā - "nedaṃ nabhomaṇḍalamamburāśirnemāśca tārā navaphenapuñjāḥ | nā'yaṃ śaśī kuṇḍalitaḥ phaṇīndro nā'yaṃ kalaṅkaḥ śayito murāriḥ || " pūrvatra niravayavāpahnutiḥ, atra sāvayaveti bhedaḥ | "aṅkaṃ ke'pi śaśaśāṅkire jalanidheḥ paṅkaṃ pare menire sāraṅgaṃ kati cicca sañjagarire bhūcchāyamaicchanpare | indau yaddalitendranīlaśakalaśyāmaṃ darīdṛśyate tatsāndraṃ niśi pītamandhatamasaṃ kukṣisthamācakṣmahe ||" ityātrāpyapahnavapūrvaka āropaḥ | apahnavasti parapakṣopanyāsādarthasiddhaḥ | "vikasadamaranārīnetranīlābjaṣaṇḍānyadhivasati sadā yaḥ saṃyamādhaḥkṛtāni | na tu rucirakalāpe vartate yo mayūre vitarati sa kumāro brajhacaryaśriyaṃ vaḥ ||" atra āropapūrvako'pahnavaḥ śābdaḥ | "manthānabhūmidharamūlaśilāsahastrasaṅghaṭṭanavraṇakiṇaḥ spharatīndumadhye | chāyāmṛgaśśaśaka ityatipāmaroktiḥ loke gatānugatikaḥ prathitaḥ pravādaḥ ||" atrāpyāropapūrvako'pahnavaḥ | sa ca pāmaravacanopanyāsādarthasiddhaḥ | etāni vākyabhedenodāharaṇāni | "bata! sakhi, kiyadetatpaśya vairaṃ smarasya priyavirahakṛśe'sminkāmiloke tathā hi | upavanasahakārodbhāsibhṛṅgacchalena prativiśikhamanenoṭṭaṅkitaṃ kālakūṭam ||" "amuṣmam̐llāvaṇyāmṛtasrasi nūnaṃ mṛgadṛśaḥ smaraḥ śarvapluṣṭaḥ pṛthujaghanabhāge nipatitaḥ | yadaṅgāṅgārāṇāṃ praśamapiśunā nābhikuhare śikhā dhūmasyeyaṃ pariṇamati romāvalivapuḥ ||" pūrvatra na sabhṛṅgāṇi sahakārāṇi, api cu sakālakūṭāḥ śarā ityasatyatvābhidhāyicchalaśabdavaśātpratīyate | uttaratra neyaṃ romāvaliḥ kintu dhūmaśikheti asatyatvaparyavasāyivapuśśabdabalātpratīyate | kecittu sādṛśyavyaktaye'pahnavavat, apahnavāya sādṛśyamapyapahnutyalaṅkāraṃ vadanti | yathāhuḥ - "sādṛśyavyaktaye yatrāpahnavo'sāvapahnutiḥ | apahnavāya sādṛśyaṃ yatrāstyeṣāpyapahnutiḥ ||" iti | adāharanti ca - "ākṛṣyādāvamandagrahamakacayaṃ vaktramāsajya vaktre kaṇṭhe lagnasvakaṇṭhaḥ prasarati kucayordattagāḍhāṅkasaṅgaḥ | baddhāsaktirnitambe patati caraṇayoryassa tādṛkpriyo me bāle, lajjā nirastā nahi nahi sarale colakaḥ kiṃ trapākṛt ||" atra vivakṣitaṃ priyamapahnutya colakatvāropaḥ | tadarthañca prāk priyacelasadṛśadharmepanyāsaḥ | atredamapahnutikathanaṃ vyājoktyalaṅkāraṃ pṛthaganaṅgīkurvatādbhaṭādīnāṃ matamanusṛtya | ye tu udbhinnavastunigūhanaṃ vyojoktiriti vyājoktyalaṅkāraṃ pṛthagicchanti teṣāmihāpi vyājoktireva; nāpahnitiriti rucakādayaḥ | daṇḍī tvapahnuteḥ sādharmyamūlatvaniyamamanādṛtya `kiñcidapahnitya kasyacitpradarśanamātramapahnutiḥ' iti lakṣayitvodājahāra - "apahnutirapahnutya kiñcidanyārthasūcanam | na pañceṣuḥ smarastasya sahastraṃ pattriṇāmiti ||" "candanaṃ candrikā mando gandhavāhaśca dakṣiṇaḥ | seyamagnimayī sṛṣyirmayi śītā parānprati ||" "amṛtasyantikiraṇaścandramā nāmato mataḥ | anyaevā'yamarthātmā viṣaniṣyandidīdhitiḥ ||" sādharmyamūlā tvapahnutiḥ upamāpahnutiriti tena vyāhṛtā | apahnutidhvaniryathā - "tvadālekhye kautūhalataralatanvīviracite vidhāyaikaṃ cakraṃ racayati suparṇāsutamapi | atha svidyatpāṇistvaritamapamṛjyaitadaparā kare pauṣpaṃ cāpaṃ makaramupariṣṭācca likhati ||" ityādau apahnutidhvanirudāhartavyaḥ atra hi cakrasuparṇāsutalekhanena nāyaṃ sādhāraṇaḥ puruṣaḥ kintu puṇḍarīkākṣa iti kayācivdyañjitam | anyayā tu tas‌yāpyetādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ na sambhavatītyāśayena nāyaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo'pi, kintu manmatha iti tadubhayamunmṛjya puṣpasāyakamamakaradhvajalekhanena vyañjitam | ityapahnutiprakaraṇam atha utprekṣālaṅkāraḥ yatrānyadharmasambandādanyatvenopatarkitam | prakṛtaṃ hi bhavetprājñāstāmutprekṣāṃ pracakṣate || yathā - "bālenduvakrāṇyavikāsabhāvādbabhuḥ palāśānyatilohitāni | sadāyo vasantena samāgatānāṃ nakhakṣatānīva vanasthalīnām ||" atra prakṛtāni palāśamukulāni aprakṛtanakhakṣatadharmavakratvalauhityasambandhānnakhakṣatatvena upatarkitāni | tarkaḥ saṃbhāvanāmātraṃ na tvavadhāraṇam | tadīyadharme hi tattādātmyambhāvanāmātraheturna vyāptipakṣadharmatāvalliṅgavadavadhāraṇahetuḥ | na cātra ivaśabdasya sādṛsyaparatvamiti upamāśaṅkā kāryā | upamāyā yatra kkacitsthitairapi nakhakṣataiḥ saha vaktuṃ śakyatayā, vasantanāyakasamāgatavanasthalīsambandhitvaviśeṣaṇakalpanānapekṣatvāt | palāśamukulānāṃ nakhakṣatatādātmyasambhāvanāyāmeva tatāvidhaviśeṣaṇasyopayuktatvāt | evamanyatrāpi yatra yatrāprakṛtatādātmyasambhāvanopayuktaviśeṣaṇakalpanā tatra sarvatrāpi utprekṣāvagantanyā | yathā - "uvāha yā tanulatā bhṛṅgālīromavallarīm | paścādvimuktāṃ vaimalyādbimbitāmiva veṇikām ||" upamā yatra kkacitstitayā'pi veṇikayā vaktuṃ śakyeti tatrānupayuktā vaimalyāt purobhagapratibimbitatvarūpaviśeṣaṇakalpanā tādātmyasambhāvanārthā | yatra tu sambhāvanopayiktaviśeṣaṇakalpanārahitamupamānaṃ nibadhyate tatra paramivaśabdaḥ sādṛśyapara ityupamālaṅkāraḥ | amumeva vibhāgamabhipretya cakravartinoktam - `yadyamupamānāṃśo lokataḥ siddimṛcchati' ityādi | daṇḍināpīvaśabdasya utprekṣāvyañjakatvamuktam | "manyo śaṅke prayo nūnamityevamādibhiḥ | utprekṣā vyajyate śabdo'pi tādṛśaḥ ||" iti | atrādiśabdena tarkayāmi, sambhāvayami, jāne, utprekṣe, syāt ityevamādīnāṃ saṅgrahaḥ | atra ca - "kastūrikāmṛgāṇāmaṇḍādgandhaguṇamakhilamādāya | yadi punarahaṃ vidhiḥ syāṃ khalajihvāyāṃ niveśayiṣyāmi ||" "yadyanuṣṇo bhavedvahniryadyaśītaṃ bhavejjalam | ṇanye dṛḍhavrato rāmastadā syādapyasatyavāk ||" ityādiṣvatuvyāptivāraṇāya dharmasambandādityuktam | teṣu hi `yadyarthoktau ca kalpanam' ityātiśayoktyalaṅkāraviṣayeṣu, `sambhāvanaṃ yadītthaṃ syādityūho'nyasye' iti sambhāvanālaṅkāsaraviṣayeṣu vā nirnimittameva tathā uparkaṇam | tathāpi - "sarvātiśāyi saundaryaṃ śaṅke satyavato mukham | yena sā mṛgaśābākṣī sāvitrī taramīkṛtā ||" ityādiṇvativyāptiḥ syāditi tadvāraṇāya anyadharmasambandhādityuktam | tatra sāvitrīhṛdayataralībhāvakārakatvādinā svadharmeṇaiva vitarkaṇamiti nātivyāptiḥ | "viraktasandhyākapiśaṃ purastādyato rajaḥ parthivamujjihīte | śaṅke hanamatkathitapravṛttiḥ pratyudgato māṃ bharatassasainyaḥ ||" ityatra ativyāptivāraṇāya anyatveneti viśeṣaṇam | tatra sasainye pratyudgantari anyatrāpi dṛṣṭasya agre rajogamanasya sambandena nimittena bharataḥ pratyudgatatvena vastusadrūpeṇaiva upatarkito na tvanyatveneti nātivyāptiḥ | "narasiṃha, mahīpāla, vijhastvāṃ makaradhvajam | mārgaṇāstava sañjātāḥ kathaṃ sumanaso'nyathā ||" ityatrātivyāptivāraṇāya upatarkitamityuktam | tatrānumānālaṅkāraviṣaye sumanomārgaṇatvena manmathatvavyāptaliṅgena rājñi manmathatvamavadhṛtaṃ na sambhāvanāmātram | "indurlipta ivāñjanena jaḍitā dṛṣṭirmṛgīṇāmiva pramlānārumimeva vidrumalatā śyāmeva hemaprabhā | kārkaśyaṃ kalayāmi kokilavadhūkaṇṭheṣviva prastutaṃ sītāyāḥ purataśca hanta śikhināṃ barhāḥ sagarhā iva ||" ityatrātivyāptivraṇāya prakṛtamityuktam | tatra niratiśayasaundaryasītvadanādisannidhānena tadvadanādyupamāneṣvapi nikarṣāpādakena indvādiṣvaprakṛteṣu añjanalepādinikarṣasambhāvanā kriyata iti nātivyāptiḥ | nanvevamapi - 'asmadvikramaceṣyitāni nikhilatrailokyahelājayaprahvībhūtasurāsurāṇi bhavato bhūmeḥ sutā śṛṇvatī | patyau dveṣakaṣāyitena manasā snigdhā mayi sthāsyati strīṇāṃ prema yaduttarottaraguṇagrāmaspṛhācañjalam ||" ityatra cāñcalyasahacaritatvena anyatra dṛṣṭartrītvasya sambandhena vastutaḥ patyekasthiracittā devī sītā cañcalatvenopatarkitā | na ca tatrotprekṣālaṅkāraḥ | rāvaṇakṛtatadīpsitasaṅghaṭanānukūlavicāramātrasya nibaddhatvena vicchittiviśeṣābhāvāt | na ca, anyadharmasambandhādityatra dharma upamāyāmiva sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādī viva kṣitaḥ, na tu sādhāraṇadharmamātram | tathā ca nooktātivyāptiḥ strītvādeścalyādisambhāvanāmātraprayojakatve'pi sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādisādhāraṇadharmatvābhāvena utprekṣālaṅaakāraprayojakatvābhāvāditi vācyam | tathā sati - "stanābhirāmastabakāṃ nūnaṃ sītetita vallarīm | sambhāvayanraghupatirdhāvati sma didṛkṣayā ||" ityatrātivyāpteravaraṇāt | na cā''hāryatvaṃ tarkaviśeṣaṇam | iha tvanāhāryā sambhāvaneti vācyam | tathā sati `śaṅke hanamatkathitapravṛttiḥ' iti sambhāvanāyā apyanāhāryatvena tadvyāvṛttyarthasya anyatvenetyasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāditi cet, maivam | anyatvenetyasya ṇanyatvenāvagataparatayā tasyaiva āhāryatvaviśeṣaṇaparyavasāyitvāt | nanu tathāpi naitallakṣaṇam, avyāpteḥ tathā hi; yatra svamātradharmādanyamātradharmādvā kiñcidutprekṣyate, tatrānyadharmasambandhāditi lakṣaṇāṃśābhāvādavyāptiḥ | yathā - "aṅgilībhiriva keśasañcayaṃ saṃniyamya timiraṃ marīcibhiḥ | kuḍmalīkṛtasarojalocanaṃ cumbatīva rajanīmukhaṃ śaśī ||" "bhūyastarāṇi yadamūni tamasvinīṣu jyotsnīṣu ca praviralāni tataḥ pratīmaḥ | sandhyānalena bhṛśamambaramūṣikāyāmāvartitairuḍubhireva kṛto'yaminduḥ ||" ityatrādyodāharaṇe'ṅgulīsadṛśībhirmarīcibhiḥ keśasañcayasadṛśasya timirasya grahaṇātsvamātradharmādeva śaśinaścumbanamutprekṣitam | dvitīye tārāviralatvāviralatvarūpeṇa anyamātradharmeṇa candrasya sandhyānalamadhyagāmbaramūṣikāvartitatārnikaranirmitatvamutprekṣitam | kiñca hetuphaladharmasvarūpotprekṣāsu anyatveneti lakṣaṇāṃśābhāvādavyāptiḥ | tathā - "saiṣā sthalī yatra vicinvatā tvāṃ bhraṣṭaṃ mayā nūpuramekamurvyam | adṛśyata tvaccaraṇāramindaviśleṣaduḥkhādiva baddhamaunam ||" iti hetūtprekṣodāharaṇe nūpuragatena duḥkhisādhāraṇena maunitvena nimittena nūpure taddhetubhūtaduḥkhameva dharmatayotprekṣyate, na tu duḥkhatādātmyam, duḥkhaśabdasyoparī matubādyaśravaṇāt | evam, "colasya yadbhītipalāyitasya bhālatvacaṃ kaṇṭakino vanāntāḥ | adyāpi kiṃ vānubhaviṣyatīti vyapāṭayan draṣṭumivākṣarāṇi ||" iti phalotprekṣodāharaṇe drūmagatena lalāṭākṣaradarśanapravṛttapuruṣasādhāraṇena lalāṭapāṭanena nimittena drūmāṇāṃ tatphalaṃ lalāṭākṣaradarśanamuddeśyamiti dharmatayotprekṣyate, na tu lalāṭākṣaradarśanapravṛttadharmitādātmyam, draṣṭumityasya dharmiparyantatvābhāvāt | tathā - "pinaṣṭīva taraṅgāgraiḥ samudraḥ phenacandanam | tadādāya karaindurlimpatīva digaṅganāḥ ||" iti dharmasvarūpotprekṣodāharaṇe samudrasya candanagharśaṣaṇaśilāprāntasthanīye taṭe hartasthanīyataraṅagāgraiḥ phenacandanaprerakatvena śaśāṅaakāsya karairdigaṅaaganādhavalīkaraṇena ca pratīyamnena nimittena tatkartṛkaṃ peṣaṇalepanamātramutprekṣyate, na tu tayoḥ peṣaṇalepanakartṛtādātmyam | pinaṣṭi limpatītyākhyātayoḥ kartṛvācakatve'pi `bhāvapradhānamākhyātam', iti nyāyena kartṛḥ pradhānabhūtakriyopasarjatasya anyatrānvayāsambhavāt | ata eva `limpatīva tamo'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñjanaṃ nabhaḥ' ityutaprekṣāmudāhṛtavatā daṇḍinoktodāharaṇayorivaśabdaśravaṇāllepanavarṣaṇakartṛbhyāṃ tamonabhasorupamāmāśaṅaakya - "kartā yadyupamānaṃ syānyagbhūto'yau kriyāpade | svakriyāsādhane vyagro nā'lamanyadvyapekṣitum ||" iti dūṣitam | "vṛttānupūrve ca na cātidīrghe jaṅgheṃ śubhe sṛṣṭavatastadīye | śeṣāṅganirmāṇavidhau vidhāturlāvaṇya utpādya ivā''sa yatnaḥ ||" ityatra niratiśayalaivaṇyaśālijaṅghāsṛṣṭyanumitena niśśeṣalāvaṇyakośyayena nimittena vidhātuḥ śeṣāṅganirmaṇopayuktalāvaṇyotpādane yatnamātramutprekṣyate, na tu tathābhūtayatnavattādātmyamiti spaṣṭameva | api ca aprakṛtadharmikotprekṣāyāṃ prakṛtamityaṃśābhāvāt avyāptiḥ | yathā - "hṛtasāramivendumaṇḍalaṃ damayantīvadanāya vedhasā | dhṛtamadhyabilaṃ vilokyate dhṛtagambhīrakhanīkhanīlima ||" atra dhṛtamadhyabilamiti padārthahetukakāv‌yaliṅgāpekṣayā'tiśayoktyā dhṛtamadhyarandhrākāśanailyatvena adhyanasito yaḥ kalaṅkastadvattvena nimittena candramaṇḍalaṃ damayantīvadananirmāṇāya hṛtasāratvenotprekṣitam | na tu prakṛtaṃ damayantīvadanamevoktaprakārāhṛtaindavasārāṃśanirmitatvenotprekṣitam | "yabdālendukaloccayādupacitaissārerivotpāditaṃ tatpaśyeyamanaṅgamaṅgalagṛhaṃ bhūyo'pi tasyā mukham ||" ityatreva tathā śabdānvayābhāvāt | nanu tathā śabdāto'nvayālābhe'pi `brājhaṇaśataṃ bhojyatām' ityatra pradhānamatilaṅghya upasarjane kriyānvayaparyavasānam saṅaakhyāyā bhojanānvayāyogyatvāt, tathehāpi pradhānamindumaṇḍalamatilaṅghya upasarjane damayandīnadane intumaṇḍalāhṛtasārāśanirmitatvotprekṣāryavasānaṃ syāt, aprakṛtasya avarṇanīyatvāt iti cet, na | aprakṛtavarṇanasyapi aprastutapraśaṃsārūpeṇa prakṛtātiśayādhānārthatayā anvetuṃṃ yogyatvāt | na ca vācyaṃ `indurliptiḥ iva' ityaprastutapraśaṃsodāharaṇāntare iva atrāpi sambhāvanāmātrameva notprekṣeti | thatra sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādinimittābhāvena utprekṣāsāmagrīparipūrtyabhāvāt utprekṣāyā asambhave'pi atra tatsambhavādaprastutapraśaṃsayā saṅkaropapatteḥ | tasmādavyāptatvānnedaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti cet - atra brūmaḥ na tāvat `hṛtasāram' ityādāvavyāptiḥ | prakṛtaśabdasya viṣayatvābhimatamātraparatvāt | na caivaṃ `indurlipta iva' ityādāvativyāptiḥ | tatra sītāvadanasannidhāne vastuto'nyadharmatve satyapi indugatāñjanaliptatvasambhāvanāyāmanyadharmatvas‌ya aprayojakatvāt, dharmasya sahṛdayahṛdayāhlādino vivākṣitatvādvā | anyatvena ityasya anyena prakāreṇa ityartha iti na hetuphaladharmasvarūpotprekṣāsu avyāptiḥ | yatra dharmiṇii dharmyantaraṃ tādātmyenotprekṣyate tatra dharmyantaraman‌yaḥ prakāraḥ | tra tu kaśiciddharma eva kiñcitprati hetutayā phalatayā svarūpeṇa votprekṣyate tatra sa eva dharme'nyaḥ prakāra iti sarvatrāpyanugateḥ yadvā hetuphaladharmasvarūpootprekṣodāharaṇeṣvapi tādātmyenaivotprekṣā | tathā hi - `saiṣā sthalī yatra vicinvatā tvām',`colasya yadbhadītipalāyitasya' ityādihetiphalotprekṣoodāharaṇayostāvadviśleṣaduḥkhalalāṭākṣaradarśanādidharme hetutayā phalatayā vā notprekṣyate | kintu nūpidrūmādidharmikaṃ yanniścalatvakaṇṭakasaṃśleṣādinimittakaṃ maunavyāpāṭanādikaṃ tadevaḥ duḥkhahetukamaunalalāṭākṣaradarśanārthavyāpāṭanāditādātmyenotprekṣyate | avaśyañja dvividhasyāpi maunādestādātmyenādhyavasāya āstheyaḥ | anyathā niścalatvādihetike svābhāvikamaunādau dhuḥkhāderhetutvādinotprekṣaṇamasamañjasaṃ syāt | aṅgīkṛtaśca `saiṣā sthalī' ityādau diḥkhādirdharma eva maunādihetutayā nūpurādigatatvena atprekṣyata iti vadatāpyalaṅkārasarvasvakṛtā dvividhasya maunāderabhedādhāyavasāyaḥ | `hetūtprekṣāyāṃ yasya prakṛ tasambandhino dharmasya hetirutprekṣyate sa dharme'dhyavasāyavaśādabhinna utprekṣānimittatvena āśrīyate' ityādi tadvacanāt | āvaśyakañcānyatrāpi kkacitkkacit hetūtprekṣādāharaṇe nimittāṃśe tādātmyādhyavasayāśrayaṇam | yathā - "unmeṣaṃ yo mama na sahate jātivairī niśāyāmindorindīvaradaladṛśā tasya saundaryadarpaḥ | nītaśśāntiṃ prasabhamanayā vaktrakāntyeti harṣāllagnā manye lalitatanu pādayoḥ rajhalakṣmīḥ ||" atra hetutayā harṣetprekṣā prati tatphalatvābhimataṃ pādayoḥ pajhalakṣmyā laganaṃ nimattiṃ vācyam, tacca sararvathaivāsiddham | atrastatra pādayoryaḥ svābhāvikaśobhāsambandhaḥ sa eva pajhalakṣmīlanatvena adhyavasito nimittamiti samarthanīyam | evañca nimittāṃśe tādātmyādhyavasānāvaśyambhāve tatraivotprekṣāviśrāntirastu | na ca tatra nimittāntaramanveṣyaṃ syāditi vācyam | niścalatvahetukamaunasya duḥkhahetukamaunatvenotprekṣāyāṃ caraṇāravindaviśleṣakālabhavatvaṃ nimittaṃ, kaṇṭakasaṃśleṣahetukavyāpāṭanasya lalāṭalipidarśanārthavyāpāṭanatvenotprekṣāyāṃ mahārājo'dyaivaṃ kaṣṭamanubhavati, itiḥparamapi kiyadanibhāvyamaneneti jijñāsotthāpakapalāyanakālabhavatvaṃ nimittamityādeḥ spaṣṭatvāt | ayameva pakṣo daṇḍino'pyabhimataḥ | yadhāha - "anyathaiva sthitā vṛttiścetanasyetarasyavā | anyathotprekṣyate yatra tāmutprekṣāṃ pracakṣate || madhyandinārkasantaptaḥ sarasīṃ gāhate gajaḥ | manye mārtaṇḍagṛjhāṇi pajhānyuddhartumudyataḥ || snātuṃ pātaṃ bisānyattuṃ kariṇo jalagāhanam | tadvairaniṣkrayāyeti kavinotprekṣya varṇyate ||" iti | atra santāpanivṛttyarthatvena anyathaiva sthitā kiriṇaś‌cetanasya jalagāhanarūpā vṛttiranyathā tadvairaniṣkrayārthajalāvagāhanatvena utprekṣyata iti svakṛtalakṣaṇānusāreṇaiva yojitam | kāvyaprakāśikākārasyāpyayameva pakṣo'bimataḥ tena hi `sambhāvanamathotprekṣā prakṛtasya samena yat' ityupamānenopameyasya tādātmyasambhāvanamutprekṣālakṣaṇamabhidhāya `unmeṣaṃ yo mama na sahate' iti tatrodāharaṇaṃ kṛtam | tataśca svakṛtalakṣaṇānurodhena svābhāvikī pādaśobhaiva svavairijayaprabhavaharṣalagnapajhalakṣmītvena utprekṣyata ityabhitamiti sphuṭameva | tathā `pinaṣṭīva taraṅgāgraiḥ' itiyādidharmasvarūpotprekṣodāharaṇeṣvapi preraṇādirūpatvena utprekṣyate | na ca preraṇāderviṣayasya anupādānaṃ doṣaḥ; atiśayoktāviva tadupapatteḥ utprekṣāyā adhyavasāyagarbhatayā tatra viṣayanigaraṇasya ucitacvācca | na ca preraṇāderviṣayatvena nimittatvābhāve nimittāntaramanveṣyaṃ syāditi vācyam | preraṇasya peṣaṇarūpatayotprekṣāyāṃ prantagataphenacandanapuñjībhavanaṃ nimittam | karavyāpanasya digaṅganālepanatvena utprekṣāyāṃ taddhavalīkaraṇaṃ nimittamiti nimittāntarasya jāgarūkatvāt | `limpatīva tamo'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñjanaṃ nabhaḥ' ityādau vyāpanādi lepanādrūpatayā sambhāvitamiti vadatā kāvyaprakāśikākāreṇapi dharmasvarūpotprekṣodāharaṇeṣu tādātmyotprekṣaṇapakṣa evāśritaḥ | evaṃ `cumbatīva rajanīmukhaṃ śaśī' ityādāvapi rajanyā vadanatvenādhyavasitaṃ yadārambhākhyaṃ mukhaṃ tasya śaśinaśca sambandhaścumbanatvenotprekṣyate | `vṛttānupūrve ca' ityatra ayatnapūrvake śeṣāṅ‌ganirmāṇe yatnapūrvakatattādātmyotprekṣā ityādyūjham | anyadharme'nugāmitayaiva na vivakṣitaḥ, kintūpamāyāṃ sādhāraṇadharma iva bimbapratibimbabhāvādibhiḥ sarvairapi prakārairvivakṣitaḥ | tathā ca yathā - "āvarjitā kiñcidiva stanābhyāṃ vāso vasānā tarūṇārkarāgam | paryāptapuṣpastabakāvanamrā sañcāriṇī pallavitā lateva ||" ityatra bimbapratibimbabhīvakṛtābhedādh‌yavasāyena | "tāruṇyakuñjārārūḍhāṃ vilāsakamalālayām | mūrtāmiva manojasya trailokyavijayaśriyam ||" ityatra samāsabhedāśrayaṇakṛtābhedādhyavasāyena ca dharmasya prakṛtāprakṛtasādhāraṇyādanyadharmasambandhaḥ | tathā - `aṅgulībhiriva' ityatra anvayabhedakṛtābhedādhyavasāyena dharmasya prakṛtāprakṛtāsādhāraṇyādanyadharmasambandhaḥ susampāda iti na tatrāvyāptiḥ nāpi `bhūyastarāṇi' ityatrāvyāptiḥ | tatropāttadharmakṣiptadharmāntarasambandhasya nimittatvāt | tatra hi candrarūpaviṣayagatasandhyānalamadhyagāmbaramūṣikāvartitārānikaranirmitatvotprakṣāyāṃ tārāgatena tattadrātriṣu viralatvāviralatvarūpeṇa upāttadharmeṇa nimittadena dharmasya candragatasya tadviralatvāviralatvānuvidhāyivṛddhihrāsaśālitvasyākṣepaḥ | ayañcāparo'pi viśeṣaḥ | anyadharmasambandhādityanyapadārthe dharmyutprekṣasu tu viṣayiṇo dharmasyāśrayaḥ | evaṃ sthite yatrnupātto nimittabhūto dharmastatra sarvatrāpi yo dharmo'nyapadārthasya viṣayasya ca sambanditayā sambhāvanāpadavīmārohati tatābhūto'nveṣyaḥ tatra `varṣatīvāñjanaṃṃ nabhaḥ' ityatra nabhogatatvena varṣaṇakriyotprekṣāpakṣe nabhaso bhūparyantagāminīlivyaptatvamañjanavarṣakasādhāraṇaṃ nimittam | tamaso vyāpane nabhaḥkartṛkāñjanavarṣaṇakriyātvotprekṣe tu sakalavastusāndramalinīkaraṇādi | evaṃ `veleva rāgasāgarasya' ityādau saṃkṣobhakāritavādi gamyaṃ nimittamūhanīyam | yatra tu nimittatayā dharmasyopādāne satyapi tatsambandho viṣayasyānyapadārthasya vāñjasā na pratīyate tatra kkacinnimittabhūtadharmādanyasya tasyaciddarmasya tattādrūpyampādanena tatsambandhaḥ samarthanīyaḥ; kkacidviṣayasya vā, anyapadārthasya vā, taddharmāśrayatādrūpyasampādanena; kkacinmilitena tenobhayena, kkacidupāttadharmakṛtadharmāntarākṣepeṇa | tatra dharmāntarasya nimittatādrūpyasampādanumupamāyāṃ dharmasya sādhāraṇyasampādanamiva bimbapratibimbabhāvādibhiḥ prakāraiḥ | te ca pradarśitāḥ | evaṃ viṣayasya anyapadārthasya vā dharmāśrayatādrūpyasampādanaṃ śleṣādibhaṅgyā | tatra viṣayasya śleṣeṇa dharmāśrayatādrūpyampādanaṃ yathā - "asyāṃ munīnāmapi mohamūhe bhṛgurmahānyatkucaśailaśīlī | nānāradāhlādi mukhaṃ śritorurvyāso mahābhāratasargayogyaḥ ||" atra bhṛgvādimunirūpaviṣayagatadamayantīgocaramohotprekṣāyāṃ yadeva tatkucapariśīlanādi nimittaṃ na tadviṣayagataṃ kintu taṭādigatam | tasya bhṛgvādiśabdaśleṣeṇa viṣayagatatānirvāhaḥ | apahnutyā yathā - "kiṃśukavyapadeśena tarumārujha sarvataḥ | dagdhādagdhāmaraṇyānīṃ paśyatīva vibhāvasuḥ ||" atra dāvānalarūpaviṣayagatadagdhādagdhavanapradarśanakriyotprekṣāyāṃ tarusamārohaṇaṃ nimittam | tadapi na viṣayagatam, kintu kiṃśukapuṣpagatam | tatrāpi yadyapi mukhyaṃ samārohaṇaṃ nsti tathāpi tadīyaṃ tarusamāśrayaṇameva tadārohaṇatvenādhyavasitam, tataś‌ca tatrāpahnutyā viṣayasya kiṃśukapuṣpatādrūpyasampādanena dharmasambandhanirvāhaḥ | anyapadārthasya śleṣeṇa dharmāśrayatādrūpyasampādanaṃ yathā - "asyā dauhṛdaśālinyā mukhamāpāṇḍuraprabham | satyaṃ rājeti manye'dya yad bhuvaṃ bhoktumicchati ||" atra mukhasya candratprekṣāyāṃ bhuvaṃ bhoktumabhilāṣo nimittam | tadviṣayagatamapi nānyapadārthabhūtacandragatam | atastatra rājaśabdaśleṣeṇa candrasya dharmāśrayatādrūpyasampādanena dharmasya tadīyatānirvāṅaḥ | dharmantarasya nimittadharmatādrūpyasampādanaṃ, viṣayasya taddharmāśrayatādrūpyasampādanaṃ ceti ubhayamelanaṃ yathā - "ākṛṣṭivegavigaladbhujagendrabhoganirmekapaṭṭapariveṣatayāmburāśeḥ | manthavyathāvyupaśamārthamivāśu yasya mandakinī ciramaveṣṭata pādamūle ||" atra mandākinīrūpaniṣayagatapayodhimanthavyathāvyupaśamarūphalotprekṣāyāṃ yannimittaṃ caraṇamūle veṣṭanaṃ,tattādātmyasampādanaṃ pratyantaparvatamūlaveṣṭanasya śleṣeṇa, viṣayasya taddharmāśrayatādrūpyasampādanamapahnutyā, pratyantaveṣṭanarūpasya, uktasya dharmasya āśrayo nirmokaḥ, tasyāpahnutiḥ vyājārthakapariveṣapadena ceti militenobhayena viṣayasya anyadharmasambandhanirvāhaḥ | upāttadharmeṇa dharmāntarākṣepastu darśita eva | tasmāt anyadharmasambandhāt ityetadapi sarvotprekṣānugatamiti na kkāpi avyāptamiti sarvaṃ samañjasam | alaṅkārasarvakṛtā itthamasya vibhāgaḥ pradarśitaḥ | vācyā pratīyamānā cetī tāvadutprekṣā dvividhā | ivādiprayoge vācyā | tadaprayoge pratīyamānā | tatra vācyā jātiguṇakriyādravyaṇāmaprakṛtānāmadhyavaseyatvena yaturvidhā | teṣāñca pratyekaṃ bhāvābhāvābhimānarūpatayā dvaividhyenāṣṭavidhā | teṣu nimittasya guṇakriyārūpatvena ṣoḍhaśa bhedāḥ nimittasya punarupīdīnīnupīdīnībhyāṃ dvātriṃśatprakārāḥ | teṣu punaḥ pratyekaṃ svarūpahetuphalotprekṣāārūpatvena ṣaṇṇavatirbhedāḥ | tatra svarūpotprekṣaṇameveti hetuphalotpekṣāstataḥ pātanīyāḥ | tataḥ ṣoḍaśabhedā nyūnāḥ | jātyādīnāmapi hetuphalootprekṣayornimittasya anupādānaṃ na sambhavati; tataścaturviṃśatirbhedā nyūnāḥ tathā ca svarūpotprekṣā avaikalyena dvātriṃśadbhedā | hetuphalotprekṣe pratyekaṃ dvādaśabheda iti ṣaṭepañcāśadabhedā vācyotprekṣā | pratīyamānotprekṣāyāmapyevameva gaṇanā | tatra svarūpokṣāyāmapi nimittānupādānaṃ na sambhavatīti bhedaḥ | tataśca tatra svarūpotprekṣā ṣoḍaśabhedā, hetuphalotprekṣe pūrvavaddvādaśabhede iti catvāriṃśadbhedā gamyotprekṣā | evameva militvā ṣaṇṇavatibhedā atprekṣeti | vidyānāthena punardravyasya hetuphalotprekṣaṇamapyaṅgīkṛtya anupāttanitteṣu gamyas‌ya nimittasya guṇakriyārūpatvena bhedagaṇanamajātaputranāmakaraṇakalpaṃ na cārutvāvahamiti tadanādṛtya anyathā vibhāgo darśitaḥ | vācyāyāṃ svarūpoootprekṣā caturviṃśatebhedā, anupāttanimittāyāṃ guṇakriyārūpabhedagaṇanābhāvena bhedāṣ‌ṭakahrāsāt . hetuphalotprekṣe pratyekaṃ bhedānāmādhikyāt | evaṃ ṣaṭpañcāśadbhedā vācyotprekṣā | pratīyamānāyāṃ punaḥ svarūpotprekṣāpi ṣoḍaśaprakārā tatra nimittanupādānsambhavena tannibandhanabhedāṣṭakahrāsāt | tataśca aṣṭacatvāriṃśadbhedā pratīyamānotprekṣā | evaṃ militvāṃ caturuttaraśatabhedotprekṣeti | athodāharaṇāni diṅmātreṇa pradarśyante | upāttaguṇanimittajātibhāvasvarūpotprekṣā yathā - "sa vaḥ pāyādindurnavabilatākoṭikuṭilaḥ smarārerye mūrdhni jvalanakapiśe bhāti nihitaḥ | stranmandakinyāḥ pratidivasasiktena payasa kapālenonmuktaḥ sphaṭikadhavalenāṅlura iva ||" atrāṅkuraśabdasya jātiśabdatvājjātirutprekṣyate | upāttaḥ kauṭilyaguṇo nimittam | evamupāttakriyānimittāpi jātibhāvasvarūpotprekṣā udāhartavyā | apāttakriyānimittaguṇabhāvasvarūpotprekṣā yathā - "niveśitaṃ yāvakarāgadīptaye lagnaṃ tadīyīdharasīmni sikthakam | rarāja tatreva nivastumutsukaṃ madhūni nirdhūya sudhāsadharmiṇi ||" atra autsukyaṃ guṇa utprekṣyate . upāttā laganakriyā nimittam | evamupāttaguṇanimittāpi guṇabhāvasvarūpotprekṣā udāhartavyā | upāttaguṇanimittakriyābhāvasvarūpotprekṣā yathā - "atha sāndhyasāndrakiraṇāruṇitaṃ harihetihūtimithunaṃ patatoḥ | pṛthagutpapāta viraṅārtidaladdhṛdayastrutāsṛganuliptamava ||" atra rudhirānulaṃpanakriyotaprekṣyate | upātta āruṇyaguṇo nimittam | evamupāttakriyānimittāpi kriyābhāvasvarūpotprekṣā udārtavyā | upāttakriyānimittadravyabhāvarūpotprekṣā yathā - "ekaikamadbhutaguṇaṃ dhutadūṣaṇañ‌ca hitvānyamupagamya parityajantīm | enāṃ jagāda jagadarcitapādapajhā pajhāmivācyutabhujāntaravicyutāṃ sā ||" atra pajhāyā ekatayā dravyatvāddravyamutprekṣyate | upāttā upagamyapirityajanakriyā nimittam | evamupāttaguṇanimittadravyabhāvasyarūpotprekṣā udāhartavyā | evaṃ bhāvābhimāneṣu jātyādiṣūpāttanimittā aṣṭau bhedāḥ sampannāḥ | anupāttanimittajātibhāvasvarūpotprekṣā yathā - "varṣātapānāvaraṇaṃ cirāya kāṣṭhaughamālambya samutthiteṣu | bāleṣu tārākavakeṣvihaikaṃ vikasvarībhūtamavaimi candram ||" atra kavakajātirutprekṣyate | anupātto dhāvalyavartulatvādirguṇo nimittam | anupāttanimittaguṇabhāvasvarūpotprekṣā yathā - "ayamābhāti rājendro vijitākhilaśātravaḥ | anujīviṣu sarveṣu prasāda iva mūrtimān ||" atra prasādo guṇa utprekṣyate | anupāttaṃ bahupradatvasukhaniṣevyatvādi nimittam | anupāttanimittakriyābhāvotprekṣā yathā - "limpatīva tamo'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñ‌janaṃ nabhaḥ | asatpuruseveva dṛṣṭirniṣphalatāṃ gātā ||" atra kriyotprekṣyate | anupāttaṃ vyāpanādi nimittam | anupāttanimittadravyabhāvotprekṣā yathā - "dehasthā darpaṇe yasya paśyati pratimāmumā | anyārdhābhyāmivotpannamardhanārīśvarāntaram ||" atra ardhāntarotpannārdhanārīśvarāntaradravyamutprekṣyate | pratibimbagataṃ vyatyastabhagastrīpuruṣākāśālitvamanupāttaṃ nimittam | ardhanārīśvarāntarotprekṣāyāmapi vastuto'rdhanārīśvarasya ekatvāt dravyotprekṣātvamaviruddham | yathā vā - "vilalāsa jalāśayodare kkacana dyauranubimbiteva yā | parikhākapaṭasphuṭasphukatpratibimbānavalambitāmbuni ||" atra devapurīdravyamutprekṣyate | saubhāgyātiśayaḥ kuṇḍinapurīgato'nupātto nimittam | evaṃ caturvidhānupāttanimittā udāhṛtā | asyāṃ nimittasya guṇākriyārūpabhedamālocyāṣṭavidhatvamūhanīyam | evaṃ jātyadyutprekṣā bhāvābhimānavatyaḥ ṣoḍaśa sampannāḥ | athavā vdyānāthoktaprakāreṇa anupāttanimittaguṇakriyābhede na cintanīyaḥ | anupātte nimitte tadvyavasthāyā asambhavāt | yathā - `vilalāsa jalāśayodare' ityatra niratiśayasaubhāgyavattvaṃ guṇo nimittamityapi vaktuṃ śakyam | niratiśayasaubhāgyabhāgitvaṃ kriyā nimittamapyapi | ato dvādaśaiva bhedāḥ | atha abhāvābhimānavatyaḥ svarūpotprekṣāḥ | upāttaguṇanimittā jātiguṇākriyāṇāmabhāvotprekṣā yathā - "akuṅlumakṣodamivāṅgametadayāvakāruṇyamivādharaṃ te | anañjanollekhamivākṣiyugmaṃ svābhāvikaireva guṇairudīkṣe ||" atra kuṅkumarajoyāvakarāgāñjanollekhanarūpāṇāṃ jātiguṇakriyāṇāmabhāvā utprekṣyante | upāttāḥ svābhāvikagaurāruṇanīlavarṇā nimittam | etāsu kriyānimittamapyudāhāryam | upāttakriyānimittadravyābhāvotprekṣā yathā - "bhuvi tvanmukhamālokya pūrṇacandramivoditam | acandramiva paśyāmi divaṃ śobhāvivarjanāt ||" atra candrasyadravyasya abhāva utprekṣyate | upāttā varjanakriyā nimittam | evupāttaguṇanimittāpi dravyābhāvotprekṣā udāhāryā | etāveva ślekau `idaṃ viśālākṣi vibhāvayāmi', `padavīmamṛtāndhasām' iti caturthapādayoḥ pāṭhe anupāttanimittajātyādyabhāvotprekṣodāharaṇe | evamabhāvābhimānavatyo'pi svarūpotprekṣāḥ pūrvoktarītyā ṣoḍaśa dvādaśa veti dvātriṃśaccaturviṃśatirvā svarūpotprekṣābhedāḥ pradarśataprāyāḥ | etāsu viṣayiṇaḥ kkacittādātmyenādhyavasāyaḥ | yathā - `sa vaḥ pāyādinduḥ' ityatra | kkacittusaṃsargitayā yathā - `nveśitaṃ yāvakarāgadīptaye, ityatra autsukyasyetyayamapi bhedo boddavyaḥ | atha hetūtprekṣā | upāttaguṇanimittā jātihetūtprekṣā yathā - "vahato bahuśaivalakṣmatāṃ dhṛtarudrāmadhuvrataṃ khagaḥ | sa nalasya karaṃ yayau punaḥ sarasaḥ kokanadabhramādiva ||" atra nalakaraprāptikriyāṃ prati kokanadabhramo hetutvenotprekṣyate | saiva prāptikriyā nimittam | uttaratrāpi hetūtprekṣāyāṃ sarvatra phalameva nimittam | evaṃ guṇanimittapi guṇahetūtprekṣā draṣṭavyā| guṇanimittā kriyāhetūtprekṣā yathā - "vivasvatā'nāyiṣataiva miśrāḥ svagosahastreṇa samaṃ janānām | gāvo'pi netrāparanāmadheyāstenedamāndhyaṃ khalu nāndhakāraiḥ ||" atrāndhyaguṇaṃ prati nayanakriyā hetutvenotprekṣyate | evaṃ kriyānimittāpi kriyāhetūtprekṣā udāhāryā | kriyānimittā dravyahetūtprekṣā yathā - "hṛdayaṃ paripūtameva nityaṃ viduṣastasya viśuddakarmabhājaḥ | viyadāpagayeva viśvamūrteḥ pravahantyā vasato'ntaraṅghrapajhāt ||" atra pavanakriyāṃ prati gaṅgādravyaṃ hetutvenotprekṣyate | evaṃ guṇanimittāpi hetūtprekṣā udāhāryā | itthaṃ bhāvābhimānavatyo hetūtprekṣā udāhṛtāḥ | atha abhāvābhimānavatyaḥ - "rātrau raverdivā cendorabhāvādiva sa prabhuḥ | bhūmau pratāpayaśasī sṛṣṭavān satatotthite ||" "tasminnastaṅgate bhānau vidhustasya pade kiyān | ityanādarato nūnaṃ mīlatyamburuhākaraḥ ||" "vīṇāvādanasaṃrambhāccakampe dakṣaṇaḥ stanaḥ | adṛṣṭvetaraṃ tasyāstumbyābhogatīrohitam ||" atra ādyaśloke ravicandrayordatidravyayorabhāvau hetutvenotprekṣyete | dvitīyatṛtīyaślokayorādaradarśanayorguṇakriyayorabhāvau | sṛṣṭimīlanakampakriyāstu nimittāni | evaṃ guṇanimittā apyabhāvahetūtprekṣā udāhāryāḥ | evaṃ ṣoḍaśabhedā hetūtprekṣā darśitā | atha phalotprekṣāḥ - " saudheṣu yatra mukhabhāsu mṛgekṣaṇānāṃ jyotsnāpahāsacaturāsu visṛtvarīṣu | candrastadarthamiva rātriṣu bambhramīti kurvankaraprasaraṇānyadhijālavargam ||" "tava nirvarṇayadvarṇaṃ svarṇaṃ varṇāya tādṛśe | tvatkośagehānnirgamya tīrtheṣu vasati dhruvam ||" "rathasthitānāṃ parivartanāya purātanānāmiva vāhanānām | utpattibhūmau turagottamānāṃ diśi pratasthe raviruttarasyām ||" "dugdhārṇavasahastrāya kailāsācalakoṭaye | nūnaṃ pratāparudreṇa yaśo dikṣu prasāritam ||" eṣu ślokeṣu krameṇa mukhaprabhāgauravarṇaparivartanadugdhārmavakailāsarūpāṇi jātiguṇakriyādravyāṇi phalatvenotprekṣyante | bhramaṇatīrthavāsaprasthānaprasāraṇakriyāḥ nimittāni | evaṃ guṇanimittā apyudāhāryāḥ | abhāvābhimānavatyaḥ phalotprekṣā yathā - "tvadānanena sādṛśyaṃ prāptukāmo niśākaraḥ | kalaṅkapaṅkābhāvāya nūnaṃ majjati sāgare ||" "araṇyavāsārjitabāndhavāsu mṛgīṣvavaisaraṇyāḥ | triliṅgadeśeś‌varavairināryaḥ parāṅgukhā locanavibhrameṣu ||" "sīmādrikuñjeṣu vihārabhājaḥ siddhāṅganāḥ kalpitacandrikārghān | śrīvīrarudrasya yaśovilāsān gāyantyasaṃspraṣṭumivāndhakāram ||" "vīrarudranarendrasya jayaprasthānasambhavam | rajaḥ pihitadiggolaṃ nirākāśamiva sthitam ||" eṣu ślokeṣu paṅkavairasparśanākāśānāmabhāvāḥ phalatvenotprekṣyante | teṣu parāṅmukhatvamekoguṇaḥ | anyāḥ kriyāḥ | ittaṃ guṇakriyānimittabhedā udāhāryāḥ | evaṃ phalotprekṣāḥ ṣoḍhaśa darśitāḥ | iti vātyotprekṣāvargaḥ | atha gamyotprekṣā diṅmātreṇodāhrayante - "nabhasi mahasāṃ dhvāntadhvāṅkṣapramāpaṇapatriṇāmiha viharaṇaiḥ śayainampātāṃ ravedhārayan | śaśaviśasanatrāsādāśāmagāccaramāṃ śaśī tadadhigamanāttārāpārāvatairudaḍīyata ||" atra sūryeṇa visṛṣṭanāṃ dhvāntakākapramāpaṇaśyenarūpāṇāṃ kiraṇānāṃ viharaṇena nimittena sūryasya śyenapātavatī mṛgayāvihārakriyā utprekṣyata iti kriyāsvarūpotprekṣā tāvadekā | tasmāt śaśinastrāsaḥ tasya digantaragamanaṃ prati hetutvenotprekṣyata iti hetūtprekṣā'nyā | tatastadadhigamastākāpārāvatānāṃ uḍḍayanatvenādhyavasitaṃ tattatsthāne'sphuraṇaṃ prati hetutvenotprekṣyata ityaparā ca hetūtprekṣā | sarvāśaacaitā gamyāḥ; ivādyabhāvāt | evamanyā api svayameva bodhyāḥ | nūnamādiśabdaviraheṇa pūrvektaprakāraṇāmunnetuṃ śakyatvāt. prāgudāhṛtānāmeva ślokānāṃ nūnamādiśabdāprayogeṇa gamyotprekṣodāharaṇatvasambhavācca gamyotprekṣāḥ pṛthak sākalyena nodāhṛtāḥ | idantu cintyate | gamyotprekṣāsu jātidravyasvarūpotprekṣe sambhavate na veti | sambhavata iti pakṣe - "rucayo'stamitasya bhāsvataḥ skhalitā yatra nirāśrayāḥ khalu | anusāyamabhurvilepanāpaṇakāśmīrajapaṇyavīthayaḥ ||" " parikhāvalayacchalena yā na pareṣāṃ grahaṇasya gocaraḥ | phaṇibhāṣitabhāṣyaphakkikā viṣamā kuṇḍalanāmavāpitā ||" ityādinodāharaṇena bhāvyam | abhimatañca tathā keṣāñcit | alaṅkārasarvasvakārasya tu na sambhavata iti pakṣaḥ | etadabhiprāyeṇaiva tenoktaṃ gamyotprekṣāvibhāge `prāyaścā'tra svarūpotprekṣā na sambhavati' iti | kastarjhanayostasya pakṣe'laṅkāraḥ ? rūpakameva | ata eva - "pīyūṣaprasṛtirnavā makhabhujāṃ dātraṃ tamolūtaye svargaṅgāvimanaskasokavadanastrastā mṛṇālīlat | dvirbhāvaḥ smarakārmukasya kimapi prāṇeśvarīsārasāmāśātantarudañcati pratipadi prāleyabhānostanuḥ ||" ityatra mālārūpakamudāharatā `svargaṅgāvimanaska' ityādiṣvapi rūpakamevorarīkṛtam | tasmājjātidravyotprekṣe parihṛtyaiva gamyotprekṣāvargaḥ parigaṇanīyaḥ | idañcānyadboddhavyam | dharmyutprekṣāsu viṣayiviṣayānugato dharmo, dharmotprekṣāsu viṣayyāśrayaviṣayānugato dharmaśca nimittam | tena `uvāha yā tanulatā' ityādau vaimalyaṃ nimittamityādipakṣo na yuktaḥ | tasya tādātmyasambhāvanopayuktapratibimbatvaghaṭakasya tanudharmasya viṣayadharmatvābhāvāt | `yatrānyadharmasambandhāt' ityādilakṣaṇaṃ vadadbhiḥ sarvairapi viṣayidharmasyaiva nimittatvasya vyavahṛtatvādityalamativistareṇa | atra brūmaḥ - "viṣayiṇa utprekṣāyāṃ jātiguṇādyātmanā vibhāgavidhā | yā'darsi naiva śobhā tayopamāyāmivopamānasya || tadabhāve'laṅkārāḥ sambhavamātreṇa na vibhāgam | arhantītarathā'syā viṣayo'pyevaṃ vibhaktavyaḥ || dharmasyāpi vibhāgo guṇakriyātmā na cārutāhetuḥ | upamāyāmiva, so'pi nyūnastadabhāvayorasaṅkalanāt || "manasi sankamiva priyamīkṣituṃ nayanayoḥ spṛhayāntarupetayoḥ | grahaṇaśaktirabhūdidamīyayorapi na sammukhavāstuni vastuni || vataṃsanīlāmburuheṇa kiṃ dṛśā vilokamāne vimanībabhūvatuḥ | api śrutī darśanasaktacetasāṃ na tena te śuśruvaturmṛgīdṛśām ||" ityādiṣu paśyāmo guṇakriyābhāvayorapi vyaktam | ujjvalabhāvanibandhanamutprekṣāyāṃ nimittatvam || atra jhādye udāharaṇe nayanayorhṛdayagatapriyavīkṣaṇāya antaḥpraviṣṭatvotprekṣaṇāyāṃ bājhavastugrahaṇaśaktyabhāvo nimittam | dvitīye śrotrendriyagatavilokanaikāgratvotprekṣāyā śravaṇakriyābhāvo nimittam | evam - "vīrāsanairdhyānajuṣāmṛṣīṇāmamī samadhyāsitavedimadhyāḥ | nivātaniṣkampatayā vibhānti yogādhirūḍhā iva śākhino'pi ||" ityādīnyabhāvanimittatve bhūyāṃsyudāharaṇāni | "api ca samuccayabhedaḥ parigaṇanīyo nimitteṣu | bhāvau bhāvābhāvau samuccitāvapi nimittatāṃ bhajataḥ ||" "avaimi haṃsāvalayo valakṣāstvatkīrtimūrteścapalāḥ pulākāḥ | uḍḍīya yuktaṃ patitāḥ stravantīveśantapūtaṃ paritaḥ plavante ||" "uḍupariṣadaḥ kiṃ nārhantī niśaḥ kimanaucitī patiriha na yaddṛṣṭastābhyāṃ gaṇeyarucīgaṇaḥ | sphuṭamuḍupaterāśmaṃ vakṣaḥ sphuranmalināśmanaśchavi yadanayorviccede'pi drutaṃ bata na drutam ||" "evamādiṣu bahvīṣu nihnotuṃ kena śakyate | samuccitanimittatvamutprekṣāsu nirīkṣitam || " ādye udāharaṇe haṃsāvalīnāṃ kīrtipulākatvotprekṣāyāṃ dhāvasyaguṇo jayopari plavanakriyā cetyubhayaṃ nimittam | dvitīye uḍupativakṣaso'śmavikāratvotprekṣāyāmaśmacchavirūpo bhāvo drutatvābhāvaścetyubhayaṃ nimittam | kiñca - "utprekṣāyāṃ nimittatvaṃ yajjātidravyayorapi | tenāpi vipulāṃ vijho nimittagaṇanāmimām ||" "droṇasya tatravitariṣyati bhāgyalabhyasaubhāgyakārmaṇayīmupadāṃ giriste | taddvīpadīpa iva dīptibhiroṣadhīnāṃ cūḍāmilajjaladakajjaladarśanīyaḥ ||" atra bāṇāsurasaudhasya dīpatvotprekṣāyāṃ tatprarūḍhauṣadhivṛkṣadīptayaḥ upari sthitaṃ jaladakajjalaṃ ca nimittamiti jāternimittatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | "niśāsu mūrdhni sphuratā yatsaudho rājatīndunā | śrīkaṇṭho bhaktarakṣārthaṃ sannidhānaṃ bhajanniva ||" ityatra bāṇāsurasaudhasya śivarūpotprekṣāyāṃ mūrdhni sphurannindurnimittam | evam - "bhāsvatā'laṅkāreṇa, śvetarociṣā smitena, lohitenādhareṇa, saumyena darśanena, guruṇā nikambena, sitena hāreṇa, śanaiścareṇa pādena, vikacena locanotpalena, tribhuvanajayaketunā rūpeṇa grahamayīmiva - " ityatra vāsavadattāyāḥ sakalagrahamayatvotprekṣāyāṃ śleṣeṇa tattadgaharūpāpannālaṅkārādayo nimittamiti jātikriyāguṇānāṃ samuccitānāṃ nimittatvaṃ dṛṣ‌ṭam | na codāhṛteṣu dīptyādisambandho nimittaṃ sa ca carve guṇa eveti vātyam | tathā sati "īdṛkṣāṃṃ kṣāmatāṃ gatau" ityādāvapi gamanādikriyāsambandha eva nimittamiti kriyāyā api animittatvaprasaṅgāt | na ca tathā'pi bhāsvatā'laṅkāreṇa ityādau śleṣeṇa sīryarūpatādyāpannā alaṅkārādayo nimittaṃ na tvaviśiṣṭā jātirdravyañceti vācyam | tatā sati `kapālenonmuktaḥ sphaṭikadhavalenāṅkura iva' ityādāvapi kapālonmuktāṅkuratvādiviśiṣṭatvamevotprekṣaṇīyaṃ na tvaviśiṣṭaṃ jātyāditamiti viṣayiṇo'pi jātyādirūpeṇa vibhāgasya asāmañjasyaprasaṅgāt | tasmādviṣayiṇa iva nimittasyāpi jātyādirūpeṇa caturvidhatayā punaḥ pratyekaṃ bhāvābhāvābhyāmaṣṭavidhatayā ca vibhāgaḥ kartavya iti nyūna ivāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ | kiñca - "yaddhetūtprekṣāyāmanupādānaṃ nimititasya | kkāpi na sambhavatīti pratiśrutaṃ, tadapi no cāru ||" "magnā sudhāyāṃ kimu tanmukhendorlagnā sthitā tatkucayoḥ kimantaḥ | cireṇa tanmadhyamamuñcatā'sya dṛṣṭiḥ kraśīyaḥ skhalanādbhiyā nu ||" "iha hetāvutprekṣye majjanalagane nimittamanupāttam | tatkāryaṃ dṛṣṭigataṃ cireṇa yanmukhakucatyajanam ||" syādetat | iha majjanalaganotprekṣayościreṇa mukhakucatyāgāvanupātau nimitte, tayośca majjanalagane hetutvayogye iti | satyam | tathāpi na hetūtprekṣaiṣā | nahi hetubhavanakṣamasya utprekṣaiva hetūtprekṣā, kintu, hetutvenotprekṣā | yatā - `saiṣāsthalī yatra vicinvatā tvām' ityatra | atra hi pañcamī hetutvāpratipādikā | tathā - "kapolaphalakāvasyāḥ kaṣṭaṃ bhūtvā tathāvidhau | apaśyantāvivā'nyonyamīdṛkṣāṃ kṣāmatāṃ gatau ||" ityatra kṣāmatāgamanaṃ prati parasparādarśanasya hetutvotprekṣāyāṃ śatṛpratyayo hetutvapratipādakaḥ | "madanatāpabhareṇa vidīrya no yadudapāti hṛdā damanasvasuḥ | nibiḍapīnakucadvayayantraṇā tamaparādhamadhātpratibadhnatī ||" ityatra hṛdayasya madanatāpena spuṭitvā utpatanābhāve kucadvayayantraṇāyā hetutvotprekṣāyāṃ utpatanapratibandhakatvaparaḥ pratibadhnatīśabdaḥ phalato'nutpatanahetutvapratipādakaḥ | etādṛśeṣu ca phalasya nimittasya upādānaṃ niyatameva | anyathā pañcamyādīnāmanvayasghaṭanābhāvāt | yatra hetutvapratipādakaḥ śabdo nāsti tatra hetūbhavanakṣamasyāpi svarūpotprekṣaiva | ata eva alaṅkārasarvasvakṛtā - "prāpyābhiṣekametasmin pratitiṣṭhāsati dviṣām | cakampe lupyamānārthabhayavihvaliteva bhūḥ ||" ityatra vihvalitatvasya utprekṣyasya hetutvapratipādaraśabdarahitasya kampaṃ prati hetūbhavanakṣamatve'pi svarūpotprekṣā udāhṛteti cet | maivam | evaṃ hi - "smarasī smara, mekhalāguṇairuta gautraskhaliteṣu bandhanam | cyutakesaradaṣitekṣaṇānyavataṃsotpalatāḍhanāni vā ||" ityatra hetūtprekṣā sakṣyā na syāt | smaraṇagatahetutvatipādaraśabdābhāvāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | "kṛtavānasi vipriyaṃ na me pratikūlaṃ na ca te mayā kṛtam | kimakāraṇameva darśanaṃ vilapantyai rataye na dīyate ||" ityuktyanantaraṃ pravṛsyāsya ślokasya, athavā matpūrvakṛtāparādharamaraṇenaiva darśanaṃ na dīyate kimiti hetūtprekṣāparatve eva sāmañjasyāt | yadi tu hetutvapratipādakaśabdābhāve'pi pūrvāparānuguṇyenāpi hetūtprekṣā bhavet tarhīhāpi tṛtīyotprekṣāsamabhivyāhārāt tasyāṃ cireṇa madhyatyajane śabdopātte skhalanabhayasyeva ādyotprekṣayorapi nimittatayā gamyamāne cirānmukhakucatyajane majjanasya ca hetutvenotprekṣaṇamityeva yuktam | yatrāpi hi phale phalatvapratipādakaśabadaḥ tatrāpyaucityena phalotprekṣāmanadhīrya hetūtprekṣā'ṅgīkāryā dṛśyate | yathā - "hṛttasya yanmantrayate rahastvāṃ tadvyaktamāmantrayate mukhaṃ yat | tadvairipuṣpāyudhamitracandrasakhyaucitī sā khalu tanmakhasya ||" atra hi hṛdayakṛtarahasyamantraṇodbhedanapratyavamarsakena tacchabadena sakhyaucitīśabdasya karmārthakaṣyañantasya sāmānādhikaraṇyācchabdato rahasyodbhedanasya mukagatatadvairimanmathasuhṛccandrasakhyakāryatvaṃ pratīyate | tathāpi tatra sakhyasya rahasyodbhedanaṃ prati hetutvenaivotprekṣā, na tu rahasyodbhedanasya sakhyaphalatvena . rahasyodbhedanaṃ phalamuddīśya sakhyaṃ kṛtamityutprekṣāyā asāmañjasyāt | hetutvamātreṇa hetūtprekṣāyā iva taduddeśaṃ vinā kāryatvamātreṇa phalotprekṣāyā anirvāhāt | evaṃ yatra hetau hetutvapratipādakaḥ śabdastatrāpi kkacit aucityena hetūtprekṣāmavadhīrya phalotprekṣā aṅgīkāryā dṛśyate | yathā - "smarāśugībhūya vidarbhasubhrūvakṣo yadakṣobhi khalu prasūnaiḥ | strajaṃ sṛjantyā tadaśodhi teṣu yatraikayā sūciśikhāṃ nikhāya ||" atra nikhanane pūrvakālatvarūpakāraṇatvapratipādakaktvāprayasadbhāve'pi na tadvairaśodhanaṃ prati hetutvenotprekṣyaṃ kintu vairaśodhanārtaṃ nikhananamiti vairaśodhanameva phalatvenotprekṣyam, siddāsiddhayorasiddhasyotprekṣaṇīyatvāt; iha taduddeśādutprekṣaṇasambhavācca | yathā vā - "asyaiva sargāya bhavatkarasya sarojasṛṣṭirmama hastalekhaḥ | ityāha dhātā hariṇekṣaṇāyāṃ kiṃ hastalekhīkṛtayā tayā'syām ||" atra hastalekhīkṛtayā tayā sarojasṛṣṭyeti karaṇavibhaktisadbhāve'pi na sā vidhātṛkartṛkasarojasṛṣṭigatahastalekhatvaprakāśanaṃ prati hetutvenotprekṣyate, kintu tatprekāśanārthaṃ sarojasṛṣṭeḥ hastalekhīkaraṇamamiti tatprakāśanameva phalatvenotprekṣyam | kīṃ bahunā | yatra hetutvapratipādakaḥ śabdastasyaiva phalatvamaucityena kkacidaṅgīkāryaṃ dṛśyate yathā - "stanāvālokya tanvaṅgyāḥ śiraḥ kampayate yuvā | tayorantaranirmagnāṃ dṛṣṭimutpāṭayanniva ||" atra śaturhetau vidhāne'pi phalasyāpyuddeśyatayā kathañciddetutvamityupapādya phalotprekṣāṅgīkaraṇīyā |evañca yadā phalatvādipratipādavamapyanādṛtya hetūtprekṣādikamaucityenāṅgīkāryaṃ tadā kimu vaktavyaṃ virodiśabdābhāve aucityānusaraṇaṃ kāryamiti | evamanayā disā anyatrāpi nimittānupādānaṃ sambhavadūhanīyam | api ca - "yathopātetanimittatvamanupāttanumuttatā | pratyekaṃ vartate tadvat samuccityāpi dṛśyate ||" yathā - "munidrumaḥ korakitaśśitidyutirvane'munā'manyata siṃhikāsutaḥ | tamistrapakṣatruṭikūṭabhakṣitaṃ kalākalāpaṃ kila vaidhavaṃ vaman ||" atra korakanirgamanaviśiṣṭasya munidrumasya vidhukalākalāpavamanaviśiṣṭarāhurūpatve utprekṣyamāṇe viśeṣyotprekṣānimittamasitavarṇatvamupāttam | viśaṣaṇotprekṣānimittantu korakavidhukalāsādharmyādirūpaṃ nopāttam | yathā vā - 'tvatprāṅgaṇe sundara pāṇḍyadeva mataṅgajāḥ śṛhkhalino vibhānti | āvāsadānādaribhūpatunāmāśantaśailā iva sāparādhāḥ ||" atra viśeṣaṇabhūtasāparādhatvotprekṣānimittaṃ śṛṅkalitatvamupāttam, viśeṣyaśailarūpatvotprekṣānimittamaunnatyādikaṃ nopāttam | yathā vā - "ajastrabhūmitaṭakuṭṭanotthitairupāsyamānaṃ caraṇeṣu reṇubhiḥ | rayaprakarṣādhyayanārthamāgatairjanasya cetobhirivāṇimāṅkitaiḥ ||" atra viśeṣyabhūtacetorūpatvotprekṣāyāmaṇimāṅkatairiti nimittamupātm | adhyayanārthamāgatairiti tadviśeṣaṇotprekṣāyāmapi caraṇopāsanārūpaṃ nimittamupāttam | rayaprakarṣetyadhyayanaviśeṣaṇe nimittaṃ cetasāṃ varṇanīyādaśvādapakṛṣṭarayatvaṃ nopāttam | evamantrāpi nimittopādīnānupādānasamuccaye udāhartavyam | tasmānyūnaḥ satṛṇābhyavahāraścāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ | ato'tra viṣayiṇo jātyādirūpeṇāṣṭadhā vibhāgaṃ, dharmasya guṇakriyārūpeṇa vibhāgañcāpahāya vibhāgāntaralabhyā yāvanto bhedāstāvan‌ta eva camatkāriṇaḥ | svarūpahetuphalotprekṣāsu tu vidhāntareṇapi ṇavāntarabhedāḥ sambhavanti | yathā - svarūtprekṣā dvividhāaviśiṣṭotprekṣā, viśiṣaṭotprekṣā ca | yatra viṣayiṇo viśeṣaṇamupāttamapi notprekṣaṇīyamavagamyate tadviṣayarūpasya tannimittarūpasya vā viṣayaviśeṣaṇasyābhāvāt, kantu tadviśeṣaṇasyābhāvāt, kintu tadviśeṣaṇaṃ viṣayiṇi vidhāntareṇopayujyate sā'viśiṣṭotprekṣā | yatra tu viṣayiṇo viśeṣaṇamapyutprekṣaṇīyamavagamyate tadviṣayarūpasya, tannimittarūpasya vā viṣayaviśeṣaṇasya upādānātsā viśiṣṭotprekṣā | tatradyā yathā - "ratergṛhītānayena kāmaṃ pratyarpitasvāṅgamiveśvareṇa | kātutsthamālokayatāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ mano babhūvendumatīnirāśam ||" atra madanarūpatvotprekṣāyāṃ madanākṛtiśilitvamasti nimittam | atastattāvadutprekṣaṇīyamavagamyate | tatparretyarpaṇaṃ ratyanunayaprasannena parameśvareṇa kṛtamiti viśeṣaṇāṃśastu notprekṣaṇīyo'vagamyate | tadaṃśe viṣayasya vācyasya, gamyasya vā nimittsya cābhāvāt | kintu parameśvaradagdhasya madanadehasya asuradagdhasya kacadehasya śukra iva na kaśaacidanyaḥ pratyarpaṇaṃ kartuṃ śaknotīti viṣayiṇi pratyarpaṇopapādakatayā tadviśeṣaṇamupayujyate iti aviśiṣṭotprekṣeyam | viśiṣṭotprekṣā yathā - `munidrumaḥ korakitaśśitidyutiḥ', tvatprāṅgaṇe sundarapāṇḍyadeva' ityādyudāharaṇam | atra ādyodāharaṇe viṣayopādānāt viṣayiviśeṣaṇasya utprekṣyatā'vagamyate, dvitīye nimittopādānāt | hetuphalotprekṣe tu asiddhayossiddhayossiddhayorvā hetuphalabhāvena utprekṣyatā'vāgamyate, dvitīye nimittopādānāt | hetuphalotprekṣe tu asiddhayossiddhayorvā hetuphalabhāvena utprekṣaṇīyatayā pratyekaṃ dvividhe | "saiṣā sthalī yatra vicinvatā tvām", `colasya yadbhītipalāyitasya' ityādiṣu nūpurakaṇṭakidrumādāvasiddhayorviśleṣaduḥkhalalāṭalipidarśanādikayorhetuphalabhāvena utprekṣaṇīyatā | "ālohitatalāvetau kṣitau vikṣepaṇādiva | varṇayema kathaṃ tanvyāḥ pādau pallavakomalau ||" "pūraṃ vidhurvardhayituṃ payodheḥ śaṅke'yameṇāṅkamaṇiṃ kiyanti | payāṃsi dogdhi priyaviprayogātsaśokakokīnayane kiyanti ||" ityadiṣu pādacandrādau svatastiddayoreva vikṣepapayodhivardhanādikayorhetuphalabhāvenotprekṣaṇīyatā | prakārāntareṇāpi katicidasyā bhedān samāsoktiprakaraṇe darśayiṣyāmaḥ | yatu sarvasvakṛtā vaicitryāntaramasyā darśitam - `eṣā kkaciddharmaviṣaye śliṣṭā, kkacicchalādiśabdena sāpahnavā, kkacitpadārthānvayavelāyāṃ sādṛśyābhidhānāt, upakrāntāpyupamā vākyārthatātparyasāmarthyāt abhimantṛvyāpāraucityakrameṇa utprekṣāyāṃ paryavasyatīti upamopakramā ceti' tatra dharmaviṣaye śliṣṭatvaṃ kimityupanyastam ? kiṃ dharmasya nimittatā anugāmitayeva śleṣeṇāpi nrvājhata iti, kiṃ vā dharmaṃśe śuddhateva śleṣeṇālaṅkṛtatāpi dṛśyata iti | ādye upamāyāṃ sādhāraṇadharmasya anugāmitvādayo yāvanto bhedāḥ sādāraṇyanirvāhakāste sarve'pi utprekṣāyāṃ dharmasya nimittatānirvāhakāḥ sambhavantīti nyūno vibhāgaḥ | tathāhi - `bālenduvakrāṇyavikāsabhāvāt' ityādau tāvadanugāmitvaṃ spaṣṭam | yathā - "vyarājata sakhe tanvyā vaktraṃ valitakandharam | lāvaṇayaughajalāvṛttanāladaṇḍamivāmbujam ||" ityatra vastuprativastubhāvaḥ | bimbapratibimbabhāvādayastu prāgevodāhṛtāḥ | dvitīye nimittāṃśe śleṣeṇeva alaṅkārāntareṇāpi alaṅkṛtatā dṛśyate iti nyūno vibhāgaḥ | tathāhi - `aṅgulībhiriva keśasañcayam' iti nimittāśe upamālaṅkāraḥ spaṣṭaḥ | "udaraṃ parimāti muṣṭinā kutukī damasvasuḥ kimu | dhṛtataccaturaṅgulīva yadvalibhirbhāti sahemakāñcibhiḥ ||" ityatrotprekṣā | atra damayantyudarasya kenacitkutukinā parimīyamāṇatvotprekṣāyāṃ kāñcīsahitāsu valīṣṭu tadīyāṅgulitvotprekṣālabdhamudaragataṃ tadīyāṅgulicatuṣṭayadhāraṇaṃ nimititam | "ajastramārohasi
